P.name: Deathbringer Stance
P.tooltip:
Aatrox's Attacks deal an additional (4% ~ 10%) max Health magic damage and restore 100% of damage dealt as Health, reduced to 25% against minions. This effect has a (22 ~ 10) second cooldown.

Attack and Ability hits against champions and large jungle monsters reduce this effect's cooldown by 2 seconds. Hits with the edge of The Darkin Blade reduce it by 4 seconds instead.

Q.name: The Darkin Blade
Q.tooltip:
Aatrox slams his greatsword, dealing (10/25/40/55/70 + (60/67.5/75/82.5/90% Attack Damage)) physical damage. If they are hit on the edge, they are briefly Knocked Up and they take (10/25/40/55/70 + (60/67.5/75/82.5/90% Attack Damage)) instead. This Ability can be Recast twice, each one changing shape and dealing 25% more damage than the previous one.

Deals 80% damage to minions.
Knock Up duration against monsters is doubled and it deals 25 bonus damage.

W.name: Infernal Chains
W.tooltip:
Aatrox fires a chain, Slowing the first enemy hit by 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% for 1.5 seconds and dealing (30/40/50/60/70 + (40% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Champions and large jungle monsters have 1.5 seconds to leave the impact area or be Pulled back to the center and damaged again for the same amount.

Deals double damage to minions.

E.name: Umbral Dash
E.tooltip:
Passive: Aatrox heals for (16% + (0.01% bonus Health)) of the damage he deals to Champions.

Active: Aatrox dashes. He can use this Ability while winding up his other Abilities.

R.name: World Ender
R.tooltip:
Aatrox reveals his true demonic form, Fearing nearby minions for 3 seconds and gaining 60/80/100% Move Speed decaying over 10 seconds. He also gains 20/30/40% Attack Damage and increases self-healing by 50/75/100% for the duration.

Champion takedowns extend the duration of this effect by 5 seconds and refresh the Move Speed effect.

Duration cannot be increased past 10 seconds.

P.name: Essence Theft
P.tooltip:
Killing minions or monsters grants Ahri an Essence Fragment. After obtaining 9 Fragments, Ahri consumes them to restore (20% Ability Power) Health.

When Ahri scores a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them, she feasts upon their Essence, restoring (30% Ability Power) Health.

Q.name: Orb of Deception
Q.tooltip: Ahri throws then pulls back her orb, dealing (35/60/85/110/135 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage on the way out and (35/60/85/110/135 + (50% Ability Power)) true damage on the way back.

W.name: Fox-Fire
W.tooltip:
Ahri releases 3 fox-fires that seek nearby enemies and deal (40/60/80/100/120 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage, reduced to (16/24/32/40/48 + (16% Ability Power)) damage beyond the first. She also gains 40% Move Speed decaying over 2 seconds.

Fox-fires prioritize champions hit by Charm, enemies Ahri has attacked, then other champions. Minions below 20% Health take 200% damage.

E.name: Charm
E.tooltip:
Ahri blows a kiss that Charms the first enemy hit for 1.2/1.35/1.5/1.65/1.8 seconds and deals (80/120/160/200/240 + (85% Ability Power)) magic damage.

This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

R.name: Spirit Rush
R.tooltip:
Ahri nimbly dashes, firing 3 essence bolts at nearby enemies, prioritizing champions. These bolts deal (75/125/175 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage each. Spirit Rush can be Recast up to 2 more times within 15 seconds.

Consuming a champion's Essence with Essence Theft during this period extends the recast window by up to 10 seconds and grants an additional recast of Spirit Rush (up to 3 stored).

P.name: Assassin's Mark
P.tooltip: When Akali hits an enemy champion with an Ability, she reveals a ring around them for 4 seconds and gains Move Speed towards the ring. Crossing the ring causes Akali's next Attack to have doubled range and deal an additional (35 + (60% bonus Attack Damage) + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Q.name: Five Point Strike
Q.tooltip: Akali slings kunai in an arc, dealing (45/70/95/120/145 + (65% Attack Damage) + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing enemies at the tip by 50% for 0.5 seconds.

W.name: Twilight Shroud
W.tooltip:
Akali drops a smoke bomb, unleashing a spreading cover of smoke lasting 5/5.5/6/6.5/7 seconds and granting herself 30/35/40/45/50% Move Speed decaying over 2 seconds.

Akali increases her max Energy by 100 while the shroud is active.

While inside the smoke, Akali is Invisible.

Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight.

E.name: Shuriken Flip
E.tooltip: Akali flips backwards as she throws a shuriken, dealing (21/42/63/84/105 + (30% Attack Damage) + (33% Ability Power)) magic damage and marking the first enemy or smoke cloud hit. Akali can Recast this once to dash to the marked target, dealing (49/98/147/196/245 + (70% Attack Damage) + (77% Ability Power)) magic damage.

R.name: Perfect Execution
R.tooltip:
Akali vaults over an enemy champion, dealing (110/220/330 + (50% bonus Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage to all enemies in her path.

Akali can Recast after 2.5 seconds to execute a piercing thrust, dashing and dealing (70/140/210 + (30% Ability Power)) to (210/420/630 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage based on missing Health.

Deals max damage to targets below 30% Health.

P.name: Dirty Fighting
P.tooltip:
After launching an Attack, Akshan will fire an additional shot for (50% Attack Damage) physical damage. He can cancel this shot to instead gain (20 ~ 75) Move Speed decaying over 1 second.

Every three hits from Attacks or Abilities deals an additional (150 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Against champions, Akshan also gains (35% bonus Attack Damage) Shield for 2 seconds (4 second Cooldown).

Q.name: Avengerang
Q.tooltip:
Akshan throws a boomerang that deals (45/75/105/135/165 + (70% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, extending the range each time an enemy is hit.

Champion hits grant Akshan (20% + (0.05% Ability Power)) Move Speed decaying over 1 second.

Deals 40/50/60/70/80% damage to non-champions. Enemies hit are briefly revealed.

W.name: Going Rogue
W.tooltip:
Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.
While active, Akshan also sees trails leading to Scoundrels.
Akshan can only claim Scoundrels when he is alive.
Total gold earned:

E.name: Heroic Swing
E.tooltip:
First Cast: Akshan fires a grappling hook, attaching to the first terrain hit.

Second Cast: Akshan swings around the terrain, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy for (8/16/24/32/40 + (25% Attack Damage)) physical damage per shot.

Third Cast: Akshan dives off the rope, firing a final shot.

Colliding with an enemy Champion or terrain ends the swing early.

Champion takedowns refresh this Ability's Cooldown.

Akshan prioritizes shooting champions marked by Dirty Fighting.
On-hits while swinging are 25% effective.
Damage is increased by 30% of bonus Attack Speed.
Attacks can critically strike for (8/16/24/32/40 + (25% Attack Damage)) physical damage.

R.name: Comeuppance
R.tooltip:
Akshan locks onto a champion and begins overcharging his gun for up to 2.5 seconds, storing up to 5/6/7 bullets.

Recast: Akshan unleashes the stored bullets, each dealing at least (25/35/45 + (15% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy or structure hit, increased up to (75/105/135 + (45% Attack Damage)) physical damage based on missing Health.

Bullets execute minions and apply Lifesteal.
Bullet damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 30% effectiveness.

P.name: Triumphant Roar
P.tooltip:
Alistar gains a stack whenever he Stuns or Knocks an enemy champion, or whenever an enemy dies. At 7 stacks, Alistar roars, restoring (5% Health) Health to himself and (7% Health) Health to nearby allied champions.

Enemy champion and epic jungle monster deaths fully charge this Ability.

Q.name: Pulverize
Q.tooltip: Alistar smashes the ground, Knocking Up enemies for 1 second and dealing (60/100/140/180/220 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

W.name: Headbutt
W.tooltip: Alistar rams into an enemy, Knocking them Back and dealing (55/110/165/220/275 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage.

E.name: Trample
E.tooltip:
Alistar begins trampling the ground, becoming Ghosted and dealing (80/110/140/170/200 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage over 5 seconds to nearby enemies. Each pulse that damages a champion grants a stack.

At 5 stacks, Alistar's next Attack against champions Stuns for 1 second and deals an additional (20 ~ 20) magic damage.

Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.

R.name: Unbreakable Will
R.tooltip: Alistar immediately cleanses all Disabling effects and takes 55/65/75% reduced damage for 7 seconds.

P.name: Drakehound's Step
P.tooltip:
When Ambessa is casting an Ability, issuing a Move or Attack order will cause her to dash in that direction after the Ability finishes.

Each cast initiation grants her a charge for 4 seconds (max: 3). While Ambessa has a charge, she gains 75 Attack Range and 50% Attack Speed. Attacks consume a charge to deal (25% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage and restore 70 Energy.

Q.name: Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam
Q.tooltip:
Cunning Sweep: Ambessa sweeps her blades forward, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) + (4/4.5/5/5.5/6% + (0.03% bonus Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage to enemies at the edge of the strike. All other enemies take 50% damage. Striking an enemy readies a Sundering Slam.

Sundering Slam: Ambessa slams her blades down, dealing (50/75/100/125/150 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) + (4/4.5/5/5.5/6% + (0.04% bonus Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage against the first enemy hit. All other enemies take 50% damage.

Deals an additional 75 physical damage to monsters.
The percent of max Health damage to monsters is capped at (100 ~ 300).

W.name: Repudiation
W.tooltip: Ambessa gains (150% bonus Attack Damage) Shield for 1.5 seconds and braces herself for 0.5 seconds. She then slams the ground, dealing (50/75/100/125/150 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to nearby enemies, which increases to (75/112.5/150/187.5/225 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage if she braced herself from damage from an enemy champion, large monster, or structure.

E.name: Lacerate
E.tooltip: Ambessa whips her chains around, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing enemies by 99%, which decays over 1 second. Initiating Drakehound's Step from this Ability will trigger an additional strike.

R.name: Public Execution
R.tooltip:
Passive: Ambessa gains 10/20/30% Armor Penetration and her Abilities heal her for (15/17.5/20% + (50% Lifesteal)) of the damage she dealt.

Active: Ambessa becomes Unstoppable and blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line, Suppressing the target for 0.75 seconds and then slamming them into the ground, dealing (150/250/350 + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Stunning them for 0.4 seconds.

Healing is 25% effective against minions and 25% effective against monsters.

P.name: Cursed Touch
P.tooltip: Amumu's Attacks Curse his enemies for 3 seconds, causing them to take an additional 10% true damage from all magic damage they take.

Q.name: Bandage Toss
Q.tooltip:
Amumu launches a bandage, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, Stunning them for 1 second, and dealing (70/95/120/145/170 + (85% Ability Power)) magic damage.

This Ability has 2 charges.

W.name: Despair
W.tooltip: Toggle: Amumu begins crying, dealing 10 plus (1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 + (0.5% Ability Power))max Health magic damage to nearby enemies every second and refreshing Curse.

E.name: Tantrum
E.tooltip:
Passive: Amumu takes (5/7/9/11/13 + (3% bonus Armor) + (3% bonus Magic Resist)) reduced physical damage. Additionally, when Amumu is hit by an Attack, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds.

Active: Amumu throws a tantrum, dealing (65/95/125/155/185 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies.

Damage reduction effect can't reduce the damage below 50%.

R.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
R.tooltip:
Amumu flares out his bandages, Stunning for 1.5 seconds, dealing (200/300/400 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and applying Curse.

This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

P.name: Rebirth
P.tooltip: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg, healing to full Health and receiving 20 Armor and Magic Resist. If she survives for 6 seconds, she is reborn.

Q.name: Flash Frost
Q.tooltip:
Anivia fires a massive chunk of ice, dealing (50/70/90/110/130 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage and Chilling enemies for 3 seconds, Slowing them by. At the end of its range, the ice detonates, Stunning enemies for 1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 seconds and dealing (60/95/130/165/200 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Anivia can Recast this ability while the ice flies to detonate it early.

W.name: Crystallize
W.tooltip: Anivia summons a wall of ice 400/500/600/700/800 units wide. The wall lasts for 5 seconds before it melts.

E.name: Frostbite
E.tooltip: Anivia blasts an enemy with a freezing wind, dealing (55/80/105/130/155 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage. Against Chilled enemies, Anivia deals (110/160/210/260/310 + (110% Ability Power)) magic damage instead.

R.name: Glacial Storm
R.tooltip:
Toggle: Anivia calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail that Slows enemies by 20/30/40% and deals (30/45/60 + (12.5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second. The storm increases in size over 1.5 seconds.

When the storm is fully formed, it Chills, Slows by 30/45/60%, and does (90/135/180 + (37.5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second instead.

The storm ends if Anivia is too far away.

P.name: Pyromania
P.tooltip:
After using 4 Abilities, Annie's next damaging Ability Stuns for 1.75 seconds.

Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.

Q.name: Disintegrate
Q.tooltip: Annie hurls a fireball, dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. If the target dies, Annie refunds the Mana cost and reduces the Cooldown by 50%.

W.name: Incinerate
W.tooltip: Annie projects a wave of fire, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

E.name: Molten Shield
E.tooltip:
Annie grants an ally champion (60/95/130/165/200 + (40% Ability Power)) Shield for 3 seconds and (20% ~ 50%) Decaying Move Speed for 1.5 seconds. While the shield holds, enemies who hit the shielded ally with an Attack or Ability receive (25/35/45/55/65 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage once per shield.

Tibbers always gains the effects of Molten Shield when summoned.

R.name: Summon: Tibbers
R.tooltip:
Passive: Annie gains 10/15/20% Magic Penetration.

Annie summons her bear Tibbers, dealing (150/275/400 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage. For the next 45 seconds, Tibbers burns nearby enemies for (8/12/16 + (4% Ability Power)) magic damage per second.

Tibbers becomes enraged when summoned, if Annie stuns an enemy champion, and if Annie dies. When enraged, Tibbers gains 275% Attack Speed and 100% Move Speed decaying over 3 seconds.

Recast: Manually issue orders to Tibbers.

Tibbers has:
(50% Ability Power) Health
30 Armor
30 Magic Resist
(30/45/60 + (10% Ability Power)) Attack Damage

P.name: The Hitman and the Seer
P.tooltip:
Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister, Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Attack and Ability []. Attacks and Abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next one.

Aphelios unlocks his weapon's Ability [] at level 2 and his Ultimate at level 6. Instead of powering up his Abilities, Aphelios' rank-ups grant him permanent stats.

Lunari Weapon Order:

Q.tooltip: {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

W.name: Phase
W.tooltip: Swap main-hand and off-hand weapons, equipping .

E.name: Weapon Queue System
E.tooltip: {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

R.name: Moonlight Vigil
R.tooltip:
Aphelios fires a concentrated blast of moonlight that explodes when it hits a champion, dealing (125/175/225 + (20% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) physical damage to surrounding enemies.

Then, Aphelios attacks all champions hit with his main-hand weapon.

The Attacks apply on-hits. Critical strikes deal 100% of normal damage instead.

P.name: Frost Shot
P.tooltip:
Ashe's Attacks and Abilities Slow by (20% ~ 30%) for 2 seconds. Attacks deal 100% damage.

Ashe's critical strikes deal no extra damage, instead increasing the Slow to (40% ~ 60%) decaying.

Q.name: Ranger's Focus
Q.tooltip:
Passive: Ashe's Attacks grant a stack for 4 seconds. At 4 stacks, she may activate this Ability.

Active: Ashe gains 20/30/40/50/60% Attack Speed and her Attacks deal (110/115/120/125/130% Attack Damage) damage instead for 6 seconds.

The empowered Attacks are comprised of a flurry of 5 small strikes. They only apply on-hit effects once per Attack.

W.name: Volley
W.tooltip:
Ashe fires a volley of 7/8/9/10/11 arrows, each dealing (60/95/130/165/200 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows, but only take damage from the first.

Champion hits count as critical strikes for the purposes of Frost Shot.

E.name: Hawkshot
E.tooltip:
Ashe sends forth a hawk to grant vision for 5 seconds anywhere on the map. It also reveals the area around it as it flies.

This Ability has 2 charges ( second recharge).

R.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
R.tooltip:
Ashe launches a crystal arrow of ice that Stuns the first champion hit and deals (200/400/600 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage. The Stun duration increases with distance travelled, up to 3.5 seconds. Surrounding enemies are Slowed by Frost Shot.

Minimum Stun duration is 1 second.

P.name: Cosmic Creator
P.tooltip:
Aurelion Sol's damaging Abilities break down enemies into Stardust, which improves his Abilities.: Bursts deal an additional max Health magic damage: increased distance.: increased area and bonus execute threshold. and : increased area.
Aurelion Sol has acquired Stardust:

Q.name: Breath of Light
Q.tooltip:
Aurelion Sol breathes starfire for up to 3.25/3.25/3.25/3.25/9999 seconds, dealing (45/60/75/90/105 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage per second to the first enemy hit and 50% of the damage to surrounding enemies.

Each full second of breath on the same enemy deals a burst of (60/70/80/90/100 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage plus max Health magic damage and absorbs 2 Stardust if they are a champion.

This Ability's range is 750.
Canceling this Ability within 0.25 seconds of casting it will lock the Ability for 1 second.
Minimum mana cost of 30/35/40/45/50 per cast.
Percent damage deals a max of 300 magic damage against jungle monsters.

W.name: Astral Flight
W.tooltip:
Aurelion Sol flies in a direction. While flying, Breath of Light has no Cooldown, no max channel duration, and its flat damage is increased by 8/9/10/11/12%.

Takedowns on champions within 3 seconds of damaging them refunds 90% of this Ability's Cooldown.

Recast: End flight early.

Casting Breath of Light while flying reduces flight speed by 50%.
Flight speed is (340 + (100%)).

E.name: Singularity
E.tooltip:
Aurelion Sol summons a black hole, dealing (10/15/20/25/30 + (12% Ability Power)) magic damage per second and Dragging enemies towards the center for 5 seconds. Enemies in the center below 5% max Health die instantly.

The black hole absorbs Stardust when enemies die within it and each second an enemy champion is inside.

This Ability's cast range is 750.
Lane minions and jungle monsters inside have 0 Movement Speed.
Epic monsters cannot be executed.
Absorbs 1 Stardust per second from Champions.
Absorbs Stardust from units that die in the black hole:Champions: 2 StardustEpic monsters: 2 StardustLarge monsters: 2 StardustSiege minions: 2 StardustMinions and small monsters: 1 Stardust

R.name: Falling Star / The Skies Descend
R.tooltip:
Aurelion Sol plucks a star from the heavens and crashes it into the earth, dealing (150/250/350 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage, Stunning enemies 1 second, and absorbing 5 Stardust for each champion hit.

Gathering 75 Stardust transforms the next Falling Star into The Skies Descend.

The Skies Descend: Aurelion Sol drags a constellation's worth of fury down from the cosmos, dealing (187.5/312.5/437.5 + (93.75% Ability Power)) magic damage in a larger area, Knocking Up enemies hit for 1 second, and unleashing a massive shockwave that deals (135/225/315 + (67.5% Ability Power)) magic damage to champions and Epic Monsters and Slows all enemies hit by 50% for 1 second.

Stardust collected towards The Skies Descend: /75.

P.name: Spirit Abjuration
P.tooltip: Damaging an enemy 3 times with Abilities or Attacks exorcises them, dealing (1% + (0.027% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage and, if the enemy is a champion, frees a spirit that follows Aurora for 4 seconds, restoring her Health for (2% Ability Power) every second.

Q.name: Twofold Hex
Q.tooltip:
Fire cursed energy in a direction, dealing (45/70/95/120/145 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies and cursing them for 3.5 seconds.

Recast: End the curse, drawing back part of the enemy's spirit to Aurora, dealing up to (67.5/105/142.5/180/217.5 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies passed through based on their missing Health. Damage beyond the first hit is reduced to 20%.

If the duration runs out, Aurora will automatically Recast the Ability.

Recast deals 40% damage to minions and monsters.

W.name: Across the Veil
W.tooltip:
Hop in a direction. Upon landing, enter the spirit realm, becoming Invisible for 1/1.15/1.3/1.45/1.6 seconds and entering Realm Hopper, gaining 20/25/30/35/40% Move Speed.

Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion resets this Ability's Cooldown.

E.name: The Weirding
E.tooltip:
Converge the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies in the area and Slowing them by 80% decaying over 1 second.

Aurora hops backwards a short distance after casting.

R.name: Between Worlds
R.tooltip:
Leap in a direction. Upon landing, Aurora converges the realms, sending out a pulse of spirit energy that deals (175/275/375 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows enemies hit by 30% for 2 seconds.

The area of convergence stays active for 2.5/3.25/4 seconds, granting Aurora Realm Hopper for 3.5/4.25/5 seconds, allowing her to jump from one edge of the area to another.

Enemies attempting to enter or leave the area are Slowed by 50% for 1.5/1.75/2 seconds.

Aurora can Recast this Ability to end the effect early.

P.name: Shurima's Legacy
P.tooltip: Azir can summon the Sun Disc from the rubble of a turret. The Sun Disc deals (230 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and has 30 Armor and Magic Resist but disintegrates over 45 seconds.

Q.name: Conquering Sands
Q.tooltip:
Azir orders all Sand Soldiers to an area, dealing (75/95/115/135/155 + (35/40/45/50/55% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies they pass through and Slowing them by 25% for 1 second.

Enemies hit by multiple Sand Soldiers will not take additional damage.

W.name: Arise!
W.tooltip:
Azir summons a Sand Soldier for 10 seconds. When Azir Attacks an enemy near a Sand Soldier, he instead orders the soldiers to stab, dealing (50/65/80/95/110 + (35/42.5/50/57.5/65% Ability Power)) magic damage in their direction.

This Ability has charges.

Sand Soldiers apply On-hits at 50% damage once per attack to Azir's primary target.
Sand Soldiers that strike the same targets deal 25% damage after the first.
Sand Soldiers deal 20%damage to enemies that are not Azir's Attack target.
Sand Soldiers expire twice as fast when near an enemy turret.

E.name: Shifting Sands
E.tooltip:
Azir grants himself (70/110/150/190/230 + (60% Ability Power)) Shield for 1.5 seconds and dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies he passes through.

If Azir hits an enemy champion, he stops and gains a Sand Soldier charge.

R.name: Emperor's Divide
R.tooltip: Azir summons a wall of armored soldiers that charges forward, Knocking Back enemies and dealing (200/400/600 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage. The soldiers remain, blocking enemy paths for 5 seconds.

P.name: Traveler's Call
P.tooltip:
Bard attracts Chimes randomly around the map. When Bard moves near a Chime he collects it, gaining 24% Move Speed (stacking up to 10 times) while out of combat for 20 seconds, Experience, and restoring 12% max Mana.

Bard attracts a Meep every seconds (max: ). Bard's Attacks consume a Meep to deal an additional (30 + (40% Ability Power)) plus 6 per 5 Chimes magic damage, plus additional effects based on Chimes collected.

Q.name: Cosmic Binding
Q.tooltip:
Bard fires an energy bolt, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first two enemies hit. The first target hit is Slowed by 60% for 1/1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8s.

If the bolt hits a second enemy or a wall, any enemies hit are Stunned for 1/1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8s.

W.name: Caretaker's Shrine
W.tooltip:
Bard creates a Health shrine that grants (20/22.5/25/27.5/30% + (0.06% Ability Power)) Move Speed decaying over 1.5 seconds and restores at least (25/50/75/100/125 + (40% Ability Power)) Health to the first ally to enter. The shrine grows to restore (50/87.5/125/162.5/200 + (70% Ability Power)) Health after existing for 5 seconds.

Bard can have up to 3 shrines at once. If an enemy champion enters a shrine, it is destroyed.

This ability has 2 charges.

Current Active Shrines: /

E.name: Magical Journey
E.tooltip:
Bard opens a one-way portal through Terrain for 10 seconds. Any champion can enter the portal by moving onto it while near the entrance.

Allies travel 33% faster than enemies.

R.name: Tempered Fate
R.tooltip:
Bard hurls magical protective energy to an area, placing all units and structures hit into Stasis for 2.5 seconds.

Units in Stasis cannot move or act, and are invulnerable and Untargetable.

P.name: Death in Lavender
P.tooltip:
After using an Ability, Bel'Veth becomes Ghosted and gains (20% ~ 20%) Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

Bel'veth gains 1 Lavender stack for large minion and monster takedowns and 2 Lavender stacks for champion and epic monster takedowns. Each stack permanently grants Attack Speed.

Total bonus Attack Speed:

Q.name: Void Surge
Q.tooltip:
Bel'Veth dashes, dealing (12/14/16/18/20 + (105% Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies she passes through.

Each direction has an unique Cooldown of seconds that scales down based on her Attack Speed.


Applies On-Hit Effects to the first target hit.
Each 1% Attack Speed is equivalent to 0.2 Ability Haste for this Ability's per-direction Cooldown.
Bel'Veth does an additional 70 physical damage to monsters.

W.name: Above and Below
W.tooltip: Bel'Veth slams her tail, dealing (80/140/200/260/320 + (150% Attack Damage)) magic damage, Knocking Up foes for 0.6/0.7/0.8/0.9/1 seconds, and Slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds. If a champion is hit, this refreshes the Cooldown of Void Surge in that direction.

E.name: Royal Maelstrom
E.tooltip:
Bel'Veth channels and slashes around herself, gaining 20/30/40/50/60% Damage Reduction, 20/25/30/35/40% Life Steal, and Attacking times over 1.5 seconds with the number of Attacks increasing based on her Attack Speed. Each Attack strikes the lowest-health enemy, dealing (10/12/14/16/18 + (12% Attack Damage)) to (20/24/28/32/36 + (24% Attack Damage)) physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

Using another Ability or Recasting ends this Ability early.


Attacks from this Ability deal 200% damage to monsters and apply On-Hit Effects at 12% to 24% effectiveness based on the target's missing Health.

R.name: Endless Banquet
R.tooltip:
Passive: Attacks deal an additional (2/4/6 + (3% bonus Attack Damage)) true damage, stacking infinitely. Takedowns against champions and epic monsters leave behind a piece of Void Coral.

Active: Bel'Veth consumes a Void Coral, gaining 1 Lavender stack and activating her true form. Void Coral from void epic monsters causes minions that die nearby to become Void Remora. While casting, Bel'Veth Slows nearby enemies before exploding, dealing (150/200/250 + (150% Ability Power)) + 20% missing-Health true damage.

In her true form, Bel'Veth gains (100/250/400 + (150% bonus Attack Damage) + (150% Ability Power)) max Health, 25/75/125 Attack range, 6/13/20% Total Attack Speed, and Void Surge can pass through walls.

True form lasts 45 seconds, increased to 90 seconds at 40 Lavender stacks. At 80 Lavender stacks, true form lasts until death.




Void Remora count as lane minions with 20/45/70% Health and 110% Attack Damage.
The applied Slow ramps up to 99% while Bel'Veth consumes Void Coral.
The passive deals a maximum of (16/32/48 + (24% bonus Attack Damage)) true damage to epic monsters.
While in true form, consuming Void Coral renews the form's duration and restores 100/250/400 Health.

P.name: Mana Barrier
P.tooltip: When Blitzcrank falls below 30% Health, they gain (35% Mana) Shield for 10 seconds.

Q.name: Rocket Grab
Q.tooltip: Blitzcrank fires their right hand, Pulling the first enemy hit towards them and dealing (110/160/210/260/310 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage.

W.name: Overdrive
W.tooltip:
Blitzcrank supercharges themself, gaining 60/65/70/75/80% decaying Move Speed and 30/40/50/60/70% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

Afterwards, Blitzcrank is Slowed by 30% for 1.5 seconds.

Move Speed decays to 10% over 2.5 seconds

E.name: Power Fist
E.tooltip: Blitzcrank charges up their fist, causing their next Attack to Knock Up for 1 second(s) and deal ((200% Attack Damage) + (25% Ability Power)) physical damage.

R.name: Static Field
R.tooltip:
Passive: While this ability is available, lightning charges Blitzcrank's fists, marking those Attacked. After 1 second, they are shocked for (50/100/150 + (30/40/50% Ability Power) + (2% Mana)) magic damage.

Active: Blitzcrank overcharges, dealing (275/400/525 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and Silencing nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds. Their shields are also destroyed.

Does not break shields on monsters.

P.name: Blaze
P.tooltip:
Brand's Abilities light his targets Ablaze, dealing 2% max Health magic damage over 4 seconds. If Brand kills a unit that is Ablaze, he regains 39.983 mana. Blaze can stack up to 3 times.

When a champion or large jungle monster reaches 3 stacks, the Blaze will detonate after 2 seconds, dealing (0.02% Ability Power) max Health magic damage to surrounding enemies.

Q.name: Sear
Q.tooltip:
Brand launches a fireball that deals (70/100/130/160/190 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit.

If the target is Ablaze, they will be Stunned for 1.75 seconds.

W.name: Pillar of Flame
W.tooltip:
Brand creates a pillar of pure fire, dealing (75/120/165/210/255 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Units that are Ablaze take (93.75/150/206.25/262.5/318.75 + (87.5% Ability Power)) damage instead.

E.name: Conflagration
E.tooltip:
Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing (55/80/105/130/155 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage to surrounding units.

If the target is Ablaze, the spread range is doubled.

R.name: Pyroclasm
R.tooltip:
Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that can bounce to Brand or another enemy up to 5 times, dealing (100/175/250 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies each bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on champions.

If the target is Ablaze, they are briefly Slowed by 30/45/60%.

P.name: Concussive Blows
P.tooltip:
Braum's Attacks apply Concussive Blows for 4 seconds. Enemies with Concussive Blows gain additional stacks from any ally's Attacks.

At 4 stacks, the target is Stunned for 1.75 seconds and takes magic damage. For the next 4 seconds they don't receive stacks, but take an additional magic damage from Braum's Attacks.

Q.name: Winter's Bite
Q.tooltip:
Braum propels freezing ice from his shield, dealing (75/120/165/210/255 + (2.5% Health)) magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slowing them by 70% decaying over 2 seconds.

Applies a stack of Concussive Blows.

W.name: Stand Behind Me
W.tooltip: Braum leaps to an allied champion or minion. On arrival, Braum grants the target (20/25/30/35/40 + (12% bonus Armor)) Armor and (20/25/30/35/40 + (12% bonus Magic Resist)) Magic Resist for 3 seconds. Braum grants himself (20/25/30/35/40 + (36% bonus Armor)) Armor and (20/25/30/35/40 + (36% bonus Magic Resist)) Magic Resist for the same duration.

E.name: Unbreakable
E.tooltip:
Braum raises his shield for 3/3.25/3.5/3.75/4 seconds, intercepting enemy missiles from the chosen direction, causing them to hit Braum and then be destroyed. The first missile Braum blocks deals no damage, and subsequent projectiles deal 35/40/45/50/55% reduced damage.

Braum gains 10% Move Speed while his shield is raised.

R.name: Glacial Fissure
R.tooltip:
Braum slams the ground sending forth a fissure that Knocks Up enemies in its path and nearby Braum, and deals (150/250/350 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. The first target hit is Knocked Up for between 0.6 and 1/1.5/2 seconds, increasing with distance from Braum. All others hit are Knocked Up for 0.6 seconds.

The fissure also creates a zone for 4 seconds, that Slows by 40/50/60%.

P.name: Crimson Curse
P.tooltip:
Briar's Attacks and Abilities apply a bleed for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. The bleed deals (50% bonus Attack Damage) to (10% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage based on stacks, and Heals Briar for 25% of the pre-mitigation damage.

Briar gains up to (40 + (2.5% bonus Health)) increased Healing based on her missing Health. She has no Base Health Regeneration and her Abilities cost 5% current Health to cast.

Q.name: Head Rush
Q.tooltip:
Briar leaps to a target, Stunning it for 0.85 seconds, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (60% Ability Power) + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and reducing 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Armor and Magic Resist for 5 seconds.

Briar will stop prioritizing champions if she casts this Ability on a minion or monster during Blood Frenzy.

This Ability applies On-Hit effects.

W.name: Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack
W.tooltip:
Briar leaps and enters a Blood Frenzy, self-taunting to the nearest enemy for 5 seconds, prioritizing Champions. While in Blood Frenzy she gains 55/65/75/85/95% Attack Speed and 24/33/42/51/60% Move Speed, and her Attacks deal (60/70/80/90/100% Attack Damage) physical damage to enemies surrounding her target.

Briar can Recast this Ability to empower her next Attack. It deals (5/20/35/50/65 + (105% Attack Damage)) + (9 + (2.5% bonus Attack Damage))missing Health physical damage and heals Briar for (5% Health) + 24/28/32/36/40% of the damage dealt.


The bite deals 10% increased damage to minions and monsters (Max 400 missing health damage).
This ability does not remove or replace Certain Death's empowered Blood Frenzy.

E.name: Chilling Scream
E.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Briar removes Blood Frenzy and gathers energy, gaining 35% damage reduction and restoring (10/11.5/13/14.5/16% Health) Health over 1 second.

Release: Briar unleashes a scream that deals up to (80/115/150/185/220 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage based on time charged, and Slows by 80% for 0.5 seconds. When fully charged, the scream Knocks Back enemies, dealing (140/215/290/365/440 + (240% bonus Attack Damage) + (240% Ability Power)) magic damage to those who hit a wall and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

R.name: Certain Death
R.tooltip:
Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone and flies to the location of the first champion it hits, marking them as her prey. On landing, she deals (150/250/350 + (130% Ability Power)) magic damage to everything nearby and causes enemies who are not her prey to Flee for 1.5 seconds. She then enters an empowered Blood Frenzy and will pursue her prey until death. During this time, she gains (20% Attack Damage) Armor and Magic Resist, 10/15/20% Lifesteal, and an additional 10/20/30% Move Speed.

When the hemolith hits it interrupts channeled Abilities. Briar has True Sight of her prey.

P.name: Headshot
P.tooltip:
Every 5 Attacks, Caitlyn fires a Headshot. Attacks while in brush count as for building towards a Headshot.

Headshots deal an additional physical damage. They have double range against enemies affected by and . Headshots against enemies hit by deal a further physical damage.

Q.name: Piltover Peacemaker
Q.tooltip:
Caitlyn revs her rifle to fire a piercing shot dealing 50/90/130/170/210 physical damage. After the bolt strikes the first target, it opens into a wider shot that deals 30/54/78/102/126 physical damage.

Enemies revealed by Yordle Snap Trap always take full damage.

W.name: Yordle Snap Trap
W.tooltip:
Caitlyn sets a trap that Roots the first champion that steps on it for 1.5 seconds and granting True Sight of them for 3 seconds. Traps last for 30/35/40/45/50 seconds, and 3/3/4/4/5 traps may be active at once. This Ability has 3/3/4/4/5 charges (26/22/18/14/10 second refresh).

Targets rooted by this Ability take an additional (35/80/125/170/215 + (30% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage from Headshot.

E.name: 90 Caliber Net
E.tooltip: Caitlyn fires a net, pushing her backwards. The net Slows the first target hit by 50% for 1 second and deals (80/130/180/230/280 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

R.name: Ace in the Hole
R.tooltip:
Caitlyn takes a moment to channel and line up the perfect shot, then she fires, dealing (300/475/650 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, but other enemy champions can intercept it. This Ability grants True Sight of the target during the channel.

Damage scales with Caitlyn's Critical Strike chance and Critical Strike Damage.

P.name: Adaptive Defenses
P.tooltip: Camille's Attacks on champions grant Shield against their damage type (Physical or Magic) for 2 seconds. This effect has a 8 second Cooldown.

Q.name: Precision Protocol
Q.tooltip:
Camille's next Attack deals an additional (20/25/30/35/40% Attack Damage) physical damage and grants her 25/30/35/40/45% Move Speed for 1 second. This ability can be Recast in the next 3.5 seconds.

If the Recast Attack hits at least 1.5 seconds after the first, the bonus damage is increased to (40/50/60/70/80% Attack Damage) and (40% ~ 100%) of the Attack's damage is converted into true damage.

This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

W.name: Tactical Sweep
W.tooltip:
Camille winds up and slices, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

Enemies hit by the outer half are Slowed by 80% decaying over 2 seconds, and they take an additional (7/7.5/8/8.5/9% + (0.025% bonus Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage. Camille restores 100% of the bonus damage dealt to champions as Health.

This Ability does 50% less damage to non-epic jungle monsters.
Max health damage is capped at 300 against jungle monsters.

E.name: Hookshot
E.tooltip:
Camille fires a hookshot that attaches to terrain, pulling her to it for 1 second and allowing this Ability to be Recast.

Recast: Camille dashes from the wall, colliding with the first enemy champion hit. Upon landing, she gains 40/45/50/55/60% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, deals (60/90/120/150/180 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to nearby enemies, and Stuns enemy champions for 0.75 seconds. Dashes towards enemy champions travel twice as far.

R.name: The Hextech Ultimatum
R.tooltip:
Camille briefly becomes Untargetable and leaps onto an enemy champion, interrupting channels and locking them into an area they cannot escape by any means for 2.5/3.25/4 seconds. Other nearby enemies are Knocked Away. Her Attacks against the trapped enemy deal an additional 4/6/8% current Health magic damage.

This Ability ends if Camille leaves the area.

P.name: Serpentine Grace
P.tooltip: Cassiopeia increases the effectiveness of all Move Speed bonuses by 6%.

Q.name: Noxious Blast
Q.tooltip: Cassiopeia blasts noxious gas, Poisoning enemies and dealing (75/110/145/180/215 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage over 3 seconds. Hitting a champion grants Cassiopeia 30/35/40/45/50% Move Speed decaying over 3 seconds.

W.name: Miasma
W.tooltip: Cassiopeia spews venom, leaving toxic clouds for 5 seconds. Enemies in the clouds take (20/25/30/35/40 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage per second, are Poisoned, Grounded, and Slowed by 40/50/60/70/80%.

E.name: Twin Fang
E.tooltip:
Cassiopeia launches deadly fangs, dealing (52 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage. If the enemy is Poisoned, they take an additional (20/45/70/95/120 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage and Cassiopeia restores (10/11.5/13/14.5/16% Ability Power) Health, reduced to (2.5/2.875/3.25/3.625/4% Ability Power) Health against lane minions and small monsters.

If this kills the target, Cassiopeia restores 40 Mana.

R.name: Petrifying Gaze
R.tooltip: Cassiopeia unleashes a petrifying gaze, dealing (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Stunning enemies facing her for 2 seconds. Enemies facing away are Slowed by 40% decaying over the same duration instead.

P.name: Carnivore
P.tooltip: Killing an enemy restores 18 Health and 4.72 Mana.

Q.name: Rupture
Q.tooltip: Cho'Gath ruptures the ground, Knocking Up enemies for 1 second, dealing (80/135/190/245/300 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage, and Slowing them by 60% for 1.5 seconds.

W.name: Feral Scream
W.tooltip: Cho'Gath roars, Silencing enemies for 1.6/1.7/1.8/1.9/2 seconds and dealing (80/130/180/230/280 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

E.name: Vorpal Spikes
E.tooltip:
Cho'Gath's next 3 Attacks launch spikes that deal (30/50/70/90/110 + (30% Ability Power)) plus 2.5/2.85/3.2/3.55/3.9% of the target's max Health magic damage and Slow by 30/35/40/45/50%, decaying over 1.5 seconds.

Feast stacks increase the width of the spikes and the max Health damage by 0.5% per stack.
Percent Health damage against monsters is replaced with 80/110/140/170/200.

R.name: Feast
R.tooltip:
Cho'Gath ravenously feeds on an enemy, dealing (300/475/650 + (50% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Health)) true damage to champions or (1200 + (50% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Health)) to minions or jungle monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains a stack, which causes him to grow in size and gain 80/120/160 max Health. Only 6 stacks can be gained from minions and non-epic jungle monsters.

Current minion and non-epic jungle monster stacks: /6
Cho'Gath gains bonus attack and Feast cast range based upon his stacks:
4.7/6.2/7.7 Attack Range per stack (max 75).
2.5 Cast Range per stack (max 25).

P.name: Hextech Munitions
P.tooltip:
Corki's Attacks and Spellblades deal 20% bonus true damage.
Attacks: (20% Attack Damage).
Critical Strikes: (20% Attack Damage).

Q.name: Phosphorus Bomb
Q.tooltip: Corki lobs a bomb, dealing (60/105/150/195/240 + (125% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. The area and champions hit are revealed for 6 seconds.

W.name: Valkyrie
W.tooltip: Corki flies over and scorches a path, burning it for 2.5 seconds. Enemies in the fire take up to (150/225/300/375/450 + (150% Ability Power) + (200% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage over the duration.

E.name: Gatling Gun
E.tooltip:
Corki fires a gatling gun in front of him, dealing (80/130/180/230/280 + (240% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage over 4 seconds and shredding up to 12/14/16/18/20 Armor and Magic Resist.

The shred lingers for 2 seconds after being hit.

R.name: Missile Barrage
R.tooltip:
Corki fires a missile that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing (90/170/250 + (85% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to surrounding enemies. Every third missile instead deals (180/340/500 + (170% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

This Ability has up to 4 charges. Basic attacks against champions reduce the time between charges by (2 + (400%)) seconds on hit.

P.name: Hemorrhage
P.tooltip:
Darius' Attacks and damaging Abilities cause the target to Hemorrhage, dealing (30% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

When an enemy reaches max stacks or is killed by , Darius gains an additional 30 Attack Damage and applies 5 Hemorrhage stacks on all Attack or damaging Ability hits for 5 seconds.

Q.name: Decimate
Q.tooltip:
Darius hefts his axe then swings it around, dealing 50/80/110/140/170 physical damage with the edge and 17.5/28/38.5/49/59.5 damage with the handle. Enemies hit with the handle do not take a Hemorrhage stack.

Darius restores 17% missing Health per enemy champion and large jungle monster hit with the edge, up to a max of 51%.

W.name: Crippling Strike
W.tooltip:
Darius' next Attack deals physical damage and Slows by 90% for 1 second.

This Ability refunds its Mana cost and reduces its Cooldown by 50% if it kills the target.

This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

E.name: Apprehend
E.tooltip:
Passive: Darius gains 20/25/30/35/40% Armor Penetration.

Active: Darius hooks with his axe, Pulling, and Knocking Up and Slowing by 40% for 1 second.

R.name: Noxian Guillotine
R.tooltip:
Darius leaps to an enemy and strikes a lethal blow, dealing (125/250/375 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) true damage. For each Hemorrhage on the target, this Ability deals an additional 20% damage, up to a max of (250/500/750 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) damage.

If this kills the target, Darius may Recast this Ability once within 20 seconds. At rank 3, this Ability has no Mana cost and kills refresh the Cooldown completely.

P.name: Moonsilver Blade
P.tooltip:
Diana gains (15% ~ 35%) Attack Speed, increased to 45/105% for 5 seconds after using an Ability.

Every third Attack cleaves nearby enemies for an additional (20 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Q.name: Crescent Strike
Q.tooltip:
Diana unleashes an arc of lunar energy, dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and marking with Moonlight for 3 seconds.

Moonlight reveals enemies that are not stealthed.

W.name: Pale Cascade
W.tooltip:
Diana creates three orbiting spheres for 5 seconds that explode on contact, each dealing (20/32/44/56/68 + (18% Ability Power)) magic damage, up to a max of (60/96/132/168/204 + (54% Ability Power)) damage.

Diana also gains (45/60/75/90/105 + (30% Ability Power) + (11% bonus Health)) Shield for the same duration. When the last sphere detonates, she gains an additional (45/60/75/90/105 + (30% Ability Power) + (11% bonus Health)) Shield and refreshes the duration.

E.name: Lunar Rush
E.tooltip: Diana becomes as the vengeful moon, dashing to an enemy and dealing (50/70/90/110/130 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. If the target is afflicted with Moonlight, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.

R.name: Moonfall
R.tooltip:
Diana Pulls In, Slows by 40/50/60%, and reveals nearby enemies for 2 seconds.

If Diana hits at least one enemy champion, she calls to the moon, dealing (200/300/400 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage plus (35/60/85 + (15% Ability Power)) for each champion pulled beyond the first, up to a max of an additional (175/300/425 + (75% Ability Power)) damage.

P.name: League of Draven
P.tooltip:
Draven gains 1 stack whenever he kills a non-champion unit or turret, catches a Spinning Axe.

Draven gains 25 gold plus 2 additional gold per stack upon killing a champion. Draven loses 50% of stacks upon death.

Total Gold Earned:
Highest Reward:

Q.name: Spinning Axe
Q.tooltip:
Draven readies a Spinning Axe, causing his next Attack to deal an additional (40/45/50/55/60 + (75/85/95/105/115% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and ricochet into the air. If Draven catches it, he readies another Spinning Axe.

Draven can hold two Spinning Axes at once.

Draven will drop any Spinning Axes if he does not attack for 6 seconds. Attacking a turret or structure will not cause Draven's Spinning Axes to richochet.

W.name: Blood Rush
W.tooltip:
Draven becomes Ghosted, gains 50/55/60/65/70% Move Speed decaying over 1.5 seconds and 20/25/30/35/40% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

When Draven catches a Spinning Axe, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.

Ghosted units can pass through other units.

E.name: Stand Aside
E.tooltip: Draven chucks a sideways axe that deals (75/110/145/180/215 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, Knocks Back, and Slows by 20/25/30/35/40% for 2 seconds.

R.name: Whirling Death
R.tooltip:
Draven hurls two massive axes that deal (200/300/400 + (110/130/150% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Upon hitting a champion or Recasting, they reverse direction and return to Draven. The axes deal 5% less damage for each enemy hit, down to a minimum of 50%.

If Whirling Death would leave an enemy champion with less health than 100% of Draven's current League of Draven stacks (), he will execute them.

Damage falloff resets after reversing direction.
Whirling Executes from League of Draven:

P.name: Goes Where He Pleases
P.tooltip:
Dr. Mundo resists the first Immobilizing effect that hits him, instead losing 4% current Health and dropping a chemical cannister nearby for 7 seconds. Moving over it reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 15 seconds and restores 4% max Health. Enemy champions moving over the cannister destroy it.

Dr. Mundo regenerates (0.4% ~ 0.65%) max Health every 5 seconds.

Q.name: Infected Bonesaw
Q.tooltip:
Dr. Mundo hurls his bonesaw, dealing 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% current Health magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.

If the bonesaw hits a champion or monster, Dr. Mundo restores 50/60/70/80/90 Health. If it hits a non-champion or non-monster, Dr. Mundo instead restores 25/30/35/40/45 Health.

Deals a minimum of 80/130/180/230/280 magic damage, and a maximum of 250/325/400/475/550 magic damage to jungle monsters.

W.name: Heart Zapper
W.tooltip:
Dr. Mundo charges up a defibrilator, dealing 20/35/50/65/80 magic damage each second for up to 3 seconds to nearby enemies. Additionally he stores (80% ~ 95%) of damage taken for the first 0.75 seconds and 25% for the remaining duration as gray health and can Recast.

Recast: Detonate the defibrilator, dealing (20/35/50/65/80 + (7% bonus Health)) magic damage to nearby enemies. If this hits at least one champion, Dr. Mundo restores 100% of gray health, otherwise he instead restores 50% of gray health.

E.name: Blunt Force Trauma
E.tooltip:
Passive: Dr Mundo gains (2/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2% Health) Attack Damage.

Active: Dr Mundo violently swings his "medical" bag, causing his next Attack to deal an additional (5/15/25/35/45 + (5% bonus Health)) physical damage, increased by up to 40% based on his missing Health. If the enemy is killed, Mundo swats them away, dealing (5/15/25/35/45 + (5% bonus Health)) physical damage to enemies they pass through.

The bonuses from the passive reach their maximum at 70% missing Health.
Deals 140% damage to minions. Deals 140% damage to jungle monsters.

R.name: Maximum Dosage
R.tooltip:
Dr. Mundo pumps himself with chemicals, gaining 15/20/25% of his missing Health as max Health, 15/25/35% Move Speed, and regenerating 20/40/60% max Health over 10 seconds.

At Rank 3, both healing effects are increased by an additional 5% per nearby enemy champion.

P.name: Z-Drive Resonance
P.tooltip: Every third Attack or damaging Ability on the same target deals an additional (30 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. If the target is a champion, Ekko gains 80% Move Speed for 3 seconds. This effect can't trigger on the same enemy more than once every 4 seconds.

Q.name: Timewinder
Q.tooltip: Ekko throws a device dealing (80/95/110/125/140 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage. On hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, it expands into a field that Slows enemies inside by 40/45/50/55/60%. After it expands, Ekko recalls it, dealing (40/65/90/115/140 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage.

W.name: Parallel Convergence
W.tooltip:
Passive: Ekko's Attacks against enemies below 30% Health deal (3% + (0.03% Ability Power)) missing Health magic damage.

Active: Ekko launches a chronosphere lasting 1.5 seconds after a delay that Slows enemies inside by 40%. If Ekko enters the sphere, he detonates it, Stunning for 2.25 seconds and gaining (100/120/140/160/180 + (150% Ability Power)) Shield.

Bonus Attack damage deals a min of 15 and a max of 150 damage against minions and monsters.

E.name: Phase Dive
E.tooltip:
Ekko dashes and empowers his next Attack to have bonus range, teleport him to his target, and deal an additional (50/75/100/125/150 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Ekko can use any of his other Abilities during the dash.

R.name: Chronobreak
R.tooltip:
Ekko turns back time, entering Stasis while teleporting to where he was 4 seconds ago and dealing (200/350/500 + (175% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies. In addition, Ekko restores (100/150/200 + (60% Ability Power)) Health, increased by 3% for each 1% Health he lost in last 4 seconds.

Will detonate the chronosphere from Parallel Convergence [] if Ekko passed through it.
Units in Stasis cannot move or act, and are Invulnerable and Untargetable.

P.name: Spider Queen
P.tooltip:
Elise begins the game with a point in her Ultimate, allowing her to shapeshift between Human Form and Spider Form.

Human Form: Elise's Ability hits grant her a dormant Spiderling, up to .

Spider Form: Attacks deal an additional magic damage and restore Health.

Q.name: Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite
Q.tooltip:
Human Form: Elise injects neurotoxin, dealing 40/70/100/130/160 plus (4% + (0.03% Ability Power)) current Health magic damage.

Human Form and Spider Form percent Health damage is capped at (65/85/105/125/145 + (90% Ability Power)) against monsters.

W.name: Volatile Spiderling / Skittering Frenzy
W.tooltip: Human Form: Elise summons an explosive spider that moves to a location and explodes when it nears an enemy or after 3 seconds. The spider deals magic damage.

E.name: Cocoon / Rappel
E.tooltip: Human Form: Elise fires a cocoon, Stunning and revealing the first enemy hit for 1.6/1.8/2/2.2/2.4 seconds.

R.name: Spider Form
R.tooltip: Human Form: Elise transforms into a menacing spider, becoming melee, gaining access to Spider Form Abilities and summons all dormant Spiderlings.

P.name: Demon Shade
P.tooltip:
Evelynn enshrouds herself in her Demon Shade after 4 seconds of not Attacking or using Abilities. Demon Shade restores (15 ~ 150) Health per second while below (250 + (250% Ability Power)) Health. From level 6 onward, it also grants Camouflage.

Taking damage from champions or towers removes Demon Shade for 1.5 seconds.

Q.name: Hate Spike
Q.tooltip:
Evelynn strikes with her Lasher, dealing (25/30/35/40/45 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit and causing Evelynn's next 3 Attacks or Abilities on that unit to deal an additional (15/25/35/45/55 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage. Evelynn can Recast this Ability up to 3 times.

Recast: Evelynn fires spikes through the nearest enemy, dealing (25/30/35/40/45 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage to all enemies hit.

The spikes prioritizes the target Evelynn is attacking.

W.name: Allure
W.tooltip:
Evelynn marks a champion or monster for 5 seconds. If Evelynn hits the target with an Attack or Ability, she will expunge the mark, refund its cost, and Slow the target by 45% for 0.75 seconds.

If the mark lasts at least 2.5 seconds, expunging it has extra effects:Against champions: Charms them for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2/2.25 second(s) and removes 35/37.5/40/42.5/45% Magic Resist for 4 seconds.Against monsters: Charms them for 3/3.25/3.5/3.75/4 seconds and deals (250/300/350/400/450 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Using this Ability does not remove Evelynn from Demon Shade.

E.name: Whiplash
E.tooltip:
Evelynn whips an enemy, dealing 60/90/120/150/180 plus (3% + (0.01% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage. Evelynn gains 30/35/40/45/50% Move Speed for 2 seconds.

Entering Demon Shade refreshes this Ability's cooldown and empowers it. When this Ability is empowered, Evelynn dashes to the target and deals 80/120/160/200/240 plus (4% + (0.02% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage to her target and everyone she passes through instead.

This Ability applies On-Hit Effects to the targeted enemy.

R.name: Last Caress
R.tooltip:
Evelynn unleashes her demonic energy, dealing heavy damage, becoming Untargetable and teleporting backwards. She deals (125/250/375 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage, increased to (300/600/900 + (180% Ability Power)) against enemies below 30% Health. Upon cast, set Demon Shade to a 1.25 second cooldown.

Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them.

P.name: Rising Spell Force
P.tooltip: Ezreal's Ability hits grant him 10% Attack Speed for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

Q.name: Mystic Shot
Q.tooltip:
Ezreal fires a bolt of energy, dealing (20/45/70/95/120 + (130% Attack Damage) + (40% Ability Power)) physical damage to the first enemy hit and reducing his Ability Cooldowns by 1.5 seconds.

This Ability applies On-Hit effects.

W.name: Essence Flux
W.tooltip: Ezreal fires a magical orb that sticks to the first champion, structure, or epic jungle monster hit for 4 seconds. If Ezreal hits that target with an Attack or Ability, it detonates, dealing (80/135/190/245/300 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage. Detonating with an Ability refunds the Mana cost of that Ability plus 60 Mana.

E.name: Arcane Shift
E.tooltip: Ezreal teleports then fires a bolt at the nearest enemy, dealing (80/130/180/230/280 + (60% bonus Attack Damage) + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage. The bolt prioritizes enemies affected by Essence Flux.

R.name: Trueshot Barrage
R.tooltip: Ezreal fires a massive energy arc that deals (350/550/750 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (110% Ability Power)) magic damage. Damage to minions and non-epic jungle monsters is reduced to (150/225/300 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (110% Ability Power)) magic damage.

P.name: A Harmless Scarecrow
P.tooltip: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by Scarecrow Effigies. When discovered by enemies, Effigies briefly impersonate Fiddlesticks. If Fiddlesticks does not move for 2 seconds, he will impersonate an Effigy. At level six Effigies reveal nearby wards for 6 seconds.

Q.name: Terrify
Q.tooltip:
Passive: While unseen and out of combat or impersonating an Effigy, damaging an enemy with an ability Fears them for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 second(s).

Active: Fear an enemy for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 second(s) and deal (4/4.5/5/5.5/6% + (0.03% Ability Power)) current Health magic damage. If the target has recently been Feared by Fiddlesticks, instead deal (8/9/10/11/12% + (0.06% Ability Power)) current Health magic damage.


Deals a minimum of 40/60/80/100/120 magic damage, or 80/120/160/200/240 magic damage if the target has been recently Feared by Fiddlesticks.
Deals a maximum of 400 magic damage to minions and jungle monsters.

W.name: Bountiful Harvest
W.tooltip:
Fiddlesticks channels and drains the souls of nearby enemies, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage per second for 2 seconds, plus 12/14.5/17/19.5/22% missing Health magic damage at the end. Fiddlesticks restores 25/32.5/40/47.5/55% of damage as Health.

If Fiddlesticks ends the channel without interruption, the remaining Cooldown is reduced by 60%.


Healing based on pre-mitigation damage.
Against monsters, this Ability deals 135% damage and heals 45% of damage done.
Against minions, this Ability deals 50% damage and heals 15% of damage done.

E.name: Reap
E.tooltip: Fiddlesticks unleashes dark magic, dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 30/35/40/45/50% for 1.25 seconds. Enemies in the center are also Silenced for the duration.

R.name: Crowstorm
R.tooltip: Fiddlesticks channels for 1.5 seconds, then teleports and unleashes a murder of crows, dealing (750/1250/1750 + (250% Ability Power)) magic damage over 5 seconds.

P.name: Duelist's Dance
P.tooltip:
Fiora identifies Vitals on enemy champions. Hitting this Vital with an Attack or Ability deals an additional (3% + (0.04% bonus Attack Damage)) max Health true damage, grants Fiora Move Speed decaying over 2 seconds, and restores (35 ~ 100) Health.

Fiora reveals a new Vital after 15 seconds or after striking one.

Q.name: Lunge
Q.tooltip:
Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs the closest enemy, ward, or structure, dealing 70/80/90/100/110 physical damage. The strike will prioritize Vitals and enemies it will kill.

If Fiora strikes an enemy, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 50%.

The strike applies On-Hit Effects.

W.name: Riposte
W.tooltip: Fiora parries all incoming damage, disables, and negative effects for 0.75 seconds, then stabs. The stab deals (110/150/190/230/270 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first champion hit and Slows Move Speed by 50% and Attack Speed by 25% for 2 seconds. If Fiora parries an Immobilizing effect, the stabbed enemy is Stunned rather than Slowed.

E.name: Bladework
E.tooltip: Fiora gains 50/60/70/80/90% Attack Speed for her next two Attacks. The first Attack Slows by 30% for 1 second. The second Attack always critically strikes for 160/170/180/190/200% damage.

R.name: Grand Challenge
R.tooltip:
Passive: Duelist's Dance Move Speed bonus is increased to 30/40/50%.

Active: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on a champion for a max of max Health true damage and gains Duelist's Dance's Move Speed bonus while near the target.

If Fiora strikes all four Vitals within 8 seconds or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora restores (75/100/125 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) Health per second to surrounding allied champions for 5 seconds.

P.name: Nimble Fighter
P.tooltip: Fizz is Ghosted and takes (4 + (1% Ability Power)) reduced damage from all sources.

Q.name: Urchin Strike
Q.tooltip:
Fizz dashes through an enemy, dealing (100% Attack Damage) physical damage plus (10/25/40/55/70 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage.

This Ability applies On-Hit effects.

W.name: Seastone Trident
W.tooltip:
Passive: Fizz's Attacks cause his enemies to bleed, dealing (30/45/60/75/90 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage over 3 seconds.

Active: Fizz's next Attack deals an additional (50/75/100/125/150 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage. If this Attack kills its target, Fizz refunds 30/40/50/60/70 Mana and reduces the cooldown of this Ability to 1 second. If it does not kill, Fizz's Attacks deal an additional (20/25/30/35/40 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage for 5 seconds.

Attacks deal 90 bonus damage to jungle monsters.
Attacks deal 50% damage to structures.

E.name: Playful / Trickster
E.tooltip:
Fizz hops onto his trident, becoming Untargetable for 0.75 seconds, after which he deals (80/130/180/230/280 + (95% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies and Slows them by 40/45/50/55/60% for 2 seconds.

Fizz can Recast this Ability while Untargetable to dash again, which ends the effect early, deals damage in a smaller area, and doesn't Slow.

R.name: Chum the Waters
R.tooltip:
Fizz launches a fish that attaches to the first champion hit. The victim is afflicted with True Sight and Slowed by between 40% to 80% based on how far the fish travelled before attaching.

After 2 seconds a shark erupts on the target, Knocking Up the target with the fish for 1 second, Knocking Back everything else, and dealing between (180/300/420 + (60% Ability Power)) to (270/450/630 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage based on how far the fish travelled before attaching.

P.name: Colossal Smash
P.tooltip:
Galio's Attacks have increased attack speed and deal ((100% Attack Damage) + (40% Ability Power) + (60% bonus Magic Resist)) magic damage to surrounding enemies.

This effect's cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds when Galio hits an enemy champion or epic monster with an ability, once per cast.

Q.name: Winds of War
Q.tooltip:
Galio fires two windblasts that deal (70/105/140/175/210 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage each. When the windblasts meet, they combine into a tornado that deals (8 + (4% Ability Power))max Health magic damage over 2 seconds.

Percent Health damage deals a max of 200 damage to jungle monsters.

W.name: Shield of Durand
W.tooltip:
Passive: Galio gains a (7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5% Health) Magic Shield after not taking damage for (12 ~ 8) seconds.

Begin Charging: Galio reduces incoming magic damage by (25/30/35/40/45% + (0.04% Ability Power) + (0.08% bonus Magic Resist) + (0.01% bonus Health)) and incoming physical damage by (12.5/15/17.5/20/22.5% + (0.02% Ability Power) + (0.04% bonus Magic Resist) + (0.005% bonus Health)) and Slows himself by 15%.

Release: Galio Taunts enemy champions for between 0.5 to 1.5 seconds, deals between (20/30/40/50/60 + (30% Ability Power)) and (60/90/120/150/180 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage, and refreshes the damage reduction for 2 seconds. Taunt duration, damage, and range increase with charge time.

E.name: Justice Punch
E.tooltip:
Galio lunges forward with a mighty blow, Knocking Up for 0.75 seconds and dealing (100/135/170/205/240 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first champion hit. Other enemies in the way take (80/108/136/164/192 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Galio's dash stops on hitting terrain.

R.name: Hero's Entrance
R.tooltip:
Galio designates an allied champion's position as his landing spot, granting all allied champions in the area Shield of Durand's passive Shield for 5 seconds. Galio then flies to his landing zone.

When Galio lands, he Knocks Up for 0.75 seconds and deals (150/250/350 + (70% Ability Power) + (100% bonus Magic Resist)) magic damage.

P.name: Trial by Fire
P.tooltip:
Gangplank's melee Attacks ignite the target, dealing an additional (100% bonus Attack Damage) true damage over 2.5 seconds and granting Gangplank (15% ~ 30%) Move Speed for 2 seconds.

Destroying a Powder Keg refreshes this Cooldown and grants Gangplank the same Move Speed.

Q.name: Parrrley
Q.tooltip: The shot applies On-Hit effects (other than Trial by Fire) and can critically strike for (10/40/70/100/130 + (100% Attack Damage)) physical damage.

W.name: Remove Scurvy
W.tooltip: Gangplank consumes a large amount of citrus fruit, removing all Disabling effects and restoring (45/70/95/120/145 + (90% Ability Power)) plus 13% missing Health.

E.name: Powder Keg
E.tooltip:
Gangplank places a powder keg that can be attacked by Gangplank and enemy champions for 25 seconds. When an enemy destroys it, the keg is defused. When Gangplank destroys it, it explodes, Slowing by 40/50/60/70/80% for 2 seconds and dealing the Attack's damage, ignoring 40% Armor. Champions take an additional 75/95/115/135/155 physical damage.

Keg health decays every 0.5 seconds. Keg explosions detonate other kegs with overlapping blast zones, but don't deal damage to the same target more than once. Keg explosions triggered by Parrrley will grant the bonus gold for targets killed.

Keg decay rate increases at level 7 and 13.

R.name: Cannon Barrage
R.tooltip:
Gangplank signals his ship to fire 12 waves of cannonballs anywhere on the map over 8 seconds. Each wave Slows by 30% for 0.5 seconds and deals (40/70/100 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage. Maximum damage: (480/840/1200 + (120% Ability Power))

This Ability can be upgraded in the shop via Parrrley.

Fire at Will: Fires 6 additional waves of cannonballs.
Death's Daughter: Fires a Mega-Cannonball that deals (120/210/300 + (30% Ability Power)) true damage and Slows by 75% for 1 second.
Raise Morale: Allies inside Cannon Barrage gain 40% Move Speed for 2 seconds.

P.name: Perseverance
P.tooltip: Garen regenerates (150% ~ 250%) max Health every 5 seconds if he has not been damaged or hit with enemy Abilities in the last 8 seconds.

Q.name: Decisive Strike
Q.tooltip:
Garen removes all Slowing effects on him and gains 35% Move Speed for 1.4/1.95/2.5/3.05/3.6 second(s).

His next Attack Silences for 1.5 seconds and does (30/60/90/120/150 + (150% Attack Damage)) physical damage.

The empowered Attack expires after 4.5 seconds.
This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

W.name: Courage
W.tooltip:
Passive: Garen has bonus Armor and bonus Magic Resist. Killing units permanently grants 0.2 resists, up to a max of 30.

Active: Garen steels his courage for 4 seconds, reducing incoming damage by 25/29/33/37/41%. He also gains (65/85/105/125/145 + (18% bonus Health)) Shield and 60% Tenacity for 0.75 seconds.

E.name: Judgment
E.tooltip:
Garen rapidly spins his sword for 3 seconds, dealing (4/7/10/13/16 + (40/43/46/49/52% Attack Damage)) physical damage times over the duration. The nearest enemy takes 25% increased damage. Champions hit by 6 strikes lose 25% Armor for 6 seconds.

Recast: Garen ends this Ability early.

Gains one strike from every 25% Attack Speed from items and levels.
Can critically strike for (4/7/10/13/16 + (40/43/46/49/52% Attack Damage)) physical damage.

R.name: Demacian Justice
R.tooltip: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to slay his enemy, dealing 125/200/275 plus 25/30/35% missing Health true damage.

P.name: Rage Gene
P.tooltip:
Gnar generates Rage by dealing and receiving damage. At max Rage his next Ability transforms him into Mega Gnar for 15 seconds.

Mini Gnar: Gain Move Speed, (5.5% ~ 99%) Attack Speed, and (0 ~ 100) Attack Range.

Mega Gnar: Gain max Health, (3.5 ~ 54.5) Armor, (3.5 ~ 63) Magic Resist, and (6 ~ 48.5) Attack Damage.

Q.name: Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss
Q.tooltip:
Mini Gnar: Gnar throws a boomerang that deals physical damage and Slows by for seconds. The boomerang returns after hitting an enemy, dealing reduced damage to subsequent targets. Each enemy can only be hit once. Catching the boomerang reduces its Cooldown by.

Deals 50% damage to enemies beyond the first.

W.name: Hyper / Wallop
W.tooltip:
Mini Gnar Passive: Every third Attack or Ability on the same enemy deals an additional plus max Health magic damage and grants Move Speed decaying over seconds.

Gnar also gains the Move Speed when he leaves Mega Gnar form.
Deals a max of 300 magic damage against jungle monsters.

E.name: Hop / Crunch
E.tooltip: Mini Gnar: Gnar leaps, gaining Attack Speed for seconds. If Gnar lands on a unit he will bounce off it, traveling further. Bouncing off an enemy deals physical damage and briefly Slows by.

R.name: GNAR!
R.tooltip:
Mini Gnar Passive: Increase Hyper's Move Speed.

Mega Gnar: Gnar tosses nearby enemies, dealing (200/300/400 + (100% Ability Power) + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, Knocking Back, and Slowing them by 45% for 1.25/1.5/1.75 seconds. Enemies that hit a wall instead take (200/300/400 + (100% Ability Power) + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and are Stunned.

After transforming to Mini Gnar, Gnar cannot gain Rage for 15 seconds.

P.name: Happy Hour
P.tooltip: When Gragas uses an Ability, Gragas takes a drink, restoring (5.5% Health) Health.

Q.name: Barrel Roll
Q.tooltip:
Gragas rolls a cask that explodes after 4 seconds, dealing between (80/120/160/200/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and (120/180/240/300/360 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing for between 40/45/50/55/60 and 60/67.5/75/82.5/90% for 2 seconds. The damage and Slow increase with time the cask spent before exploding.

Gragas can Recast to detonate the cask early.

Deals 70% damage to minions.

W.name: Drunken Rage
W.tooltip:
Gragas samples his brew, reducing incoming damage by (10/14/18/22/26% + (0.04% Ability Power)) for 2.5 seconds and empowering his next Attack to deal an additional (20/50/80/110/140 + (70% Ability Power)) plus 7% max Health magic damage to the target and surrounding enemies.

Max Health damage is capped at 300 versus jungle monsters.
Deals 50% damage to structures.

E.name: Body Slam
E.tooltip:
Gragas charges forward, colliding with the first enemy, Knocking Up nearby enemies for 1 second and dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage to them.

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 40% if Gragas collides with an enemy.

R.name: Explosive Cask
R.tooltip:
Gragas hurls his cask, dealing (200/300/400 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Knocking Away enemies from the impact zone.

Enemies cannot be Knocked over walls with this Ability.

P.name: New Destiny
P.tooltip:
Graves' Attacks have unique properties:
It can only fire two Shells before he must reload. Attack Speed reduces reload time slightly, but reduces time between shots dramatically.Each Attack fires 4 bullets. The first bullet on a target deals physical damage, and subsequent bullets deal each. Instead of normal Critical effects, Critical strikes fire 6 bullets and deal more damage. Structures take 25% reduced damage.Bullets stop on the first unit hit. Non-champions struck by multiple bullets are Knocked Back.

Q.name: End of the Line
Q.tooltip: Graves fires a powder round dealing (50/75/100/125/150 + (55% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. After 1 second or after colliding with terrain, it detonates, dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (45/60/75/90/105% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage along the travel path again and to enemies near the blast.

W.name: Smoke Screen
W.tooltip: Graves creates a cloud of black smoke for 4 seconds, Slowing enemies inside by 50% and blocking their vision outside the area. The initial impact deals (60/110/160/210/260 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage.

E.name: Quickdraw
E.tooltip:
Graves dashes and reloads one Shell into his shotgun. He also gains a stack for 4 seconds (max 8 stacks) or two stacks if he dashes towards an enemy champion. Stacks grant him 7/10/13/16/19 Armor and 3.5/5/6.5/8/9.5 Magic Resist. Stacks are refreshed when damaging a non-minion.

Each bullet hit from Graves' Attacks reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

R.name: Collateral Damage
R.tooltip: Graves fires an explosive cartridge, blasting himself backwards. The cartridge deals (275/425/575 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit. After hitting an enemy champion or reaching the end of its range, the cartridge explodes outward, dealing (200/320/440 + (120% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

P.name: A Thousand Cuts
P.tooltip: Gwen's Attacks deal an additional (1% + (0.006% Ability Power)) Max Health magic damage on hit. Gwen recovers Health equal to 67% of the damage this Ability deals to champions, up to a maximum of (7% Ability Power).

Q.name: Snip Snip!
Q.tooltip:
Passive: Gwen gains 1 stack when she hits an enemy with an attack (max 4, lasts 6 seconds).

Active: Consumes stacks. Gwen snips once for (10/14/18/22/26 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage, snips again for each ammo consumed, and then snips a final time for (60/85/110/135/160 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage.

The center of each strikes converts 50% of the damage into true damage instead and applies A Thousand Cuts to enemies hit.

Deals 80% damage to minions.
Minions below 20% health take 1000% bonus damage instead of reduced damage.

Max damage: , plus percent health from A Thousand Cuts.

W.name: Hallowed Mist
W.tooltip:
Gwen summons the Hallowed Mist, making her Untargetable to all enemies (except towers) outside the zone for 4 seconds or until she leaves it. While in the Mist, Gwen gains (22/24/26/28/30 + (7% Ability Power)) Armor and Magic Resist.

Gwen can Recast this Ability once to call the Mist to her. This will automatically Recast the first time Gwen attempts to leave the zone.

E.name: Skip 'n Slash
E.tooltip:
Gwen dashes and empowers her Attacks for 4 seconds.

Empowered Attacks gain 30/42.5/55/67.5/80% Attack Speed, (15 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit, 75 range, and the first one to hit an enemy refunds 25/35/45/55/65% of this Ability's Cooldown.

R.name: Needlework
R.tooltip:
First Cast: Hurl a needle that deals (30/50/70 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage, Slows by 40/50/60% for 1.5 seconds, and applies A Thousand Cuts to all enemies hit. Gwen can Recast this ability up to 2 additional times within 6 seconds (1s cooldown between casts).

Second Cast: Fire three needles to deal (90/150/210 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage
Third Cast: Fire five needles to deal (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage

Subsequent needle hits on the same unit Slow by 15/20/25% instead.
Max damage: (270/450/630 + (90% Ability Power)), plus max health damage from A Thousand Cuts.

P.name: Warpath
P.tooltip: Hecarim gains Attack Damage, increasing based on level.

Q.name: Rampage
Q.tooltip:
Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies for (60/90/120/150/180 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. If this Ability hits, he gains a stack that decreases its Cooldown by 0.75 seconds and increases its damage by (3 + (3% bonus Attack Damage))for 8 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.


Deals a base of (36/54/72/90/108 + (54% bonus Attack Damage)) damage to minions.

W.name: Spirit of Dread
W.tooltip:
Hecarim deals (80/120/160/200/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage over 4 seconds to nearby enemies.

Hecarim gains 5/10/15/20/25 Armor and Magic Resist and heals for 25% of damage nearby enemies take from Hecarim and 12.5% of damage taken from his allies.

Hecarim cannot heal more than 120/150/180/210/240 Health from minions or jungle monsters.

E.name: Devastating Charge
E.tooltip:
Hecarim becomes Ghosted and gains 25% Move Speed increasing to 65% over 4 seconds. His next Attack Knocks Back and deals between (30/45/60/75/90 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) and (60/90/120/150/180 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Knock Back distance and damage scales with distance travelled during this Ability.

Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.
The remaining duration of this Ability is paused during Onslaught of Shadows.
This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

R.name: Onslaught of Shadows
R.tooltip:
Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing (150/250/350 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. Hecarim unleashes a shockwave at the end of the charge that Fears for between 0.75 to 1.5 seconds, increased by charge distance.

Hecarim will move to the targeted location, but the riders always move the full distance.

P.name: Hextech Affinity
P.tooltip: Heimerdinger gains 20% Move Speed near his Turrets and ally towers.

Q.name: H-28 G Evolution Turret
Q.tooltip:
Heimerdinger constructs a Turret that attacks nearby enemies. Heimerdinger can have 3 turrets active at once. Turrets slowly build up charge. At max charge, they fire a stronger attack.

If Heimerdinger gets too far away, his Turrets will deactivate after 8 seconds.

This Ability has 3 charges.

Turrets prioritize attacking enemies Heimerdinger has recently damaged and enemies attacking Heimerdinger.

Turret Stats:
Health
(7/11/15/19/23 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per regular shot
(40/60/80/100/120 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage per charged shot

W.name: Hextech Micro-Rockets
W.tooltip:
Heimerdinger unleashes a barrage of 5 rockets that deal (50/75/100/125/150 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit. Additional rocket hits deal reduced damage.

Max Damage: (90/135/180/225/270 + (103% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Nearby Turrets gain 20% charge per rocket that hits a champion.

Enemies hit by multiple rockets take (10/15/20/25/30 + (12% Ability Power)) magic damage beyond the first. Minions instead take (30/45/60/75/90 + (36% Ability Power)) magic damage beyond the first

E.name: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade
E.tooltip:
Heimerdinger hurls a grenade that deals (60/100/140/180/220 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage in an area and Slows by 35% for 2 seconds. Enemies in the center are also Stunned for 1.5 seconds.

Hitting a champion fully charges nearby Turrets.

R.name: UPGRADE!!!
R.tooltip:
Heimerdinger upgrades his next non-ultimate Ability.
