H-28Q Apex Turret: Place an upgraded Turret for 8 seconds that doesn't count towards Heimerdinger's max turrets, deals (80/100/120 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per shot and (100/140/180 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage per charged shot. Its attacks deal damage in an area, Slow by 25% for 2 seconds, and it is immune to crowd control.

Hextech Rocket Swarm: Fires 4 waves of rockets that each deal (135/180/225 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage. Champions and jungle monsters hit by additional rockets take reduced damage, and minions take increased damage. Max Damage: (503/697.5/892 + (183% Ability Power)) magic damage.

CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Throws a bouncing grenade that discharges three times, dealing (100/200/300 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. The Stun and Slow areas are larger.

Recast: Cancel this Ability.

The upgraded Ability has no cost.
Upgraded rockets deal 2000% damage to minions.

Apex Turret Stats:
(725 + (50% Ability Power)) Health
30 Armor
30 Magic Resist
(80/100/120 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per regular shot
(100/140/180 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage per charged shot

P.name: Signature of the Visionary
P.tooltip:
Hwei's damaging Abilities against enemy champions mark them for 4 seconds.

Hitting marked enemies with a second damaging Ability creates an explosion underneath them dealing (35% Ability Power) magic damage to all enemies in range.

Q.name: Subject: Disaster
Q.tooltip:
Hwei paints visions of disaster that deal large damage to enemies.

Devastating Fire
Hwei launches a blazing fast fireball that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing (50/80/110/140/170 + (80% Ability Power)) plus 3/4/5/6/7% max health magic damage.

Severing Bolt
Hwei strikes over far distances with a delayed lightning bolt, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage. Hitting an Isolated or Immobilized target increases the damage up to (120/201.875/302.5/421.875/560 + (60/71.25/82.5/93.75/105% Ability Power)) magic damage, based on the target's missing health.

Molten Fissure
Hwei unleashes a path of eruptions, dealing (20/35/50/65/80 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage in an area and leaving behind pools of lava that Slow enemies by and deal (20/35/50/65/80 + (24% Ability Power)) magic damage per second for seconds.

W.name: Subject: Serenity
W.tooltip:
Hwei paints visions of serenity that provide utility for himself and allied champions.

Fleeting Current
Hwei launches a current of swift waters in a line that grants allies (30/32.5/35/37.5/40% + (0.03% Ability Power)) Move Speed.

Pool of Reflection
Hwei forms a protective pool that grants (100/140/180/220/260 + (60% Ability Power)) Shields over time to allied champions inside reduced by for allies.

Stirring Lights
Hwei creates three swirling lights that empower his next three Abilities or Attacks to deal an additional (20/30/40/50/60 + (15% Ability Power)) magic damage and restore 45/50/55/60/65 Mana each.

E.name: Subject: Torment
E.tooltip:
Hwei paints visions of torment that control enemies.

Grim Visage
Hwei launches a terrifying face that causes the first enemy hit to Flee for 1/1.125/1.25/1.375/1.5 second(s) and take (70/110/150/190/230 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Gaze of the Abyss
Hwei forms an eye that lingers and provides vision locking onto the first enemy champion that enters and launching a homing missile that Roots the first enemy hit for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 seconds dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Crushing Maw
Hwei paints a set of jaws at a target location that Drags enemies to the center dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing enemies caught by 40/47.5/55/62.5/70% decaying over 1.25 seconds.

R.name: Spiraling Despair
R.tooltip:
Hwei launches a vision of pure despair that sticks to an enemy champion for 3 seconds. The vision expands over time applying a Slow to enemies for 10% stacking every 0.25 seconds, and dealing (10/20/30 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second.

Upon completion, the vision shatters, dealing (200/325/450 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Maximum damage possible is (95% Ability Power) magic damage.

P.name: Prophet of an Elder God
P.tooltip:
Illaoi draws the presence of her god, spawning a Tentacle on nearby terrain if no other Tentacles are nearby ((18 ~ 7) second cooldown). Tentacles will not attack on their own, but can be made to Slam by Illaoi's Abilities.

Slam deals physical damage. Hitting at least one enemy champion restores 5% missing Health to Illaoi.

Q.name: Tentacle Smash
Q.tooltip:
Passive: Slam damage is increased by (currently physical damage).

Active: Illaoi swings her idol, causing a Tentacle to Slam forward.

W.name: Harsh Lesson
W.tooltip:
Illaoi's next Attack causes her to leap at the target, dealing an additional (3/3.5/4/4.5/5% + (0.035% Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage. When she strikes, nearby Tentacles will Slam at the target.

The percent Health damage does a minimum of 20/30/40/50/60. Against jungle monsters the damage is capped at 300.
This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

E.name: Test of Spirit
E.tooltip:
Illaoi pulls the spirit from an enemy champion for 7 seconds. The spirit can be damaged like a champion, with (25/30/35/40/45% + (0.08% Attack Damage)) of that damage echoing to its owner.

If the spirit dies or the target leaves its range, the target becomes marked for 4 seconds and is Slowed by 80% for 1.5 seconds. Marked enemies spawn Tentacles if possible.

Tentacles will automatically Slam at spirits and marked enemies once every 3 seconds.

Marked enemies are revealed for a short time.

R.name: Leap of Faith
R.tooltip:
Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing (150/250/350 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to nearby enemies and spawning a Tentacle for each enemy champion hit.

For the next 8 seconds, Tentacles are untargetable and Slam 50% faster, and Harsh Lesson has a second cooldown.

Spirits from Test Of Spirit also generate a Tentacle if hit by this ability.

P.name: Ionian Fervor
P.tooltip:
Irelia gains a stack for 6 seconds when she hits an enemy with an Ability (max 4). She gains (10 ~ 25)Attack Speed per stack, and at max stacks her Attacks deal an additional (20% bonus Attack Damage) magic damage.

Attacking a champion, structure, or large monster refreshes the duration of the stacks. Irelia gains a stack for each champion hit, or if she hits at least one non-champion enemy.

Q.name: Bladesurge
Q.tooltip:
Irelia dashes to an enemy, dealing (5/25/45/65/85 + (80% Attack Damage)) physical damage and restoring (9/10/11/12/13% Attack Damage) Health to herself. If the enemy dies or was Unsteady, the Cooldown is refreshed.

Deals (55/75/95/115/135 + (80% Attack Damage)) damage to minions.

This ability applies On-Hit Effects.

W.name: Defiant Dance
W.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Irelia enters a defensive stance for up to 1.5 seconds, becoming unable to act but reducing physical damage taken by (8% Ability Power)and magic damage taken by (4% Ability Power).

Release: Irelia lashes out with her blades, dealing (10/20/30/40/50 + (40% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage increased up to (30/60/90/120/150 + (120% Attack Damage) + (150% Ability Power)) based on charge time.

The Release will happen automatically at the end of the Charge and cannot be interrupted. Reaches max damage increase after 0.75 seconds.

E.name: Flawless Duet
E.tooltip:
Irelia throws a blade into the ground and can Recast for up to 3.5 seconds.

Recast: Irelia throws a second blade, then they fly towards each other Stunning for 0.75 seconds and dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. Champions and large jungle monsters become Unsteady for 5 seconds.

Irelia will automatically Recast at her location after 3.5 seconds.

R.name: Vanguard's Edge
R.tooltip:
Irelia launches a barrage of blades, dealing (125/200/275 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and making champions and large jungle monsters Unsteady for 5 seconds. The barrage explodes into a cage around the first champion hit for 2.5 seconds. The cage deals (125/200/275 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 90% for 1.5 seconds.

When the barrage explodes, surrounding enemies are also hit.

P.name: Friend of the Forest
P.tooltip:
Ivern will not hurt non-epic monsters. Instead, Ivern can right click a monster to grow a Grove that costs 15 Health and 20 Mana.

Groves: Grow over 40 second(s) Once fully grown, Ivern can harvest them, freeing the camp and earning gold and experience Ivern can also Smite the Groves to instantly grow and free the camp, earning gold and experience

Q.name: Rootcaller
Q.tooltip:
Ivern conjures a vine dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and Rooting the first enemy hit for 1.6/1.7/1.8/1.9/2 seconds. Allies that Attack a Rooted enemy dash into Attack Range.

Recast: Ivern dashes directly onto the Rooted enemy.

Hitting non-epic monsters reduces Rootcaller's cooldown by 50%.

W.name: Brushmaker
W.tooltip:
Passive: While in brush and for 3 seconds after leaving, Ivern's Attacks deal an additional (20/27.5/35/42.5/50 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage. Nearby allies will gain this effect for 1.5 seconds and deal (10/15/20/25/30 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Active: Ivern grows a patch of Brush, revealing the area for 8 seconds. The Brush persists until Ivern's team loses vision within it, or up to 45 seconds.

E.name: Triggerseed
E.tooltip:
Ivern grants (75/115/155/195/235 + (50% Ability Power)) Shield to an ally champion or Daisy. After 2 seconds, it bursts, dealing (70/90/110/130/150 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing enemies by 40/45/50/55/60% for 2 seconds.

If Triggerseed detonates and no enemy champions are hit while the shield still persists, the ally will be shielded for (75/115/155/195/235 + (50% Ability Power)) for 2 seconds.

Can also be used on Daisy.

R.name: Daisy!
R.tooltip:
Ivern summons his sentinel friend Daisy to leap into the fray for 45 seconds.

Daisy, Slam!: Daisy's 3rd consecutive Attack on the same champion or epic monster will launch a shockwave, dealing (90/140/190 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to all enemies hit as well as Knocking Up for 1 second. This effect can only occur once every 3 seconds.

Recast: Instruct Daisy to Attack or move.

Daisy has:
(1000 + (50% Ability Power)) Health
30 Armor
30 Magic Resist
(70/100/130 + (15% Ability Power)) Attack Damage

P.name: Tailwind
P.tooltip:
Ally champions gain 6% Move Speed moving towards Janna.

Janna deals (30%) bonus magic damage and with Zephyr.

Q.name: Howling Gale
Q.tooltip:
Janna summons a tornado that grows stronger over 3 seconds then blows along its path. It deals (55/90/125/160/195 + (50% Ability Power)) - (55/90/125/160/195 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Knocks Up for 0.5 - 1.25 seconds. The distance, damage, and Knock Up duration increase based on how much the tornado grew. Janna can Recast to send the tornado early.

Deals an additional (10/15/20/25/30 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage, Knocks Up for an additional 0.25 seconds, and travels 20% farther for each second it grew, and always reaches its destination in 1.25 seconds.

W.name: Zephyr
W.tooltip:
Passive: Janna gains (6/7/8/9/10% + (0.02% Ability Power)) Move Speed and is Ghosted.

Active: Janna's elemental strikes an enemy, Slowing them by (20/24/28/32/36% + (0.06% Ability Power)) for 2 seconds, and dealing (55/85/115/145/175 + (50% Ability Power)) + magic damage.

Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.

E.name: Eye Of The Storm
E.tooltip:
Janna grants an ally champion or turret (80/120/160/200/240 + (55% Ability Power)) Shield for 4 seconds. While shielded, they gain (10/15/20/25/30 + (10% Ability Power)) Attack Damage.

Janna refunds 20% of the cooldown whenever she impairs an enemy champion's movement with an Ability.

R.name: Monsoon
R.tooltip:
Janna summons a magical monsoon, Knocking Back nearby enemies then healing nearby allies for (300/450/600 + (150% Ability Power)) Health over 3 seconds. Moving or using an Ability ends the monsoon early.

The Knock Back cannot push enemies over walls.

P.name: Martial Cadence
P.tooltip: Jarvan's Attacks deal an additional 8% current Health physical damage. This effect has a 3 second Cooldown per target.

Q.name: Dragon Strike
Q.tooltip:
Jarvan extends his lance, dealing (90/130/170/210/250 + (145% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and removing 10/14/18/22/26% Armor for 3 seconds.

If the lance connects with Demacian Standard, Jarvan will pull himself to it, Knocking Up those in his path for 0.75 seconds.

Jarvan can pull himself even while Immobilized.

W.name: Golden Aegis
W.tooltip: Jarvan summons an aegis, Slowing nearby enemies by 15/20/25/30/35% for 2 seconds and granting him a (60/80/100/120/140 + (70% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield, increased by (1.3% Health) for each enemy champion hit.

E.name: Demacian Standard
E.tooltip:
Passive: Jarvan gains 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Attack Speed.

Active: Jarvan throws a standard into the ground, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and granting allies near the standard 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Attack Speed for 8 seconds.

R.name: Cataclysm
R.tooltip:
Jarvan heroically leaps to an enemy Champion, dealing (200/325/450 + (180% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to them and surrounding enemies and creating an arena of impassable terrain around them for 3.5 seconds.

Jarvan can Recast to collapse the terrain.

P.name: Relentless Assault
P.tooltip: Jax's Attacks grant a stack for 2.5 seconds that gives him 14% Attack Speed (max 112% Attack Speed).

Q.name: Leap Strike
Q.tooltip: Jax leaps to a friendly or enemy unit or ward, dealing (65/105/145/185/225 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage if it is an enemy.

W.name: Empower
W.tooltip:
Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next Attack or Leap Strike to deal an additional (50/85/120/155/190 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage.

This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
Deals 50% damage to structures.

E.name: Counter Strike
E.tooltip:
Jax enters a defensive stance for up to 2 seconds, dodging incoming Attacks and taking 25% less damage from area of effect Abilities. After 2 seconds or Recasting, Jax deals (40/70/100/130/160 + (70% Attack Damage)) + 4% max Health magic damage and Stuns nearby enemies for 1 second.

The damage is increased by 20% per Attack dodged, up to a maximum of (80/140/200/260/320 + (140% Attack Damage)) + 8% max Health.

R.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
R.tooltip:
Passive: Every third Attack within 2.5 seconds deals an additional (75/130/185 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Active: Jax slams his lantern down, dealing (100/175/250 + (100% Attack Damage)) magic damage to nearby enemies. If he hits a champion he gains (45/60/75 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) Armor and (27/36/45 + (24% bonus Attack Damage)) Magic Resist plus (20/25/30 + (10% bonus Attack Damage)) Armor and (12/15/18 + (6% bonus Attack Damage)) Magic Resist per additional champion hit for 8 seconds. During this time every second Attack deals additional magic damage instead of every third.

Deals 50% damage to structures.

P.name: Hextech Capacitor
P.tooltip: Jayce can swap between melee and ranged weapons using Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer starting from level 1. Swapping weapons also swaps all his Abilities and grants him 30 Move Speed for 0.75 seconds.

Q.name: To the Skies! / Shock Blast
Q.tooltip:
Mercury Hammer: Jayce leaps to an enemy, dealing physical damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by for seconds.

Deals 10 bonus damage to jungle monsters.

W.name: Lightning Field / Hyper Charge
W.tooltip:
Mercury Hammer - Passive: Jayce's Hammer Attacks grant Mana.

Mercury Hammer - Active: Jayce creates an electric aura dealing magic damage over seconds.

E.name: Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate
E.tooltip:
Hammer Form: Jayce swings his hammer, Knocking Back his target and dealing plus max Health magic damage.

Hammer swing does a max of 200/300/400/500/600/700 magic damage against jungle monsters.

R.name: Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer
R.tooltip: Mercury Hammer: Jayce transforms his weapon into the Mercury Cannon, gaining Attack Range and new Abilities. Jayce's next Attack removes Armor and Magic Resist for seconds.

P.name: Whisper
P.tooltip:
Jhin's hand cannon has a fixed Attack Speed and can be fired 4 times before needing to be reloaded. The 4th shot always critically strikes, and deals an additional (15% ~ 25%) missing health physical damage.

In addition:Jhin gains (4% + (35%) + (30%)) bonus Attack DamageJhin's critical strikes deal 25% less damage but grant him (14% + (44%)) Move Speed for 2 seconds.

Q.name: Dancing Grenade
Q.tooltip:
Jhin launches a cartridge that deals (44/69/94/119/144 + (44/51.5/59/66.5/74% Attack Damage) + (60% Ability Power)) physical damage before bouncing to a nearby enemy that has not been hit yet.

The cartridge can hit a maximum of times. Enemies that die shortly after being hit increase the damage of subsequent hits by 35%.

W.name: Deadly Flourish
W.tooltip:
Jhin fires a long range shot dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (50% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first champion hit and other enemies along the way.

If this skill strikes a champion that has been damaged by an allied champion within the last 4 seconds, it will Root them for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2/2.25 seconds and grant Jhin Whisper's Move Speed.

This ability deals 75% damage to minions.
Champions that step on a trap from Captive Audience can also be rooted.

E.name: Captive Audience
E.tooltip:
Passive: Champions Jhin kills will create and detonate a Lotus Trap at their location.

Active: Jhin places an invisible Lotus Trap for 3 minutes that creates a zone that Slows by 35% when stepped on by an enemy. After 2 seconds, the trap detonates, dealing (20/80/140/200/260 + (120% Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage.

This ability has 2 charges ( second refresh).

Lotus Trap hits deal 65% damage to minions, and enemies recently hit by another Lotus Trap.

R.name: Curtain Call
R.tooltip: Jhin sets up and channels, enabling him to fire 4 super shots, each dealing between (64/128/192 + (25% Attack Damage)) and (64/128/192 + (25% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first champion hit based on their percentage missing health and Slowing them by 80% for 0.5 seconds. The fourth shot critically strikes for 200% damage.

P.name: Get Excited!
P.tooltip:
Whenever a champion, epic monster, or structure that Jinx has dealt damage to within the last 3 seconds is killed or destroyed, she gains 175% decaying Move Speed and 25% Attack Speed for 6 seconds.

Champion takedowns stack the Attack Speed up to 5 times.

Q.name: Switcheroo!
Q.tooltip:
Jinx swaps weapons between Fishbones the rocket launcher and Pow-Pow the minigun.

While using the rocket launcher, Jinx's Attacks deal (110% Attack Damage) physical damage to the target and nearby enemies, gain 100/125/150/175/200 range, cost Mana, and scale 10% less with bonus Attack Speed.

While using the minigun, Jinx's Attacks grant Attack Speed for 2.5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times ( + 30/55/80/105/130% max).

Minigun stacks fall off one at a time and only benefit Jinx's first Attack after switching to the rocket launcher.

W.name: Zap!
W.tooltip:
Jinx fires a shock blast that deals (10/60/110/160/210 + (140% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit, Slows them by 40/50/60/70/80%, and reveals them for 2 seconds.

Zap!'s cast time decreases as Jinx gains Attack Speed.

E.name: Flame Chompers!
E.tooltip:
Jinx tosses out 3 chompers that last for 5 seconds. They explode on contact with enemy champions, Rooting them for 1.5 seconds and dealing (90/140/190/240/290 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies.

This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

R.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
R.tooltip:
Jinx fires a rocket that explodes on the first enemy champion hit, dealing (20/35/50 + (12% bonus Attack Damage)) to (200/350/500 + (120% bonus Attack Damage)) + 25/30/35% missing Health physical damage, gaining damage over the first second of travel time. Nearby enemies take 80% Damage.

Missing Health damage cannot exceed 1200 against Monsters.

P.name: Second Skin
P.tooltip:
Kai'Sa's Attacks stack Plasma for 4 seconds and deal an additional (12% Ability Power) plus (3% Ability Power) per stack magic damage. Attacking an enemy with 4 stacks consumes the Plasma, dealing (15% + (0.06% Ability Power)) missing Health magic damage. Nearby allies apply 1 stack to champions they Immobilize.

Kai'Sa's suit evolves her basic Abilities based on her stats.
Icathian Rain: / Bonus Attack Damage
Void Seeker: / Ability Power
Supercharge: /Bonus Attack Speed

Q.name: Icathian Rain
Q.tooltip:
Kai'Sa launches 6 missiles that split among nearby enemies, each dealing (40/55/70/85/100 + (55% bonus Attack Damage) + (20% Ability Power)) physical damage, up to a maximum of . Additional missile hits on champions or monsters deal 25% damage.

Evolved: Kai'Sa instead fires 12 missiles.
Current: /100 Bonus Attack Damage

Minions below 35% Health take 200% damage.

W.name: Void Seeker
W.tooltip:
Kai'Sa fires a void blast that deals (30/55/80/105/130 + (130% Attack Damage) + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage, applies 2 stacks of Plasma, and grants True Sight of the first enemy hit for seconds.

Evolved: Kai'Sa instead applies 3 stacks of Plasma and hitting a champion reduces the Cooldown by 75%.
Current: /100 Ability Power

Plasma applied by this Ability deals the damage from Second Skin.

E.name: Supercharge
E.tooltip:
Kai'Sa supercharges her void energy, gaining Move Speed and becoming Ghosted while charging, then gaining 4000/5000/6000/7000/8000% Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

Evolved: Kai'Sa also becomes Invisible for 0.5 seconds.
Current: /100% Bonus Attack Speed

Ghosted units can pass through other units.
Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight.
The charge time scales down with Attack Speed (Current: )

R.name: Killer Instinct
R.tooltip: Kai'Sa warps near an enemy champion affected by Plasma and gains (100/150/200 + (90/135/180% Attack Damage) + (120% Ability Power)) Shield for 2 seconds.

P.name: Martial Poise
P.tooltip: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.

Q.name: Pierce
Q.tooltip:
Kalista hurls a spear, dealing (10/75/140/205/270 + (105% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first target hit. If this kills the target, the spear continues onward, carrying any Rend stacks to the next target hit.

Kalista can dash after using this Ability using Martial Poise.

W.name: Sentinel
W.tooltip:
Passive: When Kalista and her Oathsworn both Attack the same target, she deals 10/12/14/16/18% max Health magic damage. This effect has a 10 second Cooldown per target and a cap of 100/125/150/175/200 to non-champions.

Active: Kalista sends a ghost to patrol an area for three laps. Champions spotted are revealed for 4 seconds. This ability has 2 charges (90/80/70/60/50 second refresh).

E.name: Rend
E.tooltip:
Passive: Kalista's spears linger in their target for 4 seconds, stacking any number of times.

Active: Kalista rips the spears from nearby enemies, dealing (5/15/25/35/45 + (70% Attack Damage) + (65% Ability Power)) plus (7/14/21/28/35 + (20/27.5/35/42.5/50% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage per spear beyond the first. Slows enemies hit by (10/18/26/34/42% + (0.05% Ability Power)) for 2 seconds.

If this Ability kills at least one target, its Cooldown is refreshed and it refunds 10/15/20/25/30 Mana.

This Ability deals 50% damage to epic jungle monsters.

R.name: Fate's Call
R.tooltip: Kalista puts her Oathsworn into Stasis and draws them to herself for up to 4 seconds. The Oathsworn can click to launch themselves, stopping at the first champion hit and Knocking Back all nearby enemies. If the Oathsworn hits a champion, they are placed at their maximum attack range from it.

P.name: Gathering Fire
P.tooltip:

W.tooltip: Karma tethers herself to a champion or jungle monster, dealing <magicDamage>{{ initialdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and revealing them for {{ tetherduration }}s. E.tooltip: Karma grants an allied champion <shield>{{ totalshield }} Shield</shield> for {{ shieldduration }}s and <speed>{{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed</speed> for {{ movespeedduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

R.name: Mantra
R.tooltip:
Karma empowers her next Ability used within 8 seconds.
Inner Flame: Deals an additional (40/100/160/220 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage and leaves behind a circle of flame, Slowing enemies and dealing an additional (40/130/220/310 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage.Focused Resolve: Karma will restore (17% + (0.01% Ability Power)) missing Health at the beginning and end of the tether, and Root for 0.5/0.75/1/1.25s longer.Inspire: Karma shields her target for (45/85/125/165 + (45% Ability Power)) more Shield, and also shields allies near her target, granting them (45/85/125/165 + (45% Ability Power)) Shield and 15% Move Speed.

P.name: Death Defied
P.tooltip: When Karthus dies he can use his Abilities for free for 7 seconds.

Q.name: Lay Waste
Q.tooltip: Karthus creates a blast of magic, dealing (40/59/78/97/116 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage. If the blast hits only one enemy, it instead deals (80/118/156/194/232 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

W.name: Wall of Pain
W.tooltip: Karthus creates a wall that lasts for 5 seconds. Enemies that pass through lose 25% Magic Resist for 5 seconds and are Slowed by 40/50/60/70/80% decaying over the duration.

E.name: Defile
E.tooltip:
Passive: When Karthus kills a unit, he restores 10/20/30/40/50 Mana.

Toggle: Karthus creates a necrotic aura, dealing (30/50/70/90/110 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage per second to nearby enemies.

R.name: Requiem
R.tooltip: Karthus channels for 3 seconds, then deals (200/350/500 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemy champions, regardless of distance.

P.name: Void Stone
P.tooltip: Kassadin takes 10% reduced magic damage and is Ghosted.

Q.name: Null Sphere
Q.tooltip: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy, dealing (65/95/125/155/185 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and interrupting channels. Kassadin also gains (80/110/140/170/200 + (30% Ability Power)) Magic Shield for 1.5 seconds.

W.name: Nether Blade
W.tooltip:
Passive: Kassadin's Attacks deal an additional (25 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Active: Kassadin charges his blade, causing his next Attack to deal (50/75/100/125/150 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and restore 4/4.5/5/5.5/6% missing Mana, increased to 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% against champions.

E.name: Force Pulse
E.tooltip:
Passive: Force Pulse's Cooldown is reduced by 0.75 second whenever any Ability is used near Kassadin.

Active: Kassadin unleashes a void pulse, dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 50/55/60/65/70% for 1 second.

R.name: Riftwalk
R.tooltip:
Kassadin teleports to a nearby location, dealing (70/90/110 + (50% Ability Power) + (2% Mana)) magic damage.

Each subsequent use of this Ability within the next 15 seconds doubles the Mana cost and deals an additional (35/45/55 + (7% Ability Power) + (1% Mana)) magic damage. The cost and damage increases can stack up to 4 times.

P.name: Voracity
P.tooltip:
Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged in the last 3 seconds, her Ability Cooldowns are reduced by 15 seconds.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing (60% bonus Attack Damage) magic damage.

Q.name: Bouncing Blade
Q.tooltip: Katarina throws a Dagger, dealing (80/115/150/185/220 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to the target and 2 nearby enemies. The Dagger then ricochets onto the ground behind the primary target.

W.name: Preparation
W.tooltip: Katarina tosses a Dagger into the air and gains 50/60/70/80/90% Move Speed decaying over 1.25 seconds.

E.name: Shunpo
E.tooltip:
Katarina blinks in the wink of an eye to the target ally, enemy, or Dagger. If it is an enemy, Katarina strikes for (20/30/40/50/60 + (25% Ability Power) + (40% Attack Damage)) magic damage - otherwise she strikes the nearest enemy in range.

Picking up a Dagger will reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 1 seconds (100%). Katarina can blink to any location near the target.

The strike Applies On-Hit Effects.

R.name: Death Lotus
R.tooltip:
Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, rapidly attacking the three nearest enemy champions with a flurry of knives. Each knife deals (25/37.5/50 + (19% Ability Power)) magic damage and physical damage, and applies 40% Grievous Wounds for 3 seconds.

Total over 2.5 seconds to each enemy: (25/37.5/50 + (19% Ability Power)) magic damage and physical damage.

This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects at 25/30/35% damage, and does not Critically Strike or apply Life Steal.
The physical damage additionally increases with Attack Speed.

P.name: Divine Ascent
P.tooltip:
Kayle's attacks rank up as she gains levels and spends skill points.

Level 1 - Zealous: Attacks grant 6% Attack Speed for 5 seconds (max 5 stacks). At max stacks Kayle becomes Exalted, gaining 10% Move Speed.
Level 6 - Arisen: Attack range is increased to 525.
Level 11 - Aflame: Exalted attacks launch fire waves that deal (20 + (25% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage.
Level 16 - Transcendent: Become permanently Exalted. Attack range is increased to 625.

Q.name: Radiant Blast
Q.tooltip: Kayle fires a celestial sword that stops on the first enemy hit, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (50% Ability Power) + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage, Slowing by 25/30/35/40/45% for 2 seconds, and removing 15% Armor and Magic Resist for 4 seconds from the target and enemies behind them.

W.name: Celestial Blessing
W.tooltip:
Kayle infuses herself and an allied champion with light, restoring (55/80/105/130/155 + (25% Ability Power)) Health and granting (24/28/32/36/40% + (0.08% Ability Power)) Move Speed for 2 seconds.

If cast without a target, this Ability will heal the most wounded ally in range.

E.name: Starfire Spellblade
E.tooltip:
Passive: Attacks deal an additional (15/20/25/30/35 + (20% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage.

Active: Kayle's next attack becomes ranged and deals an additional (8/8.5/9/9.5/10% + (0.015% Ability Power)) missing Health magic damage. This attack upgrades when Kayle reaches Level , causing it to explode when it hits the target, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

This Ability applies on-hit and spell effects. Max 400 bonus damage vs. jungle monsters.

R.name: Divine Judgment
R.tooltip: Kayle makes an allied champion Invulnerable for 2.5 seconds and then purifies the area around them, dealing (200/300/400 + (70% Ability Power) + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage to nearby enemies.

P.name: The Darkin Scythe
P.tooltip:
Kayn wields an ancient weapon and fights Rhaast, the darkin within it, for control. Either the Darkin will triumph, or Kayn will master Rhaast and become the Shadow Assassin.

Darkin: Heal for a percentage of spell damage dealt to champions.

Shadow Assassin: For the first few seconds in combat with enemy champions, deal bonus damage.

Q.name: Reaping Slash
Q.tooltip: Deals an additional 40 physical damage to minions and jungle monsters (max: 200/250/300/350/400).

W.name: Blade's Reach
W.tooltip:
Kayn swipes his scythe upward, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and Slowing enemies hit by {{ e3 }}%, decaying over {{ e5 }} seconds.

Shadow Assassin: Kayn can move while using this Ability and increases its range.

Darkin Slayer: Additionally Knocks Up enemies hit for {{ e2 }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

E.name: Shadow Step
E.tooltip:
Ghosted units can pass through other units.
Maximum duration in combat with enemy champions is 1.5 seconds.

R.name: Umbral Trespass
R.tooltip: Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them.

P.name: Mark of the Storm
P.tooltip: Kennen's abilities apply a stack for 6 seconds. At 3 stacks, enemies are Stunned for 1.25 seconds and Kennen gains 25 Energy.

Q.name: Thundering Shuriken
Q.tooltip: Kennen throws a shuriken, dealing (75/125/175/225/275 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit.

W.name: Electrical Surge
W.tooltip:
Passive: Every 5th Attack deals an additional (35/45/55/65/75 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit.

Active: Kennen sends out a blast of electricity, dealing (70/95/120/145/170 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies affected by Mark of the Storm.


The passive also applies Mark of the Storm and can critically strike for (35/45/55/65/75 + (35% Ability Power)) instead.
Attacking structures will stack the passive, but not expend it. The active automatically hits enemies inside of Slicing Maelstrom.

E.name: Lightning Rush
E.tooltip:
Kennen turns into a ball of lightning, gaining 100% Move Speed, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies he passes through, and becoming Ghosted for 2 seconds. If Kennen damages at least one enemy, he gains 40 Energy.

After this ability ends, Kennen gains 40/50/60/70/80% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Critical Strikes extend this duration by 1 second(s). Kennen can Recast to end this Ability early.

Ghosted units can pass through other units.
Deals 65% damage to minions and jungle monsters.
Duration cannot be extended beyond its initial value.

R.name: Slicing Maelstrom
R.tooltip:
Kennen unleashes a magical storm, dealing (40/80/120 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage to all nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds, and gaining 25/50/75 Armor and 25/50/75 Magic Resist for 3 seconds. Successive hits deal 10% increased damage for each hit the enemy has already suffered.

Enemies can only receive 3 stacks of Mark of the Storm from this ability.

P.name: Unseen Threat
P.tooltip:
When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, his next Attack against a champion deals an additional (50% bonus Attack Damage) magic damage and Slows by 25% for 2 seconds.

Enemies with no nearby allies become Isolated.

Q.name: Taste Their Fear
Q.tooltip: Kha'Zix slashes a nearby enemy, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ spell.khazixq:basedamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. This deals <physicalDamage>{{ spell.khazixq:isodamage }} damage</physicalDamage> instead to enemies <keywordMajor>Isolated</keywordMajor> from their allies. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

W.name: Void Spike
W.tooltip: Kha'Zix fires a spike dealing <physicalDamage>{{ basedamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to the first enemy hit in a small area. If Kha'Zix is inside the area, he restores <healing>{{ healamount }} Health</healing>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

E.name: Leap
E.tooltip: Kha'Zix leaps, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> upon landing.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

R.name: Void Assault
R.tooltip:
Passive: Leveling up this Ability allows Kha'zix to Evolve one of his Abilities, granting it additional effects.Taste Their Fear: Gain Ability range, Attack range, and lowers Cooldown by against Isolated targets.Void Spike: Fires 3 spikes and Slows by, increased against Isolated targets.Leap: Increased range and refreshes Cooldown on champion takedown.Void Assault: Invisibility duration lasts 2 seconds and gains second Recast.

Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight.

P.name: Mark of the Kindred
P.tooltip:
Kindred can designate a champion to hunt by clicking their portrait above their inventory. They also designate certain jungle monsters to hunt with an icon on the minimap automatically.

Getting a takedown on a hunted target grants Kindred a Mark, empowering them. After 4 Marks, Kindred gains Attack Range. Every 3 Marks after the fourth grants a further 25 Attack Range.

Marks empower Kindred's basic Abilities: grants an additional Attack Speed deal an additional current Health damage. deal an additional missing Health damage.

Q.name: Dance of Arrows
Q.tooltip:
Kindred vaults, firing an arrow at up to 3 enemies, dealing (40/65/90/115/140 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and gaining 35% Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

While inside of Wolf's Frenzy, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to 4/3.5/3/2.5/2 seconds.

Attack Speed scales with Marks taken.

W.name: Wolf's Frenzy
W.tooltip:
Passive: Kindred gains stacks as they move and attack. At 100 stacks, Kindred's next Attack restores up to 47 Health based on their missing Health.

Active: Kindred claims a territory, ordering Wolf to bite at the last enemy Lamb Attacked. Wolf's bites deal (25/30/35/40/45 + (20% bonus Attack Damage) + (20% Ability Power)) plus 1.5% current Health magic damage.

Wolf strikes faster based on Kindred's Attack Speed. Against jungle monsters, Wolf deals 50% increased damage and Slows them by 50% for 2 seconds.

E.name: Mounting Dread
E.tooltip:
Kindred weakens an enemy, Slowing them by (30 + (5% Ability Power))for 1 second.

Kindred's third Attack against the target within 4 seconds of each other directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, dealing an additional (80/110/140/170/200 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 5% missing Health physical damage.

Damage is increased by Critical Strike Chance and Damage at 50% effectiveness.
Missing health damage is capped at 200 against jungle monsters.

R.name: Lamb's Respite
R.tooltip:
Kindred blesses the ground for 4 seconds, allowing no unit, ally, enemy, or neutral to die while inside. Upon reaching 10% Health, units can't be damaged or healed while still inside the zone.

When the blessing ends, all units inside heal for 225/300/375 Health.

P.name: Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard
P.tooltip:
Mounted: Kled's mount Skaarl takes damage instead of Kled. When his Health depletes, Kled dismounts.

Dismounted: Kled replaces , gains 70 Move Speed toward enemy champions, and he gains (4 + (1% bonus Health)) bonus Armor and Magic Resist, increased by 30% for each nearby enemy Champion, up to (10 + (2.5% bonus Health)). While dismounted, Kled's attacks deal 0% reduced damage to Champions.

Kled gains 15 Courage by Attacking champions, 5 Courage by Attacking epic monsters and structures, and 5 Courage by killing minions. At max Courage Kled remounts with 70% of Skaarl's Health, once every 30 seconds.

Q.name: Bear Trap on a Rope
Q.tooltip:
Mounted: Kled throws a bear trap that deals (30/55/80/105/130 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and hooks onto the first enemy champion or large jungle monster hit.

If Kled stays near a hooked enemy for 1.75 seconds, he yanks out the trap, dealing (60/110/160/210/260 + (120% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, Pulling them, and Slowing by 30/35/40/45/50% for 2.5 seconds.

While hooked, Kled has True Sight to the enemy.
Deals 150% damage to minions.

W.name: Violent Tendencies
W.tooltip:
Passive: Kled's next Attack grants 150% Attack Speed for four Attacks or 4 seconds.

The fourth hit deals an additional 20/30/40/50/60 plus (4.5/5/5.5/6/6.5% + (0.02% bonus Attack Damage) + (0.004% bonus Health)) max Health physical damage.

Max Health damage is capped at 200 physical damage against monsters.
While on Cooldown, Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 0.5 second(s). Against Champions, this Cooldown reduction is increased to 1.5 second(s).

E.name: Jousting
E.tooltip:
Kled dashes, dealing (35/60/85/110/135 + (55% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies he passes through, pulling minions and small monsters towards him.

If this Ability hits an enemy champion or large jungle monster, Kled gains 50% Move Speed for 1 second(s) and can Recast within 3 seconds to dash back through the same target.

Kled gains True Sight to enemies he passes through.

R.name: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
R.tooltip:
Kled charges toward an area, leaving a trail that grants allies increasing Move Speed. While charging and for 2 seconds after Kled gains up to (200/300/400 + (300% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield. Skaarl rams the first enemy champion encountered, dealing (4/6/8% + (0.03% bonus Attack Damage)) to (12/18/24% + (0.09% bonus Attack Damage)) max Health magic damage (based on distance travelled) and briefly Knocking Back.

The damage, Move Speed, and Shield reach their max values after 3 second(s) of charging.

P.name: Icathian Surprise
P.tooltip: For 4 seconds after dying, Kog'Maw can continue to move, can move through units, and gains 10% Move Speed, increasing to 50% Move Speed over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes and deals (140 ~ 650) true damage to nearby enemies.

Q.name: Caustic Spittle
Q.tooltip:
Passive: Kog'Maw gains 5/10/15/20/25% Attack Speed.

Active: Kog'Maw vomits a corrosive projectile that deals (80/125/170/215/260 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit and shreds 16/20/24/28/32% Armor and Magic Resist for 4 seconds.

W.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
W.tooltip:
Kog'Maw gains 130/150/170/190/210 Attack Range and his Attacks deal an additional (3/3.75/4.5/5.25/6% + (0.015% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage On-Hit for 8 seconds.

Deals a maximum of 100 magic damage to Monsters.

E.name: Void Ooze
E.tooltip: Kog'Maw spits bile, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage and leaving a trail of ooze for 3 seconds. Enemies in the ooze are Slowed by 40/45/50/55/60%.

R.name: Living Artillery
R.tooltip:
Kog'Maw shoots acid at an area, dealing (100/140/180 + (35/40/45% Ability Power) + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 0.833% per 1% missing Health magic damage and revealing enemies hit for 2 seconds. Enemies below 40% Health instead take (200/280/360 + (70/80/90% Ability Power) + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage.

Subsequent shots within 8 seconds cost an additional 40 Mana (max: 400 Mana).

P.name: Dauntless Instinct
P.tooltip:
K'Sante's damaging Abilities mark enemies hit. Attacking a marked enemy deals 12 plus max Health physical damage and consumes the mark.

All Out: K'Sante's Attacks, Abilities and Passive deal an additional (1% + (0.01% bonus Armor) + (0.01% bonus Magic Resist)) max Health physical damage.

Q.name: Ntofo Strikes
Q.tooltip:
K'Sante slams his weapon, dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (40% bonus Armor) + (40% bonus Magic Resist)) physical damage and Slowing enemies by 80% for 0.5s. If he hits, he gains a stack of Ntofo Strikes for 6 seconds. At 2 stacks, he instead fires a shockwave that Stuns and Pulls enemies for 1 second.

All Out: Cooldown is reduced by 33%.

Cooldown & cast time reduced by Bonus Armor and Magic Resist: / 120.

W.name: Path Maker
W.tooltip:
K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for 0.4-1.0s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by 30%. Then, he rams forward, dealing 45/75/105/135/165 + (8% + (0.02% bonus Armor) + (0.02% bonus Magic Resist)) max Health physical damage. Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for 0.5-1.75s (based on charge time).

All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional 10-80% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to 75% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns.

Maximum effect is reached at 90% charge time.
Maximum of 180/260/340/420/500 damage against monsters.

E.name: Footwork
E.tooltip:
K'Sante dashes, gaining (70/112.5/155/197.5/240 + (13.5% bonus Health)) Shield for 2 seconds. If dashing to an ally, the distance of the dash is significantly increased and the ally is also Shielded.

All Out: Cooldown is decreased by 50% and dash speed is increased.

R.name: All Out
R.tooltip:
K'Sante shatters his ntofos to Knock Back an enemy champion, dealing 80/115/150 physical damage, then dashes behind them and goes All Out for 15s. If the enemy would hit a wall, they are Knocked Back through the wall and K'Sante strikes them again for (80/115/150 + (5% bonus Health)) physical damage.

While All Out, K'Sante's Abilities are upgraded and he gains 40/60/80% Attack Speed, 50% Bonus Armor Penetration, and 20% Omnivamp, but loses 35% max Health, 85% Bonus Armor, and 85% Bonus Magic Resistance.

K'Sante is Unstoppable and Roots his target while casting this Ability.

P.name: Mirror Image
P.tooltip: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes Invisible for 1 second and creates a harmless clone for 8 seconds. LeBlanc can move the clone with the "Alt" key.

Q.name: Sigil of Malice
Q.tooltip:
LeBlanc projects a sigil to an enemy, dealing (65/90/115/140/165 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and marking them for 3.5 seconds.

Damaging the marked enemy with an Ability detonates the sigil, dealing (65/90/115/140/165 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds 100% of the Mana cost and 30% of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

The initial sigil deals an additional 10 damage to minions.

W.name: Distortion
W.tooltip:
LeBlanc dashes then deals (75/115/155/195/235 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies. For 4 seconds after dashing, LeBlanc can Recast.

Recast: LeBlanc returns to her starting location.

E.name: Ethereal Chains
E.tooltip:
LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit, dealing (50/70/90/110/130 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and granting True Sight.

If they remain shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc Roots them for 1.5 seconds and deals an additional (80/120/160/200/240 + (85% Ability Power)) magic damage.

R.name: Mimic
R.tooltip:
LeBlanc mimics her most recent Ability, using it again. The mimicked Ability deals increased damage.

Mimicked Sigil of Malice deals (70/150/230 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage when applied, and (140/300/460 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage when consumed.
Mimicked Distortion deals (150/315/480 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage.
Mimicked Ethereal Chains deals (70/150/230 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage when shackled and (140/300/460 + (85% Ability Power)) magic damage when Rooting.

P.name: Flurry
P.tooltip: Lee Sin's Abilities grant him 40% Attack Speed for two Attacks. The first Attack restores 20/40 Energy and the second restores (10 ~ 20) Energy.

Q.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
Q.tooltip:
Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit, granting True Sight of them, and allows Lee Sin to Recast for the next 3 seconds.

Recast: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by the sound wave, dealing between (60/90/120/150/180 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) to (120/180/240/300/360 + (180% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage scaling with the target's missing Health.

W.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
W.tooltip:
Lee Sin dashes to an ally or ward. If the target is a champion, Lee Sin grants them and himself (60/105/150/195/240 + (80% Ability Power)) Shield for 2 seconds. Lee Sin may Recast for the next 3 seconds.

Recast: Lee Sin gains 10/14/18/22/26% Omnivamp for 4 seconds.

E.name: Tempest / Cripple
E.tooltip:
Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals (35/60/85/110/135 + (90% Attack Damage)) magic damage and reveals them for 4 seconds. If this hits an enemy, Lee Sin can Recast for the next 3 seconds.

Recast: Lee Sin Slows nearby enemies struck by the shockwave by 35/45/55/65/75% decaying over 4 seconds.

R.name: Dragon's Rage
R.tooltip:
Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick Knocking Back an enemy champion and dealing (175/400/625 + (200% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

Enemies the target collides with are briefly Knocked Up and take (175/400/625 + (200% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 12/15/18% of the kicked enemy's bonus Health as physical damage.

The target is Rooted during the cast time.

P.name: Sunlight
P.tooltip: Leona's abilities mark enemies for 2.5 seconds. Other allied champions consume the mark when they damage the marked enemy, dealing an additional magic damage.

Q.name: Shield of Daybreak
Q.tooltip:
Leona's next Attack Stuns for 1 seconds and deals an additional (10/35/60/85/110 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage.

The Attack must be used within 6 seconds or it is lost.

W.name: Eclipse
W.tooltip:
Leona raises her shield, reducing incoming damage by 8/12/16/20/24 and gaining (20/27.5/35/42.5/50 + (20% bonus Armor)) Armor and (20/27.5/35/42.5/50 + (20% bonus Magic Resist)) Magic Resist for 3 seconds. Afterwards, her shield detonates, dealing (55/85/115/145/175 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits at least one, she retains the Armor and Magic Resist bonuses for an additional 3 seconds.


Damage reduction effect can't reduce the damage below 50%.

E.name: Zenith Blade
E.tooltip: Leona thrusts with a sword of light, dealing (50/90/130/170/210 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage. The last champion struck will be Rooted for 0.5 seconds and Leona will dash to them.

R.name: Solar Flare
R.tooltip: Leona calls down a radiant beam of solar energy dealing (150/225/300 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 80% for 1.75 seconds. Enemies in the center of the flare are Stunned instead of Slowed.

P.name: Dream-Laden Bough
P.tooltip: Lillia's Abilities apply Dream Dust, dealing (5% + (0.012% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage over 3 seconds. Lillia restores (39 + (15% Ability Power)) Health over the duration against large jungle monsters, and restores (30% Ability Power) Health against champions.

Q.name: Blooming Blows
Q.tooltip:
Passive: Lillia's Ability hits grant (3/4/5/6/7% + (0.03% Ability Power)) Move Speed for 6.5 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

Active: Lillia whirls her censer, dealing (35/45/55/65/75 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage, plus an additional (35/45/55/65/75 + (35% Ability Power)) true damage at the outer edge.

W.name: Watch Out! Eep!
W.tooltip:
Lillia winds up a huge strike, dealing (80/100/120/140/160 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage. Enemies in the center take (240/300/360/420/480 + (105% Ability Power)) damage instead.

Lillia does not dash over terrain with this ability.
Deals 50% less damage to minions.

E.name: Swirlseed
E.tooltip: Lillia lobs a swirlseed overhead, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage where it lands and revealing and Slowing them by 40% for 3 seconds. If no enemies are hit, the seed rolls until it hits an enemy or collides with terrain.

R.name: Lilting Lullaby
R.tooltip:
Lillia causes all enemy champions with Dream Dust to become Drowsy for 1.5 seconds. Afterward, they fall Asleep for 2 seconds.

When awakened by damage, they take an additional (100/150/200 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Drowsy units are slowed over the duration, and fall Asleep afterwards.
Asleep units can't move or act until damaged by an enemy with non-periodic damage.

P.name: Iceborn Subjugation
P.tooltip: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a frozen zombie that seeks out living enemies. Enemies near these zombies are Slowed by 25%. After 4 seconds, frozen zombies shatter, dealing (120 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Q.name: Ice Shard
Q.tooltip: Lissandra throws a spear of ice that shatters on the first enemy hit, dealing (80/115/150/185/220 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage, Slowing them by 20/24/28/32/36% for 1.5 seconds, and also damaging and slowing the enemies behind them.

W.name: Ring of Frost
W.tooltip: Lissandra creates an ice field, Rooting nearby enemies for 1.25/1.35/1.45/1.55/1.65 seconds and dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

E.name: Glacial Path
E.tooltip: Lissandra casts forth an ice claw that deals (70/105/140/175/210 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Lissandra can Recast while the claw travels to teleport to its location.

R.name: Frozen Tomb
R.tooltip:
Lissandra encases herself or an enemy champion in ice. Enemies are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. When self cast, Lissandra enters Stasis for 2.5 seconds and restores (100/150/200 + (55% Ability Power)) Health, increased by 1% for each 1% missing Health.

In either case, dark ice eminates from the target, dealing (150/250/350 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage. The ice persists for 3 seconds, Slowing enemies by 45/60/75%.

Units in Stasis cannot move or act, and are invulnerable and Untargetable.
This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

P.name: Silver Stake
P.tooltip: Locke's Attacks deal an additional (10% Ability Power) magic damage on-hit, increased up to (20% Ability Power) magic damage based on the target's missing Health.

Q.name: Ritual Nails
Q.tooltip:
Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing (40/48/56/64/72 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage and marking enemies hit. Nails apply a 25/25/60% Slow for 1/1/2 seconds, stacking with the amount of nails hit.

Attacking the enemy consumes the Soul Nails, dealing (18/26/34/42/50 + (25/27.5/30/32.5/35% Ability Power)) magic damage per stack, increased by 20% and 40% for two and three nails respectively.

Each remaining nail refunds (20% ~ 35%) of Ability's Cooldown and Mana cost when this effect ends.

W.name: Soul Ignition
W.tooltip:
Locke ignites his own soul, gaining (40% ~ 70%) Attack Speed and (40% + (0.02% Ability Power)) Move Speed that decays over 2 seconds.

For 6 seconds, he suffers 2% current Health true damage per second but Heals back the last (40/60/80/100/120 + (100% Ability Power)) damage taken, and an additional (20% Ability Power) Health based on missing Health and time passed, up to a maximum of (60% Ability Power) Health remaining.

Can be Recast to end early.

This Ability can be used while Disabled.
Locke is Ghosted for the duration. Ghosted units can pass through other units.

E.name: Ashen Pursuit
E.tooltip:
Locke teleports to a location, dealing (40/50/60/70/80 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies on arrival.

On his next Attack, he dashes to his target, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to all enemies in his path. Each hit consumes Soul Nails.

If Locke scores a takedown, the Cooldown of this Ability is reset.

R.name: Purgatory
R.tooltip:
Locke throws a binding artifact to a location, dealing (150/225/300 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing enemies in the area by 99%, decaying over 2 seconds. The artifact marks enemies hit for 5 seconds, sealing away marked enemy champions brought below , and resetting the duration of the mark on other affected champions.

After the duration ends, if at least one champion was sealed, the artifact lands on the ground. Locke can pick up the artifact to permanently increase its execution threshold by 0.5%, and refund 20% of his total Cooldown, for each champion sealed.


The artifact will linger on the ground for this Ability's current Cooldown at the time of sealing.

P.name: Lightslinger
P.tooltip:
After using an Ability, Lucian's next Attack within 3.5 seconds will fire two shots. The second shot deals physical damage to the target, increased to (100% Attack Damage) against minions.

Vigilance: When Lucian is directly healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is Immobilized, his pistols become Overcharged with energy, causing his next 2 basic attacks to deal an additional (15 + (20% Attack Damage)) magic damage.

Q.name: Piercing Light
Q.tooltip:
Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light, dealing (80/115/150/185/220 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.


This Ability's cast time decreases with Lucian's level.

W.name: Ardent Blaze
W.tooltip:
Lucian fires a shot that explodes at the end of its range or on the first enemy hit, dealing (75/110/145/180/215 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage, briefly revealing enemies and marking them for 6 seconds.

When Lucian or an ally damages a marked enemy, Lucian gains 60/65/70/75/80 Move Speed for 1 second. Allies triggering this effect will also grant Lucian Vigilance.

E.name: Relentless Pursuit
E.tooltip:
Lucian dashes.

Cooldown is reduced by 1 second whenever Lucian hits an enemy with Lightslinger (2 seconds for champions).

Lucian can use other Abilities while dashing.

R.name: The Culling
R.tooltip:
Lucian rapidly fires shots in a direction for 3 seconds or until he Recasts. Each shot deals (15/30/45 + (25% Attack Damage) + (15% Ability Power)) physical damage to the first enemy hit.

While firing, Lucian may use Relentless Pursuit.

Total Damage: physical damage


Number of shots scales with Lucian's Critical Strike chance and Critical Strike damage at 100% effectiveness.
Deals 200% damage to minions.

P.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
P.tooltip: Lulu is assisted by Pix the faerie. When Lulu Attacks, Pix fires 3 bolts at her target, dealing (15% Ability Power) magic damage to the first enemy hit.

Q.name: Glitterlance
Q.tooltip:
Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing (60/95/130/165/200 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 80%, decaying over 2 seconds.

Enemies take (30/47.5/65/82.5/100 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage from additional bolts.

Deals 70% damage to Minions.

W.name: Whimsy
W.tooltip:
When used on an ally, Lulu grants (25% + (0.05% Ability Power)) Move Speed and 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Attack Speed for 3/3.25/3.5/3.75/4 seconds.

When used on an enemy, Lulu Polymorphs them for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 seconds.

Polymorphed targets are Silenced, Disarmed, and Slowed by 60.

E.name: Help, Pix!
E.tooltip:
When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for 6 seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants (70/110/150/190/230 + (50% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds.

When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and granting True Sight of them for 4 seconds.

R.name: Wild Growth
R.tooltip: Lulu enlarges an ally, Knocking Up surrounding enemies for 1 second. The enlarged ally gains (275/425/575 + (55% Ability Power)) max Health and Slows surrounding enemies by 30/45/60% for 7 seconds.

P.name: Illumination
P.tooltip:
Lux's damaging Abilities mark enemies for 6 seconds. Lux's Attacks consume the mark, dealing (35% Ability Power) magic damage.

Final Spark will consume marks on enemies it hits and refresh them.

Q.name: Light Binding
Q.tooltip: Lux fires a ball of light, Rooting the first two enemies for 2 seconds and dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage to each.

W.name: Prismatic Barrier
W.tooltip:
Lux throws her wand, granting (40/55/70/85/100 + (40% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds to allies it passes through. Then it returns, granting the same Shield on its return.

Both instances of Shield can stack.

E.name: Lucent Singularity
E.tooltip: Lux creates a light zone that Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% and reveals the area. After 5 seconds or on Recasting this Ability, it detonates, dealing (65/115/165/215/265 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing for an additional 1 second.

R.name: Final Spark
R.tooltip: Lux fires a dazzling ray of light, dealing (300/400/500 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage to all enemies in a line.

P.name: Granite Shield
P.tooltip: Malphite grants himself (10% Health) Shield after not taking damage for (8 ~ 6) seconds.

Q.name: Seismic Shard
Q.tooltip: Malphite launches a shard of earth at an enemy, dealing (70/120/170/220/270 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing them by 20/25/30/35/40% for 3 seconds. Malphite also steals the amount Slowed, gaining it as Move Speed for 3 seconds.

W.name: Thunderclap
W.tooltip:
Passive: Malphite gains 10/15/20/25/30% Armor (). This effect is increased to 30/45/60/75/90% () while Granite Shield is active.

Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional (30/40/50/60/70 + (20% Ability Power) + (15% Armor)) physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals (15/25/35/45/55 + (30% Ability Power) + (15% Armor)) physical damage On-Hit in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks On-Hit for the next 5 seconds.

Deals 180% damage to jungle monsters.

E.name: Ground Slam
E.tooltip: Malphite slams the ground, dealing (60/95/130/165/200 + (40% Armor) + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and reducing Attack Speed by 30/35/40/45/50% for 3 seconds.

R.name: Unstoppable Force
R.tooltip: Malphite charges with the force of a landslide, dashing Unstoppably. At the end of the dash, Malphite Knocks Up for 1.5 seconds and deals (200/300/400 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage.

P.name: Void Shift
P.tooltip: Malzahar gains 90% damage reduction and immunity from Disabling and Immobilizing effects, lingering for 0.25 seconds after taking damage or blocking one of those effects. This effect has a 12 second Cooldown.

Q.name: Call of the Void
Q.tooltip: Malzahar opens two portals to the Void that fire projectiles inward, dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage and Silencing for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 second(s).

W.name: Void Swarm
W.tooltip:
Passive: Malzahar's other Abilities give him a stack when cast (max 2).

Active: Malzahar summons a Voidling plus an additional Voidling per stack. Voidlings last 8/8/9/9/10 seconds and deal (12/14/16/18/20 + (40% bonus Attack Damage) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage each hit.

Voidlings deal 300% damage to lane minions affected by Malefic Visions.
Voidlings deal 50% damage to epic monsters.

E.name: Malefic Visions
E.tooltip:
Malzahar inflicts terrible visions, dealing (80/115/150/185/220 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage over 4 seconds. Applying Call of the Void or Nether Grasp to the victim during this time refreshes the visions.

If the victim dies, Malzahar gains (2% Mana) Mana and the visions spread to the nearest enemy.

Malefic Visions executes minions below 10 Health.

R.name: Nether Grasp
R.tooltip:
Malzahar Suppresses an enemy champion and deals (125/200/275 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage over 2.5 seconds. A zone of negative energy is created around his target dealing (10/15/20% + (0.025% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage over 5 seconds.

This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

P.name: Sap Magic
P.tooltip:
Maokai's next Attack restores Health.

Using an Ability or being hit by an enemy champion's Ability reduces the Cooldown by 4 seconds. Being hit by large or epic monster's Attacks or Abilities reduces the Cooldown by 1.5 second.

Q.name: Bramble Smash
Q.tooltip:
Maokai smashes his fist into the ground, dealing (75/120/165/210/255 + (50% Ability Power)) plus 2/2.5/3/3.5/4% max Health magic damage and briefly Slowing. Nearby enemies are also Knocked Back.

This Ability deals an additional 150/160/170/180/190 magic damage to jungle monsters.

W.name: Twisted Advance
W.tooltip: Maokai transforms into a moving mass of roots, becoming Untargetable and dashing to an enemy. Upon arrival, he Roots the enemy for 1/1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4 second(s) and deals (60/85/110/135/160 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

E.name: Sapling Toss
E.tooltip:
Maokai flings a sapling, which stands watch for 30 seconds. Saplings chase nearby enemies, detonating on arrival to deal (50/75/100/125/150 + (25% Ability Power) + (5% bonus Health)) magic damage and Slow surrounding enemies by 45% for 2 seconds. Sap Magic's Cooldown is reduced by an additional 4 seconds if the sapling hits an enemy champion or epic monster.

If placed in brush, Saplings instead last for (30 + (1.5% bonus Health)) seconds and cause a larger explosion, dealing (100/150/200/250/300 + (50% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Health)) magic damage over 2 seconds and Slowing enemies by (45% + (0.01% Ability Power)).

Saplings run at 400 Move Speed. Brush saplings do not deal the increased damage to minions.

R.name: Nature's Grasp
R.tooltip: Maokai summons a colossal wave of brambles and thorns, Rooting enemies for 0.75 to 2.25 seconds, increasing with distance travelled, and dealing (150/225/300 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage. Hitting a champion gives Maokai 40/50/60% Move Speed, decaying over 2 seconds.

P.name: Double Strike
P.tooltip: Every 4th Attack, Master Yi strikes twice. The second Attack deals (50% Attack Damage) physical damage.

Q.name: Alpha Strike
Q.tooltip:
Master Yi becomes Untargetable and teleports to rapidly strike enemies near his target, dealing (20/40/60/80/100 + (70% Attack Damage)) physical damage to all enemies hit after 4 hits.

This Ability can strike the same enemy repeatedly if there are no other targets, dealing 25% damage for subsequent hits (), for a maximum single target total of (20/40/60/80/100 + (70% Attack Damage)) physical damage.

Applies On-Hit effects at 75% damage. Subsequent hits are reduced to 25% of this.
Can critically strike for an additional (20/40/60/80/100 + (70% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Subsequent hits are reduced to 25% of this, for a maximum single target total of .
Jungle monsters take 60/85/110/135/160 bonus damage per strike.
Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by second.
Alpha Strike does not reduce its own cooldown or stack Double Strike On-Hit.
Master Yi will reappear near the initial target.

W.name: Meditate
W.tooltip:
Master Yi channels, restoring (120/200/280/360/440 + (100% Ability Power)) Health over 4 seconds. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Master Yi's missing Health.

While channeling and for 0.5 seconds afterwards, he takes reduced damage, decreased to 45/47.5/50/52.5/55% after the first 0.5 seconds.

Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike.
Damage reduction is halved against turrets.

E.name: Wuju Style
E.tooltip:
Master Yi's Attacks deal an additional (20/25/30/35/40 + (35% bonus Attack Damage)) true damage for 5 seconds.

The duration of Wuju Style is paused during Alpha Strike and Meditate

R.name: Highlander
R.tooltip:
Passive: Champion takedowns reduce the remaining Cooldown of Master Yi's basic Abilities by 70%.

Active: Master Yi enters a trance, gaining 35/45/55% Move Speed, 25/45/65% Attack Speed, and immunity to Slows for 7 seconds. Champion takedowns extend the duration of this Ability by 7 seconds.

The duration of Highlander is paused during Alpha Strike and Meditate

P.name: Searing Brilliance
P.tooltip:
Mel's Attacks and Abilities apply and refresh stacks of Overwhelm for 5 seconds each time they deal damage, storing plus damage per stack of magic damage. When applied, if the stored amount exceeds the enemy's combined shields and Health, they are executed.

When an Ability is cast, Mel's next Attack fires 3 extra projectiles, each dealing (4% Ability Power) magic damage. This effect can stack up to 9 extra projectiles.

Q.name: Radiant Volley
Q.tooltip:
Mel unleashes a barrage of 6/7/8/9/10 projectiles that explode in the area around a target location.

The first explosion hit deals (60/85/110/135/160 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage and each subsequent explosion deals (5/7/9/11/13 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage, adding up to magic damage total.

W.name: Rebuttal
W.tooltip:
Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects projectiles from enemy champions, gaining (80/110/140/170/200 + (70% Ability Power)) Shields for 0.75 seconds and 40% decaying Move Speed for 0.75 seconds.

Reflected projectiles deal (40/45/50/55/60% + (0.05% Ability Power)) original damage as magic damage.

Reflected projectile damage is calculated using the original caster's attributes before damage adjustments and magic penetration.
Physical damage is reduced by 30% when converted to magic damage.
Does not apply item effects from the original caster.
Projectiles targeting each enemy in an area are destroyed instead of reflected.

E.name: Solar Snare
E.tooltip:
Mel fires a radiating orb, Rooting enemies at its center for 1.5 seconds and dealing (60/105/150/195/240 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

The orb builds up a hostile area around it that Slows enemies by 30% and deals (16/28/40/52/64 + (8% Ability Power)) magic damage per second.

The Slow and damage-over-time effects linger on enemies for a short duration after they've left the area created by the orb.
Deals reduced damage when used against minions.

R.name: Golden Eclipse
R.tooltip:
Passive: Overwhelm damage is increased to (60/70/80 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage plus (3/4/5 + (0.75% Ability Power)) magic damage per stack.

Active: Mel unleashes her power on all enemies affected by Overwhelm, dealing (125/200/275 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage plus (4/7/10 + (4% Ability Power)) magic damage per Overwhelm stack.

Can only be cast when an enemy champion is affected by Overwhelm.

P.name: Fired Up!
P.tooltip: When Milio's Abilities touch ally champions, their next Attack or Ability deals 15% ally Attack Damage as additional magic damage, plus (20% Ability Power) magic damage over 1.5 seconds.

Q.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
Q.tooltip:
Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing (80/140/200/260/320 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by (40/45/50/55/60% + (0.05% Ability Power)) for 1.5 seconds.

Hitting at least one enemy champion with Ultra Mega Fire Kick refunds 50% of it's Mana cost.

Minions and monsters are knocked further and create a larger explosion.

W.name: Cozy Campfire
W.tooltip:
Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for 6 seconds. Ally champions nearby gain 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Attack Range and restore (70/90/110/130/150 + (15% Ability Power)) Health over the duration. The hearth also applies Fired Up! every 3 seconds.

Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.

E.name: Warm Hugs
E.tooltip:
Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting (45/75/105/135/165 + (45% Ability Power)) Shield and 12/14/16/18/20% Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.

R.name: Breath of Life
R.tooltip:
Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing Disabling and Immobilizing effects, restoring (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) Health, and granting 65% Tenacity for 3 seconds.

Does not cleanse Airborne.

P.name: Love Tap
P.tooltip:
Miss Fortune's Attacks deal an additional physical damage when she attacks a new target.

Triggering reduces the cooldown of by seconds.

Q.name: Double Up
Q.tooltip:
Miss Fortune fires a bouncing shot, dealing (20/45/70/95/120 + (100% Attack Damage) + (35% Ability Power)) physical damage to an enemy and to another one behind them.

The second shot can critically strike for (20/45/70/95/120 + (100% Attack Damage) + (35% Ability Power)) physical damage. It always critically strikes if the first shot kills its target.

Both strikes apply on-hit effects.

W.name: Strut
W.tooltip:
Passive: After 4 seconds of not taking damage, Miss Fortune gains 30/35/40/45/50 Move Speed. After another 3 seconds, this increases to 60/70/80/90/100.

Active: Gain the passive effect's full Move Speed bonus and 40/55/70/85/100% Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

Love Taps reduce the Cooldown of this Ability by 2 seconds.

E.name: Make It Rain
E.tooltip: Miss Fortune rains bullets, revealing an area, Slowing by (40% + (0.06% Ability Power)) and dealing (35/50/65/80/95 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage per second for 2 seconds (total (70/100/130/160/190 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage).

R.name: Bullet Time
R.tooltip:
Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets, firing 14/16/18 waves over 3 seconds, dealing (20/30/40 + (60% Attack Damage) + (25% Ability Power)) physical damage per wave (total (280/480/720 + (840/960/1080% Attack Damage) + (350/400/450% Ability Power)) physical damage).

Each wave can critically strike for (20/30/40 + (60% Attack Damage) + (25% Ability Power)) physical damage.

P.name: Stone Skin
P.tooltip: Wukong gains (6 ~ 10) Armor and regenerates 0.35% max Health per 5 seconds. These bonuses are increased by 100% for 5 seconds every time he or his Clone hit an enemy champion or jungle monster with an Attack or Ability, stacking up to 5 times.

Q.name: Crushing Blow
Q.tooltip:
Wukong and his Clone's next Attack gains 135/145/155/165/175 range, deals an additional (20/45/70/95/120 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, and removes 10/15/20/25/30% Armor for 3 seconds.

This Ability's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds every time Wukong or his Clone hit an enemy with an Attack or Ability.

This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

W.name: Warrior Trickster
W.tooltip:
Wukong dashes and becomes Invisible for 1 second, leaving behind a stationary Clone for 4 seconds.

The Clone Attacks nearby enemies Wukong has recently damaged and will mimic his ultimate, each dealing 40/45/50/55/60% of normal damage.

Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or true sight.

E.name: Nimbus Strike
E.tooltip: Wukong dashes to an enemy, sending out Clones that mimic the dash to up to 2 additional enemies nearby. Each enemy struck takes (80/120/160/200/240 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. He and his Clone gain 40/45/50/55/60% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

R.name: Cyclone
R.tooltip:
Wukong gains 20% Move Speed and spins his staff, Knocking Up nearby enemies for 0.6 seconds and take (275% Attack Damage) plus 8/12/16% max Health physical damage over 2 seconds.

This Ability can be cast a second time within 8 seconds before going on cooldown.

Damage to jungle monsters is capped at 1200 damage over 2 seconds.

P.name: Darkness Rise
P.tooltip:
Mordekaiser's Attacks deal an additional (40% Ability Power) magic damage.

Mordekaiser cloaks himself in negative energy after hitting 3 basic Abilities or Attacks against champions or jungle monsters. This cloak deals (5 + (30% Ability Power)) plus (1 ~ 5)max Health magic damage per second and grants him 18% Move Speed.

Q.name: Obliterate
Q.tooltip: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with Nightfall dealing (80/115/150/185/220 + (120% bonus Attack Damage) + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage, increased to (104/155.25/210/268.25/330 + (156/162/168/174/180% bonus Attack Damage) + (91/94.5/98/101.5/105% Ability Power)) if it hits only a single enemy.

W.name: Indestructible
W.tooltip:
Passive: Mordekaiser stores 45% of the damage he deals and 7.5% of the damage he takes.

Active: Mordekaiser gains the stored damage as Shield. He may Recast this Ability to restore 35/37.5/40/42.5/45% of the remaining Shield as Health.

Minimum Shield: (5% Health)
Maximum Shield: (30% Health)

Shield decays over time.
Damage stored from non-champion sources reduced by 75%.

E.name: Death's Grasp
E.tooltip:
Passive: Mordekaiser gains 5/7.5/10/12.5/15% Magic Penetration.

Active: Pulls enemies in his direction, dealing (60/80/100/120/140 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage.

R.name: Realm of Death
R.tooltip:
Mordekaiser banishes a champion to the Death Realm with him for 7s, stealing 10% of their core stats for the duration.

If Mordekaiser kills that enemy in the Death Realm he consumes their soul, keeping the stats he stole until the target respawns.

Core stats stolen include: Ability Power, Attack Damage, Attack Speed, Armor, Magic Resist, and Maximum Health.

P.name: Soul Siphon
P.tooltip: Morgana Heals for 18% of the damage dealt by her Abilities to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungle monsters.

Q.name: Dark Binding
Q.tooltip: Morgana hurls a blast of starfire that Roots the first enemy hit for 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3 seconds and deals (80/135/190/245/300 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage.

W.name: Tormented Shadow
W.tooltip:
Morgana ignites the ground for 5 seconds, dealing (18/31/44/57/70 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage per second, increased by up to (18/31/44/57/70 + (20% Ability Power)) based on the targets' missing Health.

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 5% every time Morgana is healed by Soul Siphon.

This Ability deals 170% damage to jungle monsters.

E.name: Black Shield
E.tooltip: Morgana grants an ally champion (100/155/210/265/320 + (70% Ability Power)) Magic Shield for 5 seconds. The shield prevents Disabling and Immobilizing effects until it breaks.

R.name: Soul Shackles
R.tooltip:
Morgana chains herself to nearby enemy Champions, dealing (200/275/350 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing them by 20%. After 3 seconds, enemies unable to break the chains take an additional (200/275/350 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and are Stunned for 1.5/1.75/2 seconds.

While casting this Ability, Morgana gains 20/40/60% Move Speed.

Morgana gains True Sight of all enemies affected by this Ability.

P.name: We Are More
P.tooltip:
Naafiri creates a Packmate every 10 seconds that will Attack enemies that she targets for (4% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage, increased to (5.2% bonus Attack Damage) after she uses an Ability.

Hitting champions and large monsters with Abilities reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 4 seconds. Killing enemies reduces it by 1 seconds.

Max Packmates: 5

Q.name: Darkin Daggers
Q.tooltip:
Naafiri hurls Darkin-tainted blades, dealing physical damage and inflicting a bleed, dealing physical damage over seconds.

Naafiri can Recast this Ability. If enemies hit are already bleeding from this Ability, it instead deals the remaining bleed damage plus between and physical damage, based on their missing Health. If that target was a champion or large monster, Naafiri restores Health.

Packmates will leap at the first champion or monster hit and attack them for seconds.



Executes lane minions and non-epic monsters below 30 health.

W.name: The Call of the Pack
W.tooltip:
Naafiri becomes Untargetable for 1 second and prepares to hunt, spawning 2 additional Packmates and gaining (20% Attack Damage) Attack Damage and 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Move Speed for 5 seconds.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri.

E.name: Eviscerate
E.tooltip:
Naafiri surges forward, dealing (15/25/35/45/55 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, then explodes in a flurry of blades, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri restoring 100% Health.

R.name: Hounds' Pursuit
R.tooltip:
Naafiri dashes at an enemy champion, dealing (125/200/275 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and briefly Slowing them. Packmates become Untargetable and dash alongside Naafiri, dealing (12.5/20/27.5 + (10% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage per Packmate.

If Naafiri scores a Takedown within 7 seconds she reveals nearby enemies and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants (100/150/200 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield for 3 seconds.




Briefly extends The Call of the Pack.

P.name: Surging Tides
P.tooltip: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions, they gain (100 + (25% Ability Power)) Move Speed, decaying over 1.5 seconds.

Q.name: Aqua Prison
Q.tooltip: Nami hurls a bubble, Stunning for 1.5 seconds and dealing (90/145/200/255/310 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage.

W.name: Ebb and Flow
W.tooltip:
Nami unleashes a stream of water that bounces between allied and enemy champions. Each champion can only be hit once, and it hits up to 3 targets.Restores (55/80/105/130/155 + (40% Ability Power)) Health to allies and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion. Deals (60/95/130/165/200 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies and will bounce to a nearby allied champion.
The damage and healing value is modified by (-20% + (0.15% Ability Power)) each bounce.

Can only bounce to visible enemies.

E.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
E.tooltip:
Nami empowers an allied champion's next 3 Attacks and Abilities for 6 seconds, causing them to Slow their targets by (15/20/25/30/35% + (0.05% Ability Power)) for 1s and deal an additional (20/35/50/65/80 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage.
