Deals (33% ~ 66%) damage to non-champions when empowering area of effect Abilities.

R.name: Tidal Wave
R.tooltip:
Nami summons a tidal wave, Knocking Up for 0.5 seconds, Slowing by 70%, and dealing (150/250/350 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. The duration of the Slow increases based on distance the wave traveled, up to 4 seconds.

Allies hit by the wave gain double the effect of Surging Tides.

The Slow has a minimum duration of 2 seconds.

P.name: Soul Eater
P.tooltip: Nasus has an additional Life Steal.

Q.name: Siphoning Strike
Q.tooltip:
Nasus' next Attack deals (40/60/80/100/120 + (100% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Killing an enemy with this Attack permanently increases its damage by 4, increased to 10 against champions, large minions and large jungle monsters.

This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
This Ability can critically strike for physical damage.

W.name: Wither
W.tooltip: Nasus ages a champion, Slowing them by 35%, increasing to 47/59/71/83/95% over 5 seconds. Their Attack Speed is also reduced by 75% of the Slow.

E.name: Spirit Fire
E.tooltip: Nasus ignites a spirit flame, dealing (50/80/110/140/170 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Enemies in the area lose 30/35/40/45/50% Armor and take (50/80/110/140/170 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage over 5 seconds.

R.name: Fury of the Sands
R.tooltip:
Nasus becomes empowered in the sandstorm for 15 seconds, increasing his maximum Health by 300/450/600 and Armor and Magic Resistance by 40/55/70.

While the storm rages, nearby enemies take (3/4/5% + (0.01% Ability Power)) of their maximum Health as magic damage each second and Siphoning Strike has a 50% reduced Cooldown.

The storm deals a max of 240 damage per second.

P.name: Staggering Blow
P.tooltip: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals (100% Attack Damage) physical damage and Roots them for (0.75 ~ 2) seconds.

Q.name: Dredge Line
Q.tooltip:
Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. If it hits an enemy, Nautilus drags himself and the target together, dealing (85/130/175/220/265 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage and Stunning them briefly. If the anchor hits terrain, Nautilus will drag himself towards it.

If Nautilus's hook hits terrain, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 50%, and 50% of the Mana cost is refunded.

W.name: Titan's Wrath
W.tooltip: Nautilus gains a (50/60/70/80/90 + (8/9/10/11/12% Health)) Shield for 6 seconds. While the Shield persists, Nautilus' Attacks deal an additional (30/40/50/60/70 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage over 2 seconds to his target and all surrounding enemies.

E.name: Riptide
E.tooltip:
Nautilus creates three exploding waves around himself, each dealing (55/90/125/160/195 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies in the area and Slows them by 30/35/40/45/50% decaying over 1.25 seconds.

Waves deal 50% less damage after the first.
This Ability deals (125/165/205/245/285 + (50% Ability Power)) bonus damage to jungle monsters the first time it hits.

R.name: Depth Charge
R.tooltip: Nautilus fires a shockwave that chases an enemy champion, dealing (150/275/400 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1/1.5/2 seconds. Other enemies hit by the shockwave are also Knocked Up and Stunned and take (125/175/225 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

P.name: Inherent Glamour
P.tooltip:
Neeko can disguise herself as other units on the map. At any time she can disguise as an allied champion, or Neeko can stand next to any allied or neutral unit to store their Sho'ma and be able to transform into it. Your disguise will break upon receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting a damaging spell, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar.

Neeko gains many of the properties of the units she turns into, negative and positive.

Q.name: Blooming Burst
Q.tooltip:
Neeko throws a seed that blooms to deal (60/110/160/210/260 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. If it kills a unit or hits a champion or large monster, it will bloom again, dealing (35/60/85/110/135 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage. Max 2 extra blooms.

Each bloom deals an additional 35/50/65/80/95 magic damage to monsters.

W.name: Shapesplitter
W.tooltip:
Passive: Every 3rd Attack deals an additional (30/65/100/135/170 + (60% Ability Power)) bonus magic damage and increases Neeko's Move Speed by 10/17.5/25/32.5/40% for 1 second.

Active: Neeko becomes invisible for 0.5 seconds and projects a clone that lasts 3 seconds. Neeko and the clone gain 20/25/30/35/40% Move Speed for 3 seconds.

The clone can be controlled using the Move Pet Click hotkey or by Recasting this Ability.
The clone mirrors her spellcasts, emotes, and recall.

The clone is untargetable while stealthed.
Empowered Attacks deal 75 bonus magic damage to monsters.

E.name: Tangle-Barbs
E.tooltip:
Neeko slings a tangle that deals (70/105/140/175/210 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage and Roots for 0.7/0.9/1.1/1.3/1.5 seconds.

The tangle becomes empowered after hitting an enemy, growing larger, moving faster, and Rooting for 1.8/2.1/2.4/2.7/3 seconds.

R.name: Pop Blossom
R.tooltip:
After a delay Neeko leaps into the air, Knocking Up all nearby enemies for 0.6 seconds. She then crashes down, dealing (150/350/550 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

This Ability can be prepared in secret if Neeko is disguised. 0.5 seconds after casting this ability Neeko breaks her disguise.

P.name: Prowl
P.tooltip:
Nidalee starts with a rank in Aspect of the Cougar.

Nidalee gains Move Speed for 2 seconds when entering Brush, increased to Move Speed while moving toward enemy champions.

Hitting champions or jungle monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack marks them as Hunted for 4 seconds. While an enemy is Hunted, they are revealed with True Sight and Nidalee gains Move Speed, increased to Move Speed toward the Hunted enemy.

Q.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
Q.tooltip: Human Form: Nidalee throws her javelin, dealing (70/90/110/130/150 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage, increased up to (227.5/292.5/357.5/422.5/487.5 + (162.5% Ability Power)) magic damage based on distance flown.

W.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
W.tooltip:
Human Form: Nidalee places an invisible trap for 2 minutes. When an enemy walks over it, they are dealt (10/20/30/40/50 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second for 4 seconds.

10 traps may be active at once.

E.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
E.tooltip: Human Form: Nidalee restores (50/75/100/125/150 + (35% Ability Power)) Health increased up to (50/75/100/125/150 + (35% Ability Power)) based on missing Health and grants them 30/40/50/60/70% Attack Speed for 7 seconds.

R.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
R.tooltip:
Passive: While in Human Form, applying Hunted refreshes this Ability's Cooldown.

Human Form: Nidalee transforms into Cougar Form, gaining melee Attacks and replacing her Active Abilities.

Cougar Form: Nidalee transforms into Human Form, gaining ranged Attacks and replacing her Active Abilities.

P.name: Joy Unending
P.tooltip:
When Nilah kills a minion, she and her nearest ally gain 50% of the experience they would have normally lost from sharing the kill.

Nilah gains 7.5% increased effectiveness from healing and 15% from shielding given to her by allied champions abilities. If an ally heals or shields her, they will also gain the increased amount of the shield or heal themselves. If an ally shields or heals themself, Nilah will also gain that additional effect.

Q.name: Formless Blade
Q.tooltip:
Passive: Nilah gains (30%) Armor Penetration, and her Attacks against champions restore (20%) damage dealt as Health. Overhealing from this is converted into a Shield for 4 seconds.

Active: Nilah cracks her whip-blade, dealing (0/10/20/30/40 + (100% Attack Damage)) physical damage. If an enemy unit or structure is hit, Nilah gains 125 Attack Range and (10 ~ 60)Attack Speed, and her Attacks hit in a cone for 4 seconds.


Damage is increased by her Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 70% effectiveness.
If cast during Slipstream, Nilah creates a wave of water striking all enemies along Nilah's path.
Area attacks deal 33% damage to minions and 100% damage to monsters.
This ability executes low Health minions.

W.name: Jubilant Veil
W.tooltip:
Nilah envelops herself in mist for 2.25 seconds, becoming Ghosted, gaining 15/17.5/20/22.5/25% Move Speed, dodging Attacks, and reducing magic damage taken by 25%.

While active, touching allied champions envelops them in mist, granting the same benefits for 1.5 seconds.


Ghosted units can pass through other units.

E.name: Slipstream
E.tooltip: Nilah dashes through a unit, dealing (60/70/80/90/100 + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to any enemies she passes through.

R.name: Apotheosis
R.tooltip:
Nilah whirls her whip-blade, dealing (60/100/140 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage over 1 second, then finishes with a burst of (125/225/325 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage that also Pulls nearby enemies toward her.

Apotheosis heals Nilah and her nearby allies for (20% + (10%)) ( + Formless Blade) of the damage dealt to enemy champions, converting any overhealing into a Shield for 6 seconds.

Healing is reduced to 10% against non-champions

P.name: Umbra Blades
P.tooltip:
Every 12 seconds, Nocturne's next Attack strikes all nearby enemies for (120% Attack Damage) physical damage and restores (30% Ability Power) Health per target hit.

Nocturne's Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second, increased to 3 against champions and jungle monsters.

Q.name: Duskbringer
Q.tooltip:
Nocturne throws a shadow blade, dealing (65/105/145/185/225 + (85% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and leaving a dusk trail for 5 seconds. Enemy champions hit also leave a trail.

While on the trail, Nocturne is Ghosted and gains 20/25/30/35/40% Move Speed and 15/25/35/45/55 Attack Damage.

Ghosted units can pass through other units.

W.name: Shroud of Darkness
W.tooltip:
Passive: Nocturne gains 30/35/40/45/50% Attack Speed.

Active: Nocturne creates a shadow barrier for 1.5 seconds that blocks the next enemy Ability. If an Ability is blocked, this Ability's passive effect is increased to 60/70/80/90/100% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

This Ability will remain active during Paranoia's flight.

E.name: Unspeakable Horror
E.tooltip:
Passive: Nocturne gains 90% Move Speed toward Feared enemies.

Active: Nocturne plants a nightmare tether into his target, dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage over 2 seconds. If the tether remains unbroken, the target is Feared for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2/2.25 second(s).

R.name: Paranoia
R.tooltip: Nocturne darkens the map, reducing the sight radius of all enemy champions and removing their vision of allies for 6 seconds. Nocturne can Recast this Ability during the duration to launch himself at an enemy champion dealing (150/275/400 + (120% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

P.name: Call of the Freljord
P.tooltip:
When Nunu and Willump deal damage to champions, large jungle monsters, or structures, they and a nearby ally gain 20% Attack Speed and 10% Move Speed for 4 seconds.

Willump's Attacks deal an additional (30% Attack Damage) physical damage to other nearby enemies while he has this buff.

Q.name: Consume
Q.tooltip:
Nunu asks Willump to take a bite of an enemy, dealing 400/600/800/1000/1200 true damage and restoring (65/95/125/155/185 + (10% bonus Health) + (90% Ability Power)) Health when used against a minion or jungle monster. Against a champion, it instead deals (60/100/140/180/220 + (5% bonus Health) + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage and restores (39/57/75/93/111 + (6% bonus Health) + (54% Ability Power)) Health.

The healing is increased by 50% when Nunu and Willump are below 50% Health.

W.name: Biggest Snowball Ever!
W.tooltip:
Nunu and Willump create a snowball that grows in size and speed as they roll it. They turn slower while rolling it, but can increase turning speed by holding the turn.

The snowball does between (59.94/74.925/89.91/104.895/119.88 + (49.95% Ability Power)) and (180/225/270/315/360 + (150% Ability Power)) magic damage, and Knocks Up for between 0.5 and 1.25 seconds when it collides with a champion, large monster or wall. These values scale up with distance rolled.

Nunu and Willump can Recast to let the snowball go early.

E.name: Snowball Barrage
E.tooltip:
Nunu throws three snowballs, dealing (15/22.5/30/37.5/45 + (12% Ability Power)) magic damage per snowball and Slowing enemies hit by all three by 30/35/40/45/50% for 1 second. Nunu can Recast this up to twice more.

After 3 seconds, Nunu Roots all nearby enemies that had been Slowed by the snowballs for (0.5 ~ 1.5) seconds and deals an additional (20/30/40/50/60 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Nunu can only Slow each enemy once with this Ability.

R.name: Absolute Zero
R.tooltip:
Nunu and Willump channel a powerful blizzard for up to 3 seconds. Enemies inside are Slowed by 50%, increasing to 95% over the duration. Nunu and Willump also gain (65/75/85 + (30/40/50% bonus Health) + (150% Ability Power)) Shield for the duration before decaying over 3 seconds afterwards.

When the blizzard ends, it detonates, dealing up to (625/925/1275 + (300% Ability Power)) magic damage based on channel time. Nunu and Willump can Recast to end the blizzard early.

P.name: Berserker Rage
P.tooltip: Olaf gains up to (50% ~ 100%) Attack Speed and (8% ~ 25%) Life Steal, based on his missing Health.

Q.name: Undertow
Q.tooltip:
Olaf throws an axe, dealing (70/120/170/220/270 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing by 30/35/40/45/50% for up to 3 seconds (based on distance travelled). Champions hit lose 20% Armor for 4 seconds.

If Olaf picks up the axe, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to 2.5 seconds, or fully refunded if 2.5 seconds has elapsed.

Deals 20/45/70/95/120 bonus damage to monsters.

W.name: Tough It Out
W.tooltip: Olaf gains 40/50/60/70/80% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, and 10/40/70/100/130 plus 17.5% missing Health Shield (up to a maximum of 10/40/70/100/130 Shield below 30% Health) for 2.5 seconds.

E.name: Reckless Swing
E.tooltip:
Olaf ferociously swings his axes, dealing (70/115/160/205/250 + (50% Attack Damage)) true damage. If the enemy dies, the cost is refunded.

Attacks lower the Cooldown of this Ability by 1 second, increased to 2 seconds when attacking monsters.

Cast time scales based on bonus Attack Speed.

R.name: Ragnarok
R.tooltip:
Passive: Olaf gains 10/15/20 Armor and 10/15/20 Magic Resist.

Active: Olaf cleanses all Immobilizing and Disabling effects on himself and becomes immune to them for 3 seconds. While active, Olaf gains (10/20/30 + (25% Attack Damage)) Attack Damage. Hitting a champion with an Attack or Reckless Swing extends the duration by 2.5 seconds.

Additionally, Olaf gains 20/45/70% Move Speed towards enemy champions for 1 second.

P.name: Clockwork Windup
P.tooltip:
Orianna's Abilities originate from her Ball. Orianna's Ball automatically returns to her if she is too far away from it.

Orianna's Attacks deal an additional (15% Ability Power) magic damage. Subsequent Attacks against the same target within 4 seconds deal an additional (2.25% Ability Power) magic damage (max of (15% Ability Power) damage).

Q.name: Command: Attack
Q.tooltip: Orianna commands her Ball to move to an area, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage to surrounding enemies and to enemies it passes through. Deals 30% less damage to all enemies after the first.

W.name: Command: Dissonance
W.tooltip:
Orianna commands her Ball to release an electric pulse, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage to surrounding enemies.

The pulse leaves behind an energy field for 3 seconds, Slowing enemies by 20/25/30/35/40% and granting allies 20/25/30/35/40% Move Speed, decaying over 2 seconds.

E.name: Command: Protect
E.tooltip:
Passive: The Ball adds 6/12/18/24/30 Armor and 6/12/18/24/30 Magic Resist to the allied champion it is attached to.

Active: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, granting them (55/90/125/160/195 + (45% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds. Enemies the Ball passes through take (60/90/120/150/180 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage.

R.name: Command: Shockwave
R.tooltip: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing (225/350/475 + (110% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies and Knocking them in the direction of the Ball.

P.name: Living Forge
P.tooltip:
Ornn gains an additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from all sources.

Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items anywhere.

Additionally, he can create masterwork items for himself and for his allies.

Q.name: Volcanic Rupture
Q.tooltip:
Ornn slams the ground, creating a fissure dealing (20/45/70/95/120 + (110% Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing by 40% for 2 seconds. A pillar of rock forms at the fissure's end for 4 seconds.

The fissure stops shortly after hitting an enemy champion.

W.name: Bellows Breath
W.tooltip:
Ornn stomps forward Unstoppably while breathing fire, dealing 12/13/14/15/16% max Health magic damage over 0.75 seconds. Enemies hit by the final bout of flame become Brittle for 3 seconds.

Immobilizing effects on Brittle targets have their duration increased by 30% and deal an additional (9% ~ 17%) max Health magic damage. Ornn's Attacks against Brittle targets Knock them Back, dealing the additional damage.

Deals a minimum of 80/130/180/230/280 magic damage to champions and minions, and a max of 260/320/380/440/500 magic damage to jungle monsters.

E.name: Searing Charge
E.tooltip:
Ornn charges, dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (40% bonus Armor) + (40% bonus Magic Resist)) physical damage. If Ornn rams into terrain, he creates a shockwave that Knocks Up enemies for 1.25 seconds and applies the same damage to those not hit by the charge.

Ornn's charge destroys magma pillars and terrain created by enemies.

R.name: Call of the Forge God
R.tooltip:
Ornn summons a massive lava elemental, which stampedes towards him, dealing (125/175/225 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage, applying Brittle to, and Slowing enemies hit by 40/50/60% for 3 seconds.

Ornn can Recast to dash with a headbutt. If he dashes into the elemental, he redirects and empowers it, causing it to Knock Up the first champion for 1 second and subsequent champions for 0.5 seconds. The elemental also deals (125/175/225 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage and reapplies Brittle.

P.name: Mortal Will
P.tooltip: After using 5 Abilities or Attacks, Pantheon empowers his next basic Ability.

Q.name: Comet Spear
Q.tooltip:
Tap: Pantheon thrusts his spear, dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (115% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies hit. Refunds 60% of this Ability's Cooldown.

Hold: Pantheon hurls his spear, dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (115% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage to the first enemy hit and 50% less to further targets.

This Ability is enhanced against enemies below 20% Health to deal (230% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage instead.

Mortal Will Bonus: Deals an additional (115% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage.

Deals 80% damage to monsters.
Deals 70% damage to minions.

W.name: Shield Vault
W.tooltip:
Pantheon leaps on his target, Stunning for 1 second and dealing (6/6.5/7/7.5/8% + (0.004% bonus Health) + (0.015% Ability Power)) max Health physical damage.

Mortal Will Bonus: Pantheon's next Attack strikes 3 times, dealing a total of physical damage.

Deals a minimum of 60 and a maximum of 150 damage to Minions and Monsters.

E.name: Aegis Assault
E.tooltip:
Pantheon braces his shield and engages enemies in a chosen direction for 1.5 seconds, becoming immune to non-tower damage from that direction and dealing (100% Attack Damage) physical damage over the duration. After channeling Pantheon slams with his shield, dealing (55/105/155/205/255 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

Mortal Will Bonus: When Pantheon slams his shield he gains (2.5% bonus Health) Armor and (2.5% bonus Health) Magic Resist for 4 seconds, and 60% Move Speed for 1.5 seconds.


Recast to end early (Pantheon still slams with his shield as the last hit).
Damage to minions is reduced by 50%.

R.name: Grand Starfall
R.tooltip:
Passive: Pantheon gains 10/20/30% Armor Penetration.

Active: Pantheon gathers his strength to leap high into the air. He throws his spear from above which in a small area deals physical damage and Slows by 50% for 2 seconds.

Pantheon then crashes down as a meteor at the target area. Deals up to (300/500/700 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies in a line (decreased by up to 50% at the edges of the area).

This Ability instantly readies Mortal Will.

P.name: Iron Ambassador
P.tooltip:
Every 6 seconds, Poppy's next Attack throws her buckler, gaining 350 range and dealing an additional (20 ~ 180) magic damage. The buckler ricochets off the target, landing nearby. Poppy can pick it up to gain Shield, and enemies can step on it to destroy it.

The buckler automatically returns to Poppy if it kills the target.

Q.name: Hammer Shock
Q.tooltip:
Poppy smashes the ground, dealing (30/55/80/105/130 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 7/7.5/8/8.5/9% max Health physical damage and making the ground unstable.

The unstable area Slows enemies by (20/23/26/29/32% + (0.008% bonus Health))and erupts after 1 second, dealing (30/55/80/105/130 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 7/7.5/8/8.5/9% max Health physical damage again.

Percent Health damage deals a max of 85/120/155/190/225 damage to minions and jungle monsters per hit.

W.name: Steadfast Presence
W.tooltip:
Passive: Poppy gains (16% Armor) Armor and (16% Magic Resist) Magic Resist. This bonus is doubled if Poppy is below 40% Health.

Active: Poppy gains 40% Move Speed and projects a field around her for 2 seconds that stops enemy dashes. Enemies who are stopped by the field are Grounded and Slowed by 25% for 2 seconds and take (70/110/150/190/230 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

E.name: Heroic Charge
E.tooltip: Poppy tackles an enemy, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and carrying them forward. If Poppy tackles them into terrain, the enemy is Stunned for 1.6/1.7/1.8/1.9/2 seconds and take an additional (40/60/80/100/120 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

R.name: Keeper's Verdict
R.tooltip:
Begin Casting: Poppy begins charging her hammer for up to 4 seconds, Slowing herself by 15%.

Release: Poppy smashes the ground, creating a shockwave that deals (200/300/400 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first champion hit and surrounding enemies, Knocks them Back towards their Nexus, and makes them Untargetable while they fly. The range and Knock Back distance increase with charge duration.

An uncharged swing deals (100/150/200 + (45% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Knocks Up for 1 seconds.

Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them.

P.name: Gift of the Drowned Ones
P.tooltip:
Pyke stores (9% + (0.2%)) of damage taken from champions, increased to (40% + (0.4%)) when there's more than one enemy nearby. Pyke can store up to (80 + (800% bonus Attack Damage)) damage. While unseen by enemies, he rapidly regenerates this stored damage.

Additionally, Pyke converts all Maximum Health increases to Attack Damage instead at a rate of 14 Health to 1 Attack Damage.

Q.name: Bone Skewer
Q.tooltip:
Tap: Pyke stabs, dealing (100/150/200/250/300 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit, preferring champions. They are then Slowed by 90% for 1 second.

Hold: Pyke throws his harpoon, dealing (100/150/200/250/300 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit and Pulling them towards him. They are then Slowed by 90% for 1 second.

If Pyke successfully hits an enemy champion or the channel does not complete successfully, 75% of the Mana cost is refunded.

W.name: Ghostwater Dive
W.tooltip:
Pyke gains Camouflage and (45 + (200%))Move Speed decaying over 5 seconds.

Move Speed scales with Lethality.
Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.

E.name: Phantom Undertow
E.tooltip:
Pyke dashes, leaving a drowned phantom behind him that returns to him shortly. The phantom Stuns for (1.25 + (1%)) seconds and deals (100/150/200/250/300 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to champions.

Stun duration scales with Lethality.

R.name: Death From Below
R.tooltip:
Pyke strikes all enemy champions in an X, teleporting to and executing targets below (250 + (80% bonus Attack Damage) + (150%)) Health. Champions above the threshold and non-champions instead take physical damage equal to 50% of that amount ((125 + (40% bonus Attack Damage) + (75%))).

When an enemy champion dies inside the X, Pyke can Recast this Ability for free within 20 seconds. If he executed that champion, the last assisting ally will also get kill gold. If he did not, he will still get kill gold as if he did.


Total gold shared with allies:
Total gold kept for self:

P.name: Royal Privilege
P.tooltip:
Qiyana's Attacks and Abilities deal an additional (15 + (25% bonus Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) bonus physical damage. This effect has a 25 second per-target Cooldown.

Using to gain a different weapon Enchantment resets this effect's Cooldown on all targets.

Q.name: Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal
Q.tooltip:
If Qiyana does not have an Enchantment, she slashes, dealing (80/110/140/170/200 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies in a small area. If she does, this Ability gains extra range and an additional effect based on the type of Enchantment:Ice Enchantment: Briefly Roots, then Slows by 20% for 1 second.Rock Enchantment: Deals an additional (80/110/140/170/200 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to units below 50% Health.Wild Enchantment: Leaves a trail that turns Qiyana Invisible and grants 20% Move Speed.


Enemies beyond the first take 75% physical damage instead.
This Ability deals 160% damage to jungle monsters.
Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight.

W.name: Terrashape
W.tooltip:
Passive: While Qiyana's weapon is Enchanted, she gains 15/20/25/30/35% Attack Speed and her Attacks deal an additional (8/16/24/32/40 + (45% Ability Power) + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage. She also gains 3/5/7/9/11% Move Speed while out of combat near the corresponding terrain type.

Active: Qiyana dashes towards a nearby brush, terrain, or river and Enchants her weapon with that particular terrain type. This refreshes Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal's Cooldown.

E.name: Audacity
E.tooltip:
Qiyana dashes through an enemy and deals (50/90/130/170/210 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to them.

If Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal is cast while this Ability is targeting a champion, Qiyana will automatically aim it at her target.

R.name: Supreme Display of Talent
R.tooltip:
Qiyana launches a shockwave that Knocks Back enemies and detonates when it hits terrain. The explosion follows the entire edge of the terrain, Stunning for between 0.5 and 1 seconds and dealing (100/200/300 + (125% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 10% max Health physical damage. Stun duration scales down with distance the shockwave has travelled.

Any river or brush the shockwave passes through also explode after a delay for the same damage and Stun.

P.name: Harrier
P.tooltip: Every seconds, Valor marks a nearby enemy with Harrier, revealing it for 4 seconds and causing Quinn's next Attack On-Hit against them to deal (40% bonus Attack Damage) bonus physical damage.

Q.name: Blinding Assault
Q.tooltip:
Quinn orders Valor to dive, making the first enemy hit with Harrier, reducing their vision radius for 1.75 seconds and dealing (65/100/135/170/205 + (80/85/90/95/100% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage to all surrounding enemies.

If the first enemy struck is not a champion, it is Disarmed for 1.75 seconds.

Deals 100% increased damage to Monsters ((65/100/135/170/205 + (80/85/90/95/100% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power))).

W.name: Heightened Senses
W.tooltip:
Passive: Attacking a Harrier target grants Quinn 28/41/54/67/80% Attack Speed and 20/25/30/35/40% Move Speed for 2 seconds.

Active: Valor reveals a large area nearby for 2 seconds.

E.name: Vault
E.tooltip: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing (40/65/90/115/140 + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and marking them with Harrier. Quinn then leaps backwards from the target, slightly Knocking them Back and Slowing them by 50%, decaying over 1.5 seconds.

R.name: Behind Enemy Lines
R.tooltip:
Quinn calls to Valor, pairing up after channeling for 2 seconds gaining 70/100/130% Move Speed and allowing her to Recast this Ability. Attacking or using Blinding Assault or Vault automatically Recasts this Ability.

Recast: Quinn and Valor perform an aerial maneuver, dealing (60/90/120 + (35% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, marking champions with Harrier, and ending this Ability.

Being damaged by non-minions removes the Move Speed bonus for 3 seconds.

P.name: Fey Feathers
P.tooltip:
Every 40 seconds, Rakan gains (95% Ability Power) Shield. Rakan's Attacks and Abilities against enemy champions reduce this Cooldown by 1 second.

Lover's Leap - Xayah and Rakan can recall together.

Q.name: Gleaming Quill
Q.tooltip:
Rakan flings a magical feather that deals (70/115/160/205/250 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit.

If the feather hits a champion or epic jungle monster, Rakan restores (55% Ability Power) Health to himself and nearby allies after 3 seconds or when he touches an allied champion.

W.name: Grand Entrance
W.tooltip: Rakan dashes, then spirals into the air, Knocking Up for 1 second and dealing (70/120/170/220/270 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

E.name: Battle Dance
E.tooltip:
Rakan dashes to an allied champion, granting them (50/75/100/125/150 + (70% Ability Power)) Shield for 3 seconds.

Rakan can Recast this Ability once within 5 seconds.

Cast range is increased when cast on Xayah.

R.name: The Quickness
R.tooltip: Rakan gains 75% Move Speed for 4 seconds. Rakan deals (100/200/300 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Charms enemies for 1/1.25/1.5 second(s) the first time he touches them. The first champion touched grants Rakan 150% decaying Move Speed.

P.name: Spiked Shell
P.tooltip: Rammus gains ((15% Armor) + (15% Magic Resist)) Attack Damage.

Q.name: Powerball
Q.tooltip:
Rammus curls into a ball, gaining (25% ~ 39.1%) Move Speed, accelerating up to 150/234.6% Move Speed over 6 seconds. Rammus stops after colliding with an enemy, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage, Knocking Back, and Slowing nearby enemies by 40/50/60/70/80% for 1 second.

Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.

W.name: Defensive Ball Curl
W.tooltip:
Rammus enters a defensive formation for 7 seconds, gaining (30/37.5/45/52.5/60% Armor) Armor and (30/37.5/45/52.5/60% Magic Resist) Magic Resist and dealing (15 + (10% Armor) + (10% Magic Resist)) magic damage to enemies that Attack him.

Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.

E.name: Frenzying Taunt
E.tooltip: Rammus Taunts an enemy champion or monster for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 seconds. Monsters are dealt (80/100/120/140/160 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

R.name: Soaring Slam
R.tooltip:
Rammus hops into the air and slams down in an area, dealing (150/250/350 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 30/40/50% for 1.5 seconds. If used during Powerball, enemies in the center take an additional magic damage and are Knocked Up for 0.75 seconds.

Rammus then creates 3 aftershocks in the area over 3.5 seconds, repeating the Slow.

The range of this Ability is increased by Rammus's Move Speed.

This Ability deals 200% damage to turrets.

P.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
P.tooltip:
Rek'Sai generates 25 Fury when she Attacks and 25 Fury from Abilities.

While Burrowed, she consumes her Fury to restore up to Health over 3 seconds, increasing with level.

Q.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
Q.tooltip:
Unburrowed: Rek'Sai's next 3 Attacks within 3 seconds gain 35% Attack Speed and deal an additional (30/35/40/45/50% Attack Damage) physical damage to nearby enemies. Attacks refresh the duration of this Ability.

The bonus damage can critically strike the primary target.

W.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
W.tooltip: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining access to new Abilities but cannot Attack. She gains 5/10/15/20/25 Move Speed, 65% reduced vision range, and nearby enemies that move and are otherwise unseen will have their positions revealed to Rek'sai and her allies.

E.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
E.tooltip: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai bites a target, dealing physical damage. At max Fury, the bite deals true damage instead.

R.name: Void Rush
R.tooltip: Rek'Sai targets an enemy damaged by her in the last 5 seconds and then dives underground, becoming Untargetable. Moments later, she leaps unstoppably at her target, dealing (150/250/350 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 15/20/25% max Health physical damage and resets the cooldown of Burrow / Un-burrow.

P.name: Break the Mold
P.tooltip: Rell's Attacks and Abilities steal 3% Armor and 3% Magic Resist for 5 seconds. Max: 15%. Basic attacks deal ((5% Armor) + (5% Magic Resist)) magic damage on-hit.

Q.name: Shattering Strike
Q.tooltip:
Rell thrusts her lance, Stunning targets for 0.65 seconds, destroying all Shields, and dealing (60/100/140/180/220 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Does not break Shields on monsters.

W.name: Ferromancy: Crash Down
W.tooltip:
Passive - Mounted Alacrity: Rell gains Move Speed while mounted.

Active - Ferromancy: Crash Down: Rell leaps off her mount, Knocking Up enemies and dealing magic damage. Rell gains Shield, which lasts until she remounts.

Rell then enters her armored form, gaining increased Armor and Magic Resist, Attack Speed and Attack Range. In this armored form, she can use Ferromancy: Mount Up.

E.name: Full Tilt
E.tooltip:
Rell and an ally charge, gaining 15% Move Speed, increased to 30% when facing enemy champions or each other for 3 seconds. Rell's next Attack or Shattering Strike explodes in an area for (5/5.5/6/6.5/7% + (0.03% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage.

Damage capped at (150 ~ 300) against jungle monsters and structures.

R.name: Magnet Storm
R.tooltip: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies towards herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies towards herself and deals (150/250/350 + (110% Ability Power)) magic damage over the next 2 seconds.

P.name: Leverage
P.tooltip:
Renata's Attacks mark enemies for 6 seconds and deal an additional (1.13% + (0.02% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage if they were unmarked.

Allied champions' Attacks or Abilities consume the mark, dealing (1.13% + (0.02% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage.

Renata may only have one target marked at a time.

Q.name: Handshake
Q.tooltip:
Renata sends out a missile from her arm, Rooting the first enemy hit for 1 second and dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Recast: Renata Pulls the enemy in a direction, dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies they are thrown into and Stunning for 0.5 seconds if the thrown enemy is a champion.

W.name: Bailout
W.tooltip:
Renata infuses an ally champion, granting (10/15/20/25/30% + (0.01% Ability Power)) Attack Speed and (10/12.5/15/17.5/20% + (0.01% Ability Power)) Move Speed towards enemies, increasing to (20/30/40/50/60% + (0.02% Ability Power)) Attack Speed and (20/25/30/35/40% + (0.02% Ability Power)) Move Speed over 5 seconds. Takedowns refresh the duration of the buff.

If the ally would die, they instead return to full Health, which then decays over 3 seconds.

If they get a Takedown while decaying, they will be set to 20% max Health and stop decaying.

The Champion's death can be delayed by healing or similar effects while in the decaying state, but cannot be prevented unless the Champion gets a Takedown. Champions can only delay their death once.

E.name: Loyalty Program
E.tooltip: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, dealing (65/95/125/155/185 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing surrounding enemies and enemies hit by 30% for 2 seconds. Allies hit gain (50/65/80/95/110 + (50% Ability Power)) Shield for 3 seconds.

R.name: Hostile Takeover
R.tooltip:
Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, Berserking enemies for 1.25/1.75/2.25 seconds, causing them to Attack the nearest unit, prioritizing their allies.

While Berserk, enemies gain 100% Attack Speed.

P.name: Reign of Anger
P.tooltip:
Renekton gains 5 Fury per Attack. While above 50 Fury, his next Ability spends it to become empowered. Fury decays while out of combat.

While below 50% Health, Renekton gains 50% increased Fury.

Q.name: Cull the Meek
Q.tooltip:
Renekton swings his blade, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and restoring (2/3/4/5/6 + (2% bonus Attack Damage)) Health per non-champion and (12/20/28/36/44 + (17% bonus Attack Damage)) per champion hit. He also generates 2.5 Fury per non-champion and 10 Fury per champion.

Fury Bonus: Damage is increased to (90/135/180/225/270 + (140% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and healing is increased to (6/9/12/15/18 + (6% bonus Attack Damage)) Health against non-champions and (36/60/84/108/132 + (51% bonus Attack Damage)) Health against champions. Does not generate any Fury.

Max 30 Fury per cast.
Restores up to 50/75/100/125/150 Health on basic casts.
Restores up to 200/300/400/500/600 Health on empowered casts.

W.name: Ruthless Predator
W.tooltip:
Renekton's next Attack strikes twice, Stunning for 0.75 seconds and dealing a total of (10/40/70/100/130 + (150% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Hitting a champion generates an additional 10 Fury.

Fury Bonus: Renekton Attacks 3 times instead, destroying Shields before dealing (15/60/105/150/195 + (225% Attack Damage)) physical damage and Stunning for 1.5 seconds. Does not generate any Fury.

All Attacks apply On-hit effects separately.
Does not break shields on monsters.

E.name: Slice and Dice
E.tooltip:
Renekton dashes, dealing (40/70/100/130/160 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. He generates 2 Fury per non-champion and 10 Fury per champion hit. Hitting at least one enemy allows Renekton to Recast this Ability once for 4 seconds.

Fury Bonus: The Recast dash deals (70/115/160/205/250 + (135% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage instead and removes 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% Armor for 4 seconds. Does not generate Fury.

Max 30 Fury per cast.

R.name: Dominus
R.tooltip: Renekton surrounds himself with dark energies for 15 seconds, gaining 300/500/700 max Health and 20 Fury. While active, he deals (60/150/240 + (10% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage and gains 5 Fury per second.

P.name: Unseen Predator
P.tooltip:
While in Brush, Rengar leaps to enemies he Attacks.

Rengar generates 1 Ferocity when he uses a non-ultimate Ability. At the start of the leap Unseen Predator will generate 1 Ferocity if none of his current Ferocity was generated this way.

At 4 Ferocity, his next non-ultimate Ability is empowered. Casting an empowered Ability grants Rengar 70% Move Speed for 1.5 seconds.

Unique takedowns increase Rengar's Attack Damage from Bonetooth Necklace.

Q.name: Savagery
Q.tooltip:
Rengar's next 2 Attacks gain 40% Attack Speed. The first Attack deals (20/55/90/125/160 + (100% Attack Damage) + (5% Attack Damage)) physical damage.

Max Ferocity: The first Attack deals (35 + (100% Attack Damage) + (20% Attack Damage)) physical damage and grants Rengar 50% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

W.name: Battle Roar
W.tooltip:
Rengar roars, dealing (50/80/110/140/170 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies and restoring 50% of the damage taken in the last 1.5 seconds as Health.

Max Ferocity: Deals (80% Ability Power) magic damage and additionally cleanses Rengar of crowd control.

Deals an additional (65 ~ 130) magic damage to jungle monsters. Restores 100% of damage taken from jungle monsters.

E.name: Bola Strike
E.tooltip:
Rengar throws a bola, dealing (55/100/145/190/235 + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit, revealing and Slowing them by 30/45/60/75/90% for 1.75 seconds.

Max Ferocity: Deals (50 + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Roots for 1.75 seconds.

Reveals enemies for 2 seconds.
Bola Strike has no cast time when leaping.

R.name: Thrill of the Hunt
R.tooltip:
Passive: Rengar will also leap Attack when Camouflaged.

Active: Rengar gains 40/50/60% Move Speed and True Sight in a small area around the nearest enemy champion for 12/16/20 seconds.

After 2 seconds, Rengar becomes Camouflaged and can leap without being in Brush. Leaping to the nearest champion deals an additional (100% Attack Damage) physical damage, shreds 15/20/25 Armor for 4 seconds, and ends this Ability.

Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.

P.name: Runic Blade
P.tooltip: Using an Ability grants Riven a charge for 6 seconds (max 3). Her Attacks spend a charge to deal an additional physical damage.

Q.name: Broken Wings
Q.tooltip:
Riven dashes forward, dealing (45/75/105/135/165 + (60/65/70/75/80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. She can Recast this Ability twice. The first Recast is the same as the original, but the second has a different effect:

Recast: Riven leaps forward and slams, dealing (45/75/105/135/165 + (60/65/70/75/80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Knocks Up nearby enemies for 0.75 seconds.

Only the last use of this Ability can cross terrain.
Riven targets the unit your cursor is on, or dashes forward if there is no target.

W.name: Ki Burst
W.tooltip: Riven's sword emits a burst of runic energy, dealing (65/95/125/155/185 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Stunning for 0.75 seconds.

E.name: Valor
E.tooltip:
Riven quickly dashes and gains (70/95/120/145/170 + (110% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield for 1.5 seconds.

This dash cannot go over terrain.

R.name: Blade of the Exile
R.tooltip:
Riven's weapon surges with spiritual energy, granting her (20% Attack Damage) Attack Damage and increased range on damaging Abilities and Attacks for 15 seconds. While active, she can Recast.

Recast: Riven fires a wind slash that deals between (100/150/200 + (55% bonus Attack Damage)) and (300/450/600 + (165% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, based on their missing Health.

Gains 75 Attack Range

P.name: Junkyard Titan
P.tooltip:
Rumble's Abilities generate Heat. While above 50 Heat, he enters the Danger Zone, causing his basic Abilities to gain bonus effects. When he reaches 150 Heat, he overheats for 4 seconds.

While overheated, Rumble Silences himself, but gains (50% ~ 130%) Attack Speed and causes his Attacks to deal an additional (25% Ability Power) plus 4% max Health magic damage.

Percent damage is limited to (65 ~ 150) damage on Monsters.

Q.name: Flamespitter
Q.tooltip:
Rumble ignites his flamethrower, dealing (50/75/100/125/150 + (105% Ability Power)) plus 6/6.5/7/7.5/8% max Health magic damage over 3 seconds, reduced to 70% against minions.

Danger Zone: Damage is increased to (75/112.5/150/187.5/225 + (157.5% Ability Power)) plus 9/9.75/10.5/11.25/12% max Health.

Percent damage is limited to (65 ~ 300) damage on Monsters.

W.name: Scrap Shield
W.tooltip:
Rumble tosses up a barrier, gaining (25/55/85/115/145 + (30% Ability Power) + (4% Health)) Shield for 1.5 seconds and 10/15/20/25/30% Move Speed for 1 second.

Danger Zone: The barrier grants (37.5/82.5/127.5/172.5/217.5 + (45% Ability Power) + (6% Health)) Shield and 15/22.5/30/37.5/45% Move Speed instead.

E.name: Electro Harpoon
E.tooltip:
Rumble launches an electrified harpoon, dealing (55/80/105/130/155 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage, Slowing by 15/20/25/30/35% for 2 seconds, and reducing the enemy's Magic Resist by 10/12/14/16/18% for 4 seconds.

Hitting an enemy who's already Slowed by this Ability increases the Slow to 30/40/50/60/70% and reduces the enemy's Magic Resist by 20/24/28/32/36%

Danger Zone: The harpoon deals (82.5/120/157.5/195/232.5 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage instead and the Slow and reduced Magic Resist are increased by 50%.

R.name: The Equalizer
R.tooltip:
Rumble launches a line of rockets, creating a burning trail that lasts 4.5 seconds, Slowing by 35% and dealing (120/200/280 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per second.

Rumble can control the direction of the trail by clicking and dragging while casting this Ability.

P.name: Arcane Mastery
P.tooltip: Ryze gains (10% Ability Power)max Mana. His Abilities do additional damage based on his bonus Mana.

Q.name: Overload
Q.tooltip:
Passive: Rune Prison and Spell Flux refresh this Ability's Cooldown and charge a rune for 4 seconds (max 2 runes).

Active: Ryze unleashes a blast, dealing (75/95/115/135/155 + (55% Ability Power) + (2% bonus Mana)) magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the target has Flux on it, it is consumed, causing this Ability to deal increased damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.

Ryze also discharges all runes, granting Ryze 28/32/36/40/44% Move Speed for 2 seconds if 2 runes were charged.

W.name: Rune Prison
W.tooltip: Ryze deals (60/90/120/150/180 + (60% Ability Power) + (3% bonus Mana)) magic damage and Slows by 50% for 1.5 seconds. If the target has Flux, it is consumed and this Ability Roots instead of Slowing.

E.name: Spell Flux
E.tooltip: Ryze fires an orb, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (50% Ability Power) + (2% bonus Mana)) magic damage and applies Flux for 4 seconds to the target and nearby enemies. Enemies already afflicted with Flux will cause it to spread further.

R.name: Realm Warp
R.tooltip:
Passive: Overload damage bonus against targets with Flux increased to 50/75/100%.

Active: Ryze opens a portal to another location. After 2 seconds, all allies near the portal are teleported to that location.

If Ryze becomes Immobilized or Disabled, the portal is cancelled.

P.name: Daredevil Impulse
P.tooltip:
Samira builds a combo by dealing damage with Attacks or Abilities against enemy champions unique from the previous one. Each one increases her Style, from "E" to "S" grade (6 total). Samira gains 3.5% Move Speed per grade.

Samira's Attacks and Abilities in melee range deal an additional 2 magic damage, increased up to 4 based on the target's missing Health.

Samira's Attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her Attack Range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up for at least 0.5 seconds.

Q.name: Flair
Q.tooltip:
Samira fires a shot, dealing (0/5/10/15/20 + (110% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit.

If this Ability is cast towards an enemy in melee range, Samira will instead slash with her sword, dealing (0/5/10/15/20 + (110% Attack Damage)) physical damage.

Either hit can critically strike for (0/5/10/15/20 + (110% Attack Damage)) damage and applies Life Steal at 100% effectiveness.
If cast during Wild Rush, Samira will strike all enemies in her path upon completion.

W.name: Blade Whirl
W.tooltip: Samira slashes around her for 0.75 seconds, damaging enemies twice for (20/35/50/65/80 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage each and destroying any enemy missiles that enter the area.

E.name: Wild Rush
E.tooltip:
Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through dealing (50/60/70/80/90 + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage and gaining 20/25/30/35/40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

If an enemy champion is killed within 3 seconds of Samira damaging them, This Ability's Cooldown is reset.

R.name: Inferno Trigger
R.tooltip:
Samira can only use this Ability if her current Style rating is S. Using this Ability consumes all Style rating.

Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her 10 times over 2 seconds, each shot dealing (20/40/60 + (30% Attack Damage)) physical damage and applying Life Steal at 100% effectiveness. Each shot can also critically strike.

This Ability deals 25% damage to minions.

P.name: Fury of the North
P.tooltip:
Sejuani becomes immune to Slows and gains (10 + (75% bonus Armor)) Armor and (10 + (75% bonus Magic Resist)) Magic Resist after not taking damage from champions or large jungle monsters for (12 ~ 6) seconds.

Sejuani's first Attack against enemies she has Stunned deals an additional 10% max Health magic damage.

Q.name: Arctic Assault
Q.tooltip: Sejuani charges, dealing (90/140/190/240/290 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies and Knocking them Up for 0.5 seconds. The charge ends after hitting an enemy champion.

W.name: Winter's Wrath
W.tooltip:
Sejuani swings her flail, dealing (5/15/25/35/45 + (30% Ability Power) + (4% Health)) physical damage and Knocking Back minions and jungle monsters. She then lashes out again, dealing (5/25/45/65/85 + (60% Ability Power) + (8% Health)) physical damage and briefly Slowing targets.

Both swings apply stacks of Permafrost.

E.name: Permafrost
E.tooltip:
Passive: Nearby melee allied champions' Attacks apply a stack to champions and jungle monsters.

Active: Sejuani deals (55/105/155/205/255 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage to target enemy with 4 stacks and Stuns them for 1 second.

Champions Stunned by Sejuani can't gain stacks for 8 seconds.
Enemies Stunned by this Ability are slightly Knocked Back.
Permafrost will target the closest valid enemy to your cursor (prioritizing champions).
This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

R.name: Glacial Prison
R.tooltip:
Sejuani throws her True Ice bola, Stunning and revealing the first enemy champion hit for 1 second and dealing (125/150/175 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

If the bola travels at least 25% of its range, it Stuns and reveals for 1.5 seconds instead. It then also creates an ice storm that Slows surrounding enemies by 80% for 2 seconds. All affected enemies take (200/300/400 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

The Stunned enemy takes damage immediately, while enemies inside the storm take damage after it ends. Enemies in the storm are also Slowed for an additional 1 second.

P.name: Absolution
P.tooltip:
Senna can attack souls that spawn from dead enemies to absorb their Mist. She can also siphon Mist from enemy champions she hits with Attacks or Abilities twice, dealing an additional 1% current Health physical damage.

Each stack of Mist grants 0.75 Attack Damage. Every 20 stacks grant 20 Attack Range and 10% Critical Strike Chance but she only has (100%) Critical Strike Damage. 35% of excess Critical Strike Chance is converted into Lifesteal.

Senna's Attacks take extra time to fire, deal an additional (20% Attack Damage) physical damage, and briefly grant her 20% of the target's Move Speed.

Q.name: Piercing Darkness
Q.tooltip:
Senna shoots a bolt of piercing shadow through an ally or enemy, dealing (30/55/80/105/130 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies and Slowing them by (15% + (0.07% Ability Power) + (0.15% bonus Attack Damage)) for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 second(s). Restores (40/60/80/100/120 + (35% Ability Power) + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) Health to allied champions.

Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second.

This Ability's cast range matches Senna's attack range and its cast time is improved with Attack Speed. It can target anything and applies on-hit effects to enemy champions.

W.name: Last Embrace
W.tooltip: Senna sends forth the Black Mist, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit. After a 1 second delay the target and other nearby enemies are Rooted for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2/2.25 second(s).

E.name: Curse of the Black Mist
E.tooltip:
Senna dissolves into a cloud of Black Mist for 6/6.5/7/7.5/8 seconds, becoming a Wraith. Allied champions who enter the Mist are Camouflaged and become Wraiths when they leave. Wraiths gain (20% + (0.05% Ability Power)) Move Speed, are Unselectable, and hide their identities as long as no enemy champions are nearby.

Enemies can see where Wraiths are, but not who they are. They are otherwise treated as being Camouflaged.
Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.
Unselectable units cannot be targeted by Attacks or Abilities that require a target.

R.name: Dawning Shadow
R.tooltip:
Senna fires a beam of light that deals (250/400/550 + (70% Ability Power) + (115% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to all enemy champions hit. Allied champions hit in a wider area receive (120/160/200 + (50% Ability Power)) Shield for 3 seconds.

The shield's power scales with the amount of Mist Senna has collected.

P.name: Stage Presence
P.tooltip:
Every third basic Ability Seraphine casts will echo, automatically casting a second time.

Additionally, Seraphine draws inspiration from the music within her allies, creating a Note for each nearby ally whenever she casts an Ability. For each Note, Seraphine's Attacks gain 25 Attack Range and deal an additional (4% Ability Power) magic damage and consume the Notes.

Q.name: High Note
Q.tooltip: Seraphine projects a pure note, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage, increased against champions and monsters by the target's missing Health percentage up to (105/148.75/192.5/236.25/280 + (70% Ability Power)) damage below 25% Health.

W.name: Surround Sound
W.tooltip:
Seraphine spurs her nearby allied champions in song, granting them (8% + (0.01% Ability Power)) Move Speed, herself (20% + (0.02% Ability Power)) decaying Move Speed and both (60/80/100/120/140 + (20% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds.

If Seraphine is already Shielded, she calls out to her allies to join her, restoring 8/10/12/14/16% missing Health to them after a 2.5 second delay.

This Ability only heals once, even if cast twice.

E.name: Beat Drop
E.tooltip:
Seraphine unleashes a heavy soundwave, dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies in a line and Slowing them by 99% for 1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 seconds.

Enemies that are already Slowed are Rooted instead, and Immobilized enemies are Stunned.

Deals 70% damage against minions.

R.name: Encore
R.tooltip:
Seraphine takes the stage, projecting a captivating force that Charms for 1.25/1.5/1.75 seconds and deals (150/200/250 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Any champions struck (including allies) become part of the performance, extending the range of this Ability. Allied champions gain maximum Notes.

P.name: Pit Grit
P.tooltip:
Sett's Attacks alternate between left and right punches. Right punches follow the left quickly and deal an additional (55% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage.

Sett gains 2 Health Regeneration for each 5% missing Health.

Q.name: Knuckle Down
Q.tooltip:
Sett itches for a fight, gaining 30% Move Speed towards enemy champions for 1.5 seconds.

Additionally Sett's next two Attacks deal an additional 10/20/30/40/50 plus (1% + (0.01/0.02/0.02/0.03/0.03% Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage.

The Attacks are always a left and right punch. Deals a max of 400 damage to monsters per punch.

W.name: Haymaker
W.tooltip:
Passive: Sett stores 100% of damage taken as Grit, up to (50% Health). Grit decays quickly 4 seconds after the damage was taken.

Active: Sett consumes all Grit, gaining a 100% Grit consumed Shield decaying over 3 seconds. Sett then delivers a massive punch, dealing 80/100/120/140/160 plus (25% + (0.25% bonus Attack Damage)) Grit consumed true damage to enemies in the center (max damage). Enemies not in the center instead take physical damage.

E.name: Facebreaker
E.tooltip:
Sett smashes enemies on either side of him into each other, dealing (50/70/90/110/130 + (60% Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing them by 70% for 0.5 seconds. If Sett grabbed at least one enemy on each side, all enemies are Stunned for 1 second.

Deals (125 ~ 250) bonus damage against monsters.

R.name: The Show Stopper
R.tooltip: Sett grabs an enemy champion and Suppresses them as he carries them forward, then slams them into the ground, dealing (200/300/400 + (120% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 40/50/60% of the grabbed enemy's bonus Health physical damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by 99% for 1 second. Enemies take less damage the further they are from where Sett lands.

P.name: Backstab
P.tooltip: When striking enemies that are facing away from him:Shaco's Attacks deal an additional (20% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage that can critically strike. deals an additional (10% Ability Power) magic damage, increased to (15% Ability Power) magic damage if the target is below 30% Health.

Q.name: Deceive
Q.tooltip:
Shaco teleports and becomes Invisible for 2.5/2.75/3/3.25/3.5 seconds. Using Jack In The Box or Hallucinate does not break Invisibility.

Shaco's next Attack while Invisible deals an additional (25/35/45/55/65 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. If striking from behind, this Attack critically strikes for damage.

The bonus damage on Attack can critically strike.
Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight.

W.name: Jack In The Box
W.tooltip:
Shaco creates a trap that stealths itself after 2 seconds and lasts for (40 + (10% Ability Power)) seconds. It activates when an enemy comes near or when revealed, Fearing nearby enemy Champions for 0.5/0.75/1/1.25/1.5 seconds, or 2 seconds for minions and jungle monsters.

Once activated, the trap fires at all nearby enemies for 5 seconds, dealing (10/15/20/25/30 + (12% Ability Power)) magic damage, or (25/40/55/70/85 + (18% Ability Power)) damage if focused on a single target.

Jack in the Box's attacks deal an additional 20/35/50/65/80 damage to monsters.

E.name: Two-Shiv Poison
E.tooltip:
Passive: While this Ability is off Cooldown, Shaco's Attacks Slow the target by 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% for 2 seconds.

Active: Shaco throws a shiv, dealing (70/95/120/145/170 + (80% bonus Attack Damage) + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% for 3 seconds. If the target has less than 30% Health, the shiv deals (105/142.5/180/217.5/255 + (120% bonus Attack Damage) + (90% Ability Power)) damage instead.

R.name: Hallucinate
R.tooltip:
Shaco briefly disappears, then reappears with a clone that lasts 18 seconds and detonates when it dies, dealing (150/225/300 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and spawning three mini Jack in the Boxes that trigger immediately. The clone deals 60% of Shaco's damage and receives 50% increased damage.

Mini Jack in the Boxes deal (10/20/30 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage, or (25/50/75 + (15% Ability Power)) magic damage if firing at only one enemy, and Fear for 1 second.


The clone can be controlled using the Alt key and right click, or by Recasting this Ability.

P.name: Ki Barrier
P.tooltip:
Shen gains Shield for 2.5 seconds after using an Ability. This effect has a 11 second Cooldown, reduced by 4 seconds when one of Shen's Abilities successfully affects an ally or enemy.

Shen has a Spirit Blade that his other Abilities use.

Q.name: Twilight Assault
Q.tooltip:
Shen recalls his Spirit Blade. Enemies hit by the pull are Slowed by 25/30/35/40/45% while moving away from Shen for the next 2 seconds.

Additionally, Shen's next 3 Attacks deal an additional 40 plus (2/2.5/3/3.5/4% + (0.01% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage. If Shen hit an enemy champion with the Spirit Blade, the damage is increased to 40 plus (5/5.5/6/6.5/7% + (0.02% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage and he gains 50% Attack Speed for those Attacks.

Each Attack deals 100% increased damage to jungle monsters (max 100/125/150/175/200 damage).
Attacks against structures deal 40 damage.

W.name: Spirit's Refuge
W.tooltip:
Shen creates a defensive zone at his Spirit Blade for 1.75 seconds. Attacks against allied champions in the zone are blocked.

If there are no champions to protect in the zone when it starts, it will wait for up to 2 seconds.

E.name: Shadow Dash
E.tooltip:
Passive: Dealing damage with Twilight Assault or this Ability recovers 50 Energy.

Active: Shen dashes, Taunting champions and jungle monsters for 1.5 seconds and dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (11% bonus Health)) physical damage.

R.name: Stand United
R.tooltip: Shen grants an allied champion anywhere on the map between (120/220/320 + (15% bonus Health) + (135% Ability Power)) and (192/352/512 + (24% bonus Health) + (216% Ability Power)) Shield based on their missing Health for 5 seconds (max Shield at 60% missing Health). After channeling for 3 seconds, Shen teleports to his ally's location with his Spirit Blade.

P.name: Scalemail
P.tooltip:
Takedowns on champions, large minions, and monsters earn Shyvana stacks of , each stack grants Shyvana permanent 0.3 Armor and 0.3 Magic Resist.

Bonus Armor:
Bonus Magic Resist:

Q.name: Emberstrike
Q.tooltip:
Passive: Shyvana's Attacks deal (1% + (0.01% bonus Attack Damage)) max Health magic damage On-Hit and reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

Active: Shyvana's next Attack strikes the target and the surrounding area dealing (10/15/20/25/30 + (110% Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) physical damage. This Ability may be Recast after an Attack or short delay within the next 4 seconds.

Dragon Form: Shyvana gains an additional Recast, causing her to bite the target of her next Attack dealing (15/22.5/30/37.5/45 + (165% Attack Damage) + (45% Ability Power)) true damage.

Deals 10 additional damage to monsters.
Maximum health damage does not affect structures and against non-champions has a minimum of 10 and maximum of 200.
Dragon Form's final Recast cannot critically strike.

W.name: Inferno Aegis
W.tooltip:
Shyvana wraps herself in flames for 2.5 seconds, gaining (60/80/100/120/140 + (12% bonus Health)) Shield, increased by (18/24/30/36/42 + (3.6% bonus Health)) per nearby enemy champion and 25% Move Speed, increased to 43.75% when moving towards enemy champions.

When the effect ends, the Shield is broken, or upon Recast the area around her detonates, dealing (80/100/120/140/160 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Dragon Form: If the detonation hits an enemy champion Shyvana heals for (60 ~ 100) + (4% ~ 8%) Missing Health.

E.name: Molten Burst
E.tooltip:
Shyvana launches a fireball at the target location dealing (50/65/80/95/110 + (60/65/70/75/80% Ability Power)) + 5% Max health magic damage and Slowing by 30% for 2 seconds. It explodes upon striking an enemy or reaching its terminus.

Dragon Form: Shyvana's fireball is larger and pierces through enemies. Upon striking a champion, large monster, or reaching its terminus it triggers a pulse of fire that deals (62.5/81.25/100/118.75/137.5 + (75/81.25/87.5/93.75/100% Ability Power)) + 6.25% Max Health magic damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds. The fireball leaves behind a trail for 2 seconds that deals (25 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second.

Overlapping Dragon Form explosions deal 40% damage.

R.name: Dragon's Descent
R.tooltip:
Passive: Shyvana generates 1.25 Dragon Fury by striking enemies with Attacks and Abilities, increased by 200% while in Dragon Form, and reduced 75% by when striking in an area against non-champions.

Active: Shyvana transforms into her Dragon Form, becoming Unstoppable, and flying to the target location breathing fire on enemies below dealing (150/250/350 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and causing them Flee for 0.75 seconds.

While transformed, Shyvana's basic Abilities are upgraded, she gains 150/250/350 bonus Health, size, and Attack Range. Shyvana loses Dragon Fury over time and her transformation ends when she has no Dragon Fury remaining.

Shyvana gains 1% increased Fury from all sources per 1 Ultimate Ability Haste. Ultimate Haste acquired while dead does not take effect until Shyvana revives.

P.name: Noxious Slipstream
P.tooltip: Singed drafts off of nearby allied or enemy champions, gaining 25% Move Speed for 2 seconds. This effect has an 8 second Cooldown per champion.

Q.name: Poison Trail
Q.tooltip:
Toggle: Singed lays a poisonous trail that deals (20/30/40/50/60 + (42.5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second.

Cloud duration: 3.25 seconds.
Poison duration: 2 seconds.
Approximate total damage: (95/142.5/190/237.5/285 + (201.875% Ability Power)) magic damage.
If a minion would be killed by minion damage while under the effects of Poison Trail, Singed claims the kill credit instead.

W.name: Mega Adhesive
W.tooltip: Singed hurls a cask of sticky liquid, Grounding and Slowing enemies in the area by 50/55/60/65/70% for 3 seconds.

E.name: Fling
E.tooltip:
Singed flings an enemy over his shoulder, dealing (50/60/70/80/90 + (55% Ability Power)) plus 6/6.5/7/7.5/8% max Health magic damage.

If Singed flings a target into his Mega Adhesive, they are Rooted for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 seconds.

Max Health damage is capped at 300 against minions and jungle monsters.

R.name: Insanity Potion
R.tooltip: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him 25/55/85 Ability Power, Armor, Magic Resist, Move Speed, Health Regen, and Mana Regen for 25 seconds. During this effect, Singed's Poison Trail also applies 40% Grievous Wounds for 1 second.

P.name: Glory in Death
P.tooltip:
After being killed Sion will reanimate himself allowing him to move and Attack, but his Health rapidly decays while he is reanimated. He also gains 100% Lifesteal, attacks extremely fast, and his Attacks deal an additional 10% max Health physical damage.

All of his Abilities are replaced with Death Surge, which grants him a burst of Move Speed.

Q.name: Decimating Smash
Q.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Sion charges a heavy blow for up to 2 seconds.

Release: Sion slams his axe down, briefly Slowing and dealing between (30/45/60/75/90 + (40/50/60/70/80% Attack Damage)) and (90/155/220/285/350 + (120/150/180/210/240% Attack Damage)) physical damage based on charge time. If Sion charged for at least 1 second, enemies are Knocked Up and Stunned for between 1.25 and 2.25 seconds based on charge time.

Deals 165% damage to jungle monsters and 60% damage to minions.

W.name: Soul Furnace
W.tooltip:
Passive: Sion gains 4 max Health when he kills a unit, or 15 for champion takedowns, large minions and large monsters.

Active: Sion gains (60/75/90/105/120 + (40% Ability Power) + (8/10/12/14/16% Health)) Shield for 6 seconds. After 3 seconds if the shield still holds, Sion can Recast to detonate the shield to deal (40/65/90/115/140 + (40% Ability Power)) plus 14% max Health magic damage.

Max 400 bonus damage to minions and monsters.

E.name: Roar of the Slayer
E.tooltip: Sion fires a shockwave, dealing (65/100/135/170/205 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage, Slowing them by 40/45/50/55/60% for 2.5 seconds and removing 25% Armor for 4 seconds. Non-champions hit are Knocked Back. Enemies hit by a Knocked Back unit take the same damage and effects.

R.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
R.tooltip:
Sion charges Unstoppably in a direction for 8 seconds, turning towards the mouse cursor. Sion stops on colliding with an enemy champion or wall or on Recasting this Ability.

At the end of the charge, Sion deals between (150/300/450 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) and (400/800/1200 + (120% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage based on distance travelled. Enemies close to Sion are Stunned for between 0.75 and 1.75 seconds based on distance travelled. Enemies in a larger area are Slowed by 40/45/50% for 3 seconds.

P.name: Fleet of Foot
P.tooltip: Sivir's Attacks and Abilities grant her a burst of (55 ~ 85) Decaying Move Speed for 1.5 seconds when they damage enemy champions.

Q.name: Boomerang Blade
Q.tooltip:
Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (70% bonus Attack Damage) + (60% Ability Power)) to all enemies it cuts through. Hitting non-champions reduces the damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of 40%.

The damage falloff resets upon beginning its return.
Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 40% effectiveness.
Cast time scales down with Attack Speed

W.name: Ricochet
W.tooltip:
For the next 4 seconds, Sivir gains 20/25/30/35/40% Attack Speed and her auto attacks are empowered to bounce to additional surrounding enemies dealing (40/42.5/45/47.5/50% Attack Damage) physical damage each bounce for up to 8 bounces.

These bounces critically strike if the attack generating them does.

Bounces will prioritize new targets before returning to targets that have already been struck. Can only hit each target a maximum of two times.
Bounces deal 65% damage to minions.
This ability executes low Health minions.

E.name: Spell Shield
E.tooltip:
Sivir creates a magical barrier for 1.5 seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy Ability. If an ability is blocked, Sivir restores ((60/65/70/75/80% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) health and triggers Fleet of Foot.

This shield blocks both champion and item Abilities.

R.name: On The Hunt
R.tooltip:
Sivir rallies her nearby allies, granting them 20/25/30% Move Speed for 8/10/12 seconds.

Sivir's attacks against champions while On The Hunt reduce the cooldown of her basic abilities by 0.5 seconds.

Takedowns on recently damaged enemies refreshes the duration of the hunt.

P.name: Threads of Vibration
P.tooltip: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking for 4s. At 3 stacks of Quaking, enemies take (500% ~ 900%) max Health magic damage over its duration.

Q.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
Q.tooltip:
Skarner rips a boulder from the ground, empowering his next 3 Attacks with 20/25/30/35/40% Attack Speed and dealing (10/20/30/40/50 + (90% bonus Attack Damage) + (3% bonus Health)) physical damage to surrounding enemies. His final Attack will deal an additional 11% max Health physical damage and Slow affected foes by 40% for 1s.

Recast: Skarner ends this Ability and throws his boulder, dealing + max Health physical damage, and additionally Slowing the first enemy hit — and any other surrounding enemies — by for s.

Percent Health Damage to monsters is capped at 150/200/250/300/350.
This Ability deals 100% to structures.

W.name: Seismic Bastion
W.tooltip: Skarner gains (8% Health) Shield for 2.5s and triggers an earthquake that deals (50/70/90/110/130 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows nearby enemies by 20% for 1s.

E.name: Ixtal's Impact
E.tooltip:
Skarner charges forward, steering toward the chosen direction and ignoring terrain. If he runs into a champion or large monster, Skarner drags them along for the rest of his charge.

Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals (30/60/90/120/150 + (120% bonus Attack Damage) + (6% Health)) physical damage to the enemy and Stuns them for 1.1s.

Skarner can Recast this Ability to end his charge early.

Successful wall collisions reduce this Ability's cooldown to 65%.

R.name: Impale
R.tooltip:
Skarner's tails lash forward, dealing (150/250/350 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and Suppressing the first 3 champions he hits for 1.5s. Those hit are dragged along by Skarner for the duration of this Ability.

If Skarner hits at least one champion he gains 40% Move Speed for 1.5 seconds.

If Shattered Earth is active, Skarner will cast Upheaval first.

P.name: Dragon Practice
P.tooltip:
Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with grants a stack of , which improves Smolder's basic Abilities.
: Deal an additional magic damage and gain new effects at , , and stacks.: Explosions deal an additional magic damage.: Each hit deals an additional magic damage and gain an extra bolt every 100 stacks.

Smolder has acquired Dragon Practice: .

Q.name: Super Scorcher Breath
Q.tooltip:
Smolder belches flame, dealing (60/70/80/90/100 + (130% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage + magic damage. If the target dies, Smolder refunds 15 Mana, once per cast.

Based on stacks of Dragon Practice, this Ability evolves to gain the following effects:25 Stacks: Damages all enemies surrounding the target.125 Stacks: Sends 2 explosions beyond the target that deal 50% of this Ability's damage.225 Stacks: Burns the target, dealing (0.03% bonus Attack Damage) max Health true damage over 3 seconds. Enemy champions that drop below 6.5% total health while burning are killed instantly.

Super Scorcher Breath is considered a basic Attack, applies On-Hit effects, and applies Life Steal at 50% effectiveness.
Damage is increased by Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 75% effectiveness.
This Ability can only damage each target one time per cast.

W.name: Achooo!
W.tooltip:
Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze, dealing (60/70/80/90/100 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing by 35% for 1.5 seconds.

Hitting champions causes an explosion, dealing (10/35/60/85/110 + (50% bonus Attack Damage) + (80% Ability Power)) physical + magic damage.

Each consecutive explosion does 75% damage.
Smolder can only gain one Dragon Practice stack per champion hit.

E.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
E.tooltip:
Smolder takes flight, gaining 75% Move Speed and ignoring terrain for 1.25 seconds.

While flying, Smolder bombards the lowest Health enemy 5 (rounded down) times for (10/15/20/25/30 + (30% Attack Damage)) physical damage + magic damage per hit.

This Ability prioritizes champions.
While flying, Smolder gains expanded vision.

R.name: MMOOOMMMM!
R.tooltip:
Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing (150/250/350 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) physical damage. Enemies in the center take (225/375/525 + (150% bonus Attack Damage) + (150% Ability Power)) physical damage instead and are Slowed by 40% for 2 seconds.

Smolder's mom heals her son for (100/135/170 + (50% bonus Attack Damage) + (75% Ability Power)) Health if she hits him.

Deals 50% damage to minions and monsters.

P.name: Power Chord
P.tooltip:
Accelerando: Sona gains Accelerando stacks from using her Basic Abilities well. She gains + 0.5 Basic Ability Haste permanently per stack, up to 60 Basic Ability Haste. When she reaches 60 Basic Ability Haste, instead of gaining further stacks her current Ultimate Ability's cooldown is reduced by seconds.

Power Chord: After using 3 basic Abilities, Sona's next Attack deals an additional (20 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage and may have an additional effect based on the song Sona last activated.
Hymn of Valor: The Attack deals magic damage instead.Aria of Perseverance: The target deals less damage for seconds.Song of Celerity: The target is Slowed by for seconds.

Q.name: Hymn of Valor
Q.tooltip:
Sona deals (50/85/120/155/190 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to the nearest two enemies, prioritizing champions. She then begins a new Melody. Gain a stack of Accelerando for every champion you damage with this.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for 3 seconds, granting allied champions an additional (10/15/20/25/30 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage on their next Attack within 5 seconds.

Power Chord - Staccato: Power Chord bonus damage ((30 + (30% Ability Power)) total magic damage).

W.name: Aria of Perseverance
W.tooltip:
Active: Sona restores (30/45/60/75/90 + (30% Ability Power)) Health to herself and a nearby allied champion, prioritizing the most wounded. She then begins a new Melody.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for 3 seconds, granting allied champions (25/45/65/85/105 + (25% Ability Power)) Shield for 1.5 seconds.

Gain a stack of Accelerando whenever you heal another injured ally and every time you protect another ally from at least 25/45/65/85/105 damage with this shield.

Power Chord - Diminuendo: Power Chord also reduces physical and magic damage dealt by the target by (25% + (0.04% Ability Power)) for 3 seconds.

E.name: Song of Celerity
E.tooltip:
Active: She begins a new Melody and grants herself (20% + (0.02% Ability Power)) Move Speed for 3 seconds, extended to up to 7 seconds if she doesn't take damage.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for 3 seconds that grants allied champions (10/12/14/16/18% + (0.02% Ability Power)) Move Speed for 3 seconds.

Power Chord - Tempo: Power Chord also Slows the target by (50% + (0.04% Ability Power)) for 2 seconds.

R.name: Crescendo
R.tooltip:
Sona strikes an irresistible chord, Stunning enemy for 1.5 seconds and dealing (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Enemies that know how to dance, will dance during the stun.

P.name: Salvation
P.tooltip: Soraka gains 90% Move Speed while moving towards allied champions who are below 40% Health.

Q.name: Starcall
Q.tooltip:
Soraka calls down a star, dealing (85/120/155/190/225 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 30% for 1.5 seconds.

Hitting an enemy champion grants Soraka Rejuvenation, which restores (60/75/90/105/120 + (30% Ability Power)) Health over 2.5 seconds and grants 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Move Speed decaying over the same duration.

W.name: Astral Infusion
W.tooltip:
Soraka restores (90/110/130/150/170 + (50% Ability Power)) Health to another allied champion.

If Soraka is affected by Rejuvenation, the Health cost will be reduced by 80/85/90/95/100%, and the target will gain Rejuvenation for seconds.

This Ability cannot be used if Soraka is below (5% Health) Health .

E.name: Equinox
E.tooltip: Soraka creates a starfield that deals (70/95/120/145/170 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to champions. The field lingers for 1.5 seconds, Silencing enemies inside. When the zone disappears, champions inside the zone are Rooted for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 second(s) and take (70/95/120/145/170 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

R.name: Wish
R.tooltip: Soraka calls upon divine powers, restoring (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) Health to all allied champions, regardless of distance. Healing is increased to (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) on targets below 40% Health.

P.name: Ravenous Flock
P.tooltip:
Swain collects Soul Fragments from Vision of Empire, Nevermove, and enemy champion deaths. Soul Fragments restore (6% ~ 6%) maximum Health and permanently grant Swain 15 max Health.

Soul Fragments collected:
Total Health gained:

Q.name: Death's Hand
Q.tooltip: Swain unleashes 5 eldritch bolts, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage plus (15/22.5/30/37.5/45 + (11.25% Ability Power)) magic damage per bolt past the first (max (120/180/240/300/360 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage).

W.name: Vision of Empire
W.tooltip:
Swain opens a demon eye, revealing a location for 1.5 seconds, then deals (70/105/140/175/210 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 50% for 1.5 seconds.

Champions hit grant Swain a Soul Fragment and are revealed for 6 seconds.

Deals (35/52.5/70/87.5/105 + (30% Ability Power)) damage instead to minions.

E.name: Nevermove
E.tooltip:
Swain launches a wave of demonic power that returns, detonating on the first enemy hit to deal (90/130/170/210/250 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and Root enemies in the area for 1.5 seconds.

Rooting a champion allows Swain to reactivate this ability to pull all champions Rooted by Nevermove toward him, gaining a Soul Fragment for each.

Nevermove temporarily grants vision of rooted champions.

R.name: Demonic Ascension
R.tooltip:
Swain frees the demon, which deals (15/25/35 + (4% Ability Power)) magic damage and drains (15/30/45 + (5% Ability Power) + (1.5% bonus Health)) Health per second from nearby enemies.
