His Demonic Energy depletes over time but can be recharged indefinitely by draining enemy Champions and is fully restored on Champion takedowns.

After 2 seconds and every 8 seconds thereafter, Swain can cast Demonflare while transformed, which deals (150/250/350 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows enemies by 50%, decaying over 1.5s.

Healing is reduced to 10% against non-champions.
Depletes 10 Demonic Energy per second. After 5 seconds, this increases to 15.
Regenerates 20 Demonic Energy per second while draining from champions.

P.name: Petricite Burst
P.tooltip:
After using an Ability, Sylas gains a charge (max 3 charges). Sylas' Attacks expend a charge to whirl his chains, dealing ((130% Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage to the main target and ((40% Attack Damage) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage to other surrounding enemies.

While he has at least one charge, Sylas gains 125% Attack Speed.

Q.name: Chain Lash
Q.tooltip:
Sylas lashes his chains out, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 15/20/25/30/35% for 1.5 seconds. The place where the chains intersect explodes, dealing a further (60/115/170/225/280 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

The explosion deals 40% damage to minions.

W.name: Kingslayer
W.tooltip: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing (75/110/145/180/215 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Against champions, Sylas restores between (20/40/60/80/100 + (30% Ability Power) + (5% bonus Health)) and (40/80/120/160/200 + (60% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Health)) Health based on his missing Health (max healing at or below 40% Health).

E.name: Abscond / Abduct
E.tooltip:
Sylas quickly dashes, and prepares a Recast for 3.5 seconds.

Recast: Sylas throws his chains, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, dealing (80/130/180/230/280 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage, and Knocking Up for 0.5 seconds.

R.name: Hijack
R.tooltip:
Sylas hijacks an enemy champion, allowing him to cast a copy of their ultimate Ability, based on his Ultimate level and using his stats.

Hijacking an enemy places a Cooldown on them for (modified by Sylas' Ability Haste) of the enemy's ultimate's Cooldown, with a minimum of 40 seconds, during which time Sylas cannot hijack them again.

Sylas converts non-hybrid AD ratios into AP ratios, granting him .4 AP: 1 Bonus AD and .6 AP: 1 Total AD respectively.

P.name: Transcendent
P.tooltip:
Syndra can collect up to 120 Splinters of Wrath. These enhance Syndra's Abilities and restore 20 Mana each time she claims one from an enemy.

Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from the following:3 Splinter(s) when damaging enemy champions with two Abilities within 4 seconds (8s Cooldown)5 Splinters upon spending Ability points1 Splinter on killing large minions

At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra increases her Ability Power by 15%.

Q.name: Dark Sphere
Q.tooltip:
Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere, dealing (90/125/160/195/230 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage. The Dark Sphere remains for 6 seconds and can be manipulated by Syndra's other Abilities.

Splinters of Wrath: Syndra can store 2 charges of Dark Sphere.

This Ability can be cast while moving.

W.name: Force of Will
W.tooltip:
Syndra grabs a Dark Sphere, enemy minion, or non-epic monster. She drags it with her and can Recast for up to 5 seconds.

Recast: Syndra hurls the object, dealing and Slowing by 25% for seconds.

Splinters of Wrath: This Ability deals an additional (12% + (0.02% Ability Power)) true damage.


If no target is selected, grabs nearest Dark Sphere.
This Ability can be cast while moving.

E.name: Scatter the Weak
E.tooltip:
Syndra projects a wave of force, Knocking Back enemies and Dark Spheres and dealing (60/95/130/165/200 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Dark Spheres that are pushed Stun enemies for 1.25 seconds and deal (60/95/130/165/200 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Splinters of Wrath: This Ability's width is increased and Slows enemies by 70% for 1.25 seconds.

Enemies can only take damage and be Knocked Back from this Ability once per cast.

R.name: Unleashed Power
R.tooltip:
Passive: Dark Sphere gains an additional 10 Ability Haste for each rank of Unleashed Power.

Syndra draws on her full cataclysmic power, launching the 3 Dark Spheres orbiting her plus up to 4 more nearby at an enemy champion. Each Dark Sphere deals (80/120/160 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage (max (560/840/1120 + (140% Ability Power)) magic damage).

Splinters of Wrath: This Ability executes enemies below 15% Health.

P.name: An Acquired Taste
P.tooltip:
Attacks deal (10 + (4% bonus Health)) bonus magic damage. Against champions, they add a stack of for 5 seconds, up to 3 times.

At 3 stacks, Tongue Lash and Devour become empowered against that champion.

Q.name: Tongue Lash
Q.tooltip:
Deals (75/120/165/210/255 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slows them by 50% for 2 seconds.

On champion hit, heals Tahm for 10/15/20/25/30 + 5/5.5/6/6.5/7% of his missing Health and applies a stack of An Acquired Taste dealing extra magic damage. If that champion already had 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they will also be Stunned for 1.5 seconds, consuming the stacks.

Activate Devour while your tongue is in midair to devour enemy champions who already have 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste from a distance when you hit them.

Tongue Lash's range increases with Tahm Kench's size

W.name: Abyssal Dive
W.tooltip:
Dive down and then re-appear at target location, dealing (100/135/170/205/240 + (150% Ability Power)) magic damage and Knock Up all enemies in an area for 1 second. Hitting at least one enemy champion refunds 40/42.5/45/47.5/50% of the Cooldown and Mana cost.

Devoured allies can be taken along for the ride (but can always hop out early).

Enemies cannot see where you are headed to until 0.75 seconds into the channel.

'Boy, the world's one river, and I'm its king. Ain't no place I ain't been; ain't no place I can't go again.'

E.name: Thick Skin
E.tooltip:
Passive: 15/23/31/39/47% of damage Tahm Kench takes is stored by his Thick Skin, increased to 42/44/46/48/50% if there are at least 2 nearby enemy champions. If Kench has not taken damage within 4 seconds, Thick Skin will rapidly be consumed to heal Tahm for (60% ~ 100%) of its value.

Active: Convert all your stored Thick Skin into a Shield, lasting 2.5 seconds.

Grey Health is capped at (300% Health)

R.name: Devour
R.tooltip:
Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds. He can Recast to spit them out.

Enemy Champions: Require 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste. Are devoured for up to 3 seconds and take 100/250/400 ( + (15% + (0.07% Ability Power)) of their Max Health) magic damage. Tahm Kench is Slowed by 40% and Grounded during this effect.

Ally Champions: Are devoured for up to 3 seconds and are granted (650/800/950 + (100% Ability Power)) Shield which decays gradually after being spit out. Allies can also choose to exit early. Tahm Kench is Grounded during this effect, but can cast Abyssal Dive and gains 60% Move Speed for 3 seconds.

Allies can see when this spell is available next to your health bar (enemies cannot).
Shield decays by 200 per second.

P.name: Rock Surfing
P.tooltip: Taliyah gains 95% Move Speed while out of combat if she has been near a wall within the last 3 seconds.

Q.name: Threaded Volley
Q.tooltip:
Taliyah hurls 5 rocks, each dealing (55/72.5/90/107.5/125 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage in an area around the first enemy hit while creating Worked Ground at that area. Subsequent hits against the same enemy deal 60% less damage.

Casts on worked ground cost 10 Mana and have 50% less Cooldown, consume the Worked Ground, and hurl a boulder that Slows enemies it hits by 20/25/30/35/40% for 1.5 seconds, dealing (99/130.5/162/193.5/225 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage to the primary target. Monsters hit by the boulder are Stunned for 3 seconds.

Taliyah can move and use other Abilities while hurling rocks.
Casting this Ability on Worked Ground cannot reduce its Cooldown to less than 0.75 seconds.
Total damage to a single target: (143/188.5/234/279.5/325 + (130% Ability Power))
Each rock deals 20/25/30/35/40 additional damage to monsters.

W.name: Seismic Shove
W.tooltip: Taliyah quakes the earth, Knocking enemies in an area in the chosen direction.

E.name: Unraveled Earth
E.tooltip:
Taliyah scatters loose stones in an area, Slowing enemies hit by 20% and dealing (60/105/150/195/240 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. The stones detonate when enemies dash or are Knocked through them, Stunning for the remaining movement duration + 0.75 seconds and dealing (25/40/55/70/85 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage.

The stun's duration cannot exceed 2 seconds. Each enemy can only be stunned once per cast. Monsters are always stunned for the maximum duration.
Stones beyond the first one deal 25% less damage.
Max detonation damage: (62.5/100/137.5/175/212.5 + (75% Ability Power))
This ability deals 225% damage to monsters.

R.name: Weaver's Wall
R.tooltip:
Taliyah creates a massive earthen wall for 4 seconds. If she immediately Recasts, she will ride along the wall as it unravels. Moving or being immobilized will end the ride.

This ability cannot be cast if Taliyah has taken damage from Champions or structures within the last 3 seconds.

Once the wall is fully formed, Taliyah can Recast to destroy it early.

P.name: Blade's End
P.tooltip:
Talon's Abilities apply a stack to champions and large jungle monsters they damage for 6 seconds (max 3 stacks).

When Talon Attacks a target with 3 stacks, he deals an additional (210% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage over 2 seconds.

Q.name: Noxian Diplomacy
Q.tooltip:
Talon leaps to a target and deals (65/85/105/125/145 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. If used in melee range, this Ability instead critically strikes for (65/85/105/125/145 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

If this Ability kills the target, Talon restores (9 ~ 55) Health and refunds 50% of its Cooldown.

Melee damage is affected by Critical Strike Damage increase.

W.name: Rake
W.tooltip: Talon tosses a volley of blades, dealing (50/60/70/80/90 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. The blades then return to him, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing by 40/45/50/55/60% for 1 second.

E.name: Assassin's Path
E.tooltip: Talon vaults over the nearest terrain or structure. Talon cannot dash over the same terrain more than once every 160/135/110/85/60 seconds.

R.name: Shadow Assault
R.tooltip:
Talon disperses a ring of blades that deal (90/135/180 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, gains 40/55/70% Move Speed, and becomes Invisible for 2.5 seconds. When the Invisibility ends, the blades return to Talon, dealing (90/135/180 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage again.

If Talon cancels the Invisibility with an Attack or with Noxian Diplomacy, the blades return to the target instead.

Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight.

P.name: Bravado
P.tooltip: After using an Ability, Taric's next 2 Attacks within 5 seconds gain 100% Attack Speed, deal an additional (15% bonus Armor) magic damage, and reduce his basic Ability Cooldowns by second.

Q.name: Starlight's Touch
Q.tooltip:
Passive: Gain a stack (max 1/2/3/4/5) every 15 seconds and when hitting a Bravado Attack.

Active: Consume all stacks to restore (25 + (15% Ability Power) + (1% Health)) Health per stack to nearby ally champions ((25/50/75/100/125 + (15/30/45/60/75% Ability Power) + (1/2/3/4/5% Health)) at 1/2/3/4/5 stacks).

W.name: Bastion
W.tooltip:
Passive: Taric gains (6/7/8/9/10% Armor) Armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by this Ability. As long as they are near each other, the ally gains (6/7/8/9/10% Armor) Armor and Taric casts all his Abilities from both himself and his linked ally.

Active: Taric binds to an ally champion, granting a 7/8/9/10/11% max Health Shield for 2.5 seconds.

Mimicked spell effects do not stack.
Only one ally can be bound at a time.

E.name: Dazzle
E.tooltip: Taric projects a beam of starlight, bursting after 1 second to deal (90/130/170/210/250 + (50% Ability Power) + (50% bonus Armor)) magic damage and Stun enemies for 1.5 seconds.

R.name: Cosmic Radiance
R.tooltip: Taric calls down protection from the heavens. After 2.5 seconds, nearby ally champions become invulnerable for 2.5 seconds.

P.name: Guerrilla Warfare
P.tooltip:
If Teemo stands still for 1.5 seconds without being damaged, he becomes Invisible until he moves. While in a brush, he can maintain Invisibility while moving.

Upon exiting this Invisibility, Teemo gains 80% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

Q.name: Blinding Dart
Q.tooltip:
Teemo fires a dart, Blinding the target for 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3 seconds and dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Minions and jungle monsters are Blinded for 200% longer.

W.name: Move Quick
W.tooltip:
Passive: Teemo gains 12/16/20/24/28% Move Speed while he hasn't been damaged by a champion or turret in the last 5 seconds.

Active: Teemo sprints, gaining 24/32/40/48/56% Move Speed that is not lost when struck for 3 seconds.

E.name: Toxic Shot
E.tooltip:
Passive: Teemo's Attacks apply poison On-Hit, dealing an additional (9/23/37/51/65 + (30% Ability Power) + (5% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage plus (24/48/72/96/120 + (40% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage over 4 seconds.

This poison deals 160% damage to jungle monsters.

R.name: Noxious Trap
R.tooltip:
Teemo tosses a mushroom trap that detonates when stepped on. The traps Slow by 30/40/50% and deal (200/325/450 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage over 4 seconds. Enemies are revealed for the same duration.

Traps last 5 minutes and are stealthed. A mushroom tossed onto another mushroom bounces before landing at its position. This Ability has 3/4/5 charges (35/30/25 second refresh).

P.name: Damnation
P.tooltip: Thresh collects the Souls of dead enemies by walking near them. Each Soul grants him 1 Armor and 1 Ability Power.

Q.name: Death Sentence
Q.tooltip:
Thresh throws out his scythe, Stunning the first unit hit and Pulling them towards Thresh for 1.5 seconds. The scythe does (100/150/200/250/300 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage and also grants True Sight for the duration.

Thresh can Recast this Ability to pull himself to the enemy.

If this Ability hits, its Cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

W.name: Dark Passage
W.tooltip:
Thresh throws his lantern, allowing an ally to click on it to dash to Thresh.

The lantern also grants 50/70/90/110/130 Shield for 4 seconds to Thresh and the first ally champion to come in contact with it.

The Shield scales with number of Souls collected. Thresh can use his lantern to pick up Souls.

E.name: Flay
E.tooltip:
Passive: Thresh's Attacks deal additional damage based on how long since he last Attacked. They deal between and (90/120/150/180/210% Attack Damage) magic damage.

Active: Thresh whips his chains, Pulling or Pushing enemies in the direction of the swing. Enemies hit are also Slowed by 20/25/30/35/40% for 1 second and take (65/110/155/200/245 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Passive damage scales with number of Souls collected.

R.name: The Box
R.tooltip: Thresh creates a prison of spectral walls, Slowing champions by 99% for 2 seconds and dealing (250/400/550 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. Walls break after one collision, and after one is broken, the rest deal no damage and Slow for half duration.

P.name: Draw a Bead
P.tooltip: Tristana's Attack Range and the range of and are increased by (0 ~ 150).

Q.name: Rapid Fire
Q.tooltip: Tristana goes full-auto, gaining 60/75/90/105/120% Attack Speed for 7 seconds.

W.name: Rocket Jump
W.tooltip:
Tristana launches herself, dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 40% for 2 seconds upon landing.

Champion takedowns and max stack Explosive Charge detonations on champions refresh this Ability's Cooldown.

E.name: Explosive Charge
E.tooltip:
Passive: Tristana's Attacks that kill enemies deal (45/60/75/90/105 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage to surrounding enemies.

Active: Tristana attaches a bomb to an enemy or turret that deals (60/85/110/135/160 + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage to surrounding enemies after 4 seconds. The damage is increased by 25% each time Tristana hits an Attack or Ability (max 4 stacks).

At 4 stacks, the bomb explodes immediately (max (60/85/110/135/160 + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage).

Active damage is increased by Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 40% effectiveness.
The detonation radius is twice as large if used on a turret.

R.name: Buster Shot
R.tooltip:
Tristana fires a massive cannonball, dealing (225/275/325 + (70% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to the target, Knocking Back and Stunning them and surrounding enemies for 0.4/0.55/0.7 seconds.

If this Ability applies the final stack of Explosive Charge, it explodes after the unit is Knocked Back.

P.name: King's Tribute
P.tooltip: When an enemy dies near Trundle, he restores (1.8% ~ 5.5%) of its max Health.

Q.name: Chomp
Q.tooltip:
Trundle's next Attack deals (10/30/50/70/90 + (115/125/135/145/155% Attack Damage)) physical damage and briefly Slows by 75%, then Trundle gains 20/25/30/35/40 Attack Damage for 5 seconds and the enemy loses 10/12.5/15/17.5/20 Attack Damage for the same duration.

This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
Trundle gains 25 attack range for this attack.

W.name: Frozen Domain
W.tooltip: Trundle freezes an area for 8 seconds. While inside he gains 20/28/36/44/52% Move Speed, 30/50/70/90/110% Attack Speed, and 25% increased healing.

E.name: Pillar of Ice
E.tooltip: Trundle creates an icy pillar for 6 seconds, briefly Knocking Back enemies directly over it and Slowing nearby enemies by 34/38/42/46/50%.

R.name: Subjugate
R.tooltip:
Trundle drains the lifeforce of an enemy champion, dealing (20/25/30% + (0.02% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage and stealing 40% Armor and Magic Resist over 5 seconds.

Half of the damage and shred happen immediately and the other half happens over the duration.
The shred lasts for 4 seconds after the drain ends.

P.name: Battle Fury
P.tooltip:
Tryndamere's Attacks grant him 5 Fury or 10 Fury for a critical strike, and 10 Fury for killing a unit. After 8 seconds of being out of combat, Tryndamere loses 5 Fury every second.

Each point of Fury grants 0.5% Critical Strike Chance.

Q.name: Bloodlust
Q.tooltip:
Passive: Tryndamere thirsts for blood, gaining up to 20/35/50/65/80 Attack Damage based on his missing Health.

Active: Tryndamere consumes his Fury, restoring (30/40/50/60/70 + (30% Ability Power)) plus (0.5/0.95/1.4/1.85/2.3 + (1.2% Ability Power)) Health per Fury (max: (30/40/50/60/70 + (30% Ability Power))).

Maximum Attack Damage gained at 10% remaining Health.

W.name: Mocking Shout
W.tooltip: Tryndamere hurls insults, reducing champions' Attack Damage by 20/35/50/65/80 for 4 seconds and Slowing by 30/35/40/45/50% while cowering from him for 3.25 seconds.

E.name: Spinning Slash
E.tooltip:
Tryndamere spins through his enemies, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (80% Ability Power)) physical damage and generating 2 Fury per enemy hit, increased to 5 Fury against enemy champions.

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds when Tryndamere critically strikes, and reduced by 1.5 seconds when critically striking a champion.

R.name: Undying Rage
R.tooltip:
Tryndamere becomes completely immune to death for 5 seconds, refusing to be reduced below 30/50/70 Health, and instantly gains 50/75/100 Fury.

This Ability can be used while Disabled.

P.name: Loaded Dice
P.tooltip: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.

Q.name: Wild Cards
Q.tooltip:
Twisted Fate throws three cards that deal (60/105/150/195/240 + (50% bonus Attack Damage) + (85% Ability Power)) magic damage each.

Enemies can only be damaged by one of the cards.

W.name: Pick a Card
W.tooltip:
Twisted Fate begins shuffling his deck, allowing him to Recast to lock in one of three cards and enhance his next Attack.
The Blue Card deals (40/60/80/100/120 + (100% Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and restores 70/90/110/130/150 Mana.The Red Card deals (30/45/60/75/90 + (100% Attack Damage) + (70% Ability Power)) to nearby enemies and Slows by 30/35/40/45/50% for 2.5 seconds.The Gold Card deals (15/22.5/30/37.5/45 + (100% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) and Stuns for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 seconds.

E.name: Stacked Deck
E.tooltip:
Passive: Twisted Fate gains 15/25/35/45/55% Attack Speed and every 4th Attack deals an additional (65/90/115/140/165 + (20% bonus Attack Damage) + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

50% effective against structures.

R.name: Destiny
R.tooltip:
Twisted Fate focuses on his cards, granting True Sight of all enemy champions on the map for 6/8/10 seconds and allowing him to Recast.

Recast: Twisted Fate teleports up to 5500 units away.

Disabling effects will interrupt the teleport.

P.name: Deadly Venom
P.tooltip:
Twitch's Attacks infect his target On-Hit, dealing (8 + (3% Ability Power)) true damage per second for 6 seconds, stacking up to 6 times.

Max Damage Per Second: (48 + (18% Ability Power))

Q.name: Ambush
Q.tooltip:
Twitch Camouflages and gains 10% Move Speed for 10/11/12/13/14 seconds. The Move Speed increases to 30% while near an enemy champion that can't see him. After exiting Camouflage, Twitch gains 40/45/50/55/60% Attack Speed for 6 seconds.

When an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Venom, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.

Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.

W.name: Venom Cask
W.tooltip:
Twitch hurls a cask that adds a stack of Deadly Venom to all enemies struck and leaves behind a toxic cloud that persists for 3 seconds.

Enemies that remain within the cloud are Slowed by (30/35/40/45/50 + (6% Ability Power))and receive an additional stack of Deadly Venom each second.

E.name: Contaminate
E.tooltip:
Deals 20/30/40/50/60 physical damage to all nearby enemies affected by Deadly Venom, plus an additional (15/20/25/30/35 + (35% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and (35% Ability Power) magical damage per stack of Deadly Venom.

Max Damage: 110/150/190/230/270 physical damage and (210% Ability Power) magical damage.

R.name: Spray and Pray
R.tooltip:
Twitch unleashes his crossbow, gaining 300 Attack Range and 30/45/60 Attack Damage, and causing his Attacks to become piercing bolts for 6 seconds. These bolts hit all enemies they pass through, but deal 10% less damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of 60% damage.


Using this Ability does not break Camouflage, but Attacking still does.

P.name: Bridge Between
P.tooltip:
Awakened Spirit: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances. Udyr can Recast an Ability that is on Cooldown to gain its bonuses again with Ultimate benefits. (20 second Cooldown).

Monk Training: After using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks within 4 seconds gain 30% Attack Speed and refund 5% of Awaken's Cooldown.

Q.name: Wilding Claw
Q.tooltip:
Claw Stance: Udyr gains 20/32/44/56/68/80% Attack Speed and his Attacks deal (6/12/18/24/30/36 + (20% bonus Attack Damage) + (1/1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2% bonus Health)) physical damage On-Hit for 4 seconds. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks in this stance deal a bonus (3/4/5/6/7/8% + (0.03% bonus Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage and gain 50 range.

Awaken: Increase bonus Attack Speed to 20/32/44/56/68/80% and max Health damage to (3/4/5/6/7/8% + (0.05% bonus Attack Damage) + (0.001% bonus Health)). Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks call lightning six times, dealing a total of max Health magic damage to isolated targets (strikes bounce to other nearby targets when possible).


Claw Stance Max Health damage is capped at (15 + (50% Ability Power) + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) to monsters. Each lightning strike deals (0.01% Ability Power) max Health magic damage Minimum damage to minions: (40 ~ 160)).

W.name: Iron Mantle
W.tooltip:
Mantle Stance: Udyr gains (45/65/85/105/125/145 + (2/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2/3.5% Health) + (40% Ability Power) + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield for 4 seconds. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks gain 15/16/17/18/19/20% Life Steal and restore ((1.2% Health) + (8% Ability Power)) Health.

Awaken: Gain (45/65/85/105/125/145 + (65% Ability Power) + (8% Health) + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield, restore (22.5/32.5/42.5/52.5/62.5/72.5 + (32.5% Ability Power) + (4% Health) + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) Health over 4 seconds, and Udyr's next two Attacks instead have 30/32/34/36/38/40% Life Steal and restore ((2.4% Health) + (16% Ability Power)) Health.


The Shield granted by an Awaken cast will stack with any remaining Shield from the original cast. Life on hit reduced by 40% against minions.

E.name: Blazing Stampede
E.tooltip:
Stampede Stance: Udyr gains (25/31/37/43/49/55% + (0.05% bonus Attack Damage)) Move Speed, decaying over 4 seconds. Additionally, Udyr's Attacks dash him to the target and Stun for 0.75 seconds (6/5.6/5.2/4.8/4.4/4 second Cooldown per target).

Awaken: Grants immunity to Immobilizing and Disabling effects and an additional (0.1% bonus Attack Damage) Move Speed for 1.5 seconds.

Udyr moves through units during the Move Speed boost, and his Attacks in this Stance can't be cancelled.

R.name: Wingborne Storm
R.tooltip:
Storm Stance: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm for 4 seconds, dealing (20/36/52/68/84/100 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per second to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 15/18/21/24/27/30%. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks in this stance deal (35% Ability Power) magic damage to enemies in the storm.

Awaken: Unleash the storm, causing it to follow Udyr's last Attacked enemy, deal an additional (0.03% Ability Power) max Health magic damage over the duration, and Slow by an additional 5%.

Storm deals 100% damage to minions. Awakened deals a minimum of to monsters.

P.name: Echoing Flames
P.tooltip: Urgot has a cannon on each of his 6 legs. Attacks and will fire the leg cannon that is facing his target for plus 6% max Health physical damage. This effect has a 2.5 second Cooldown per leg.

Q.name: Corrosive Charge
Q.tooltip: Urgot fires an explosive charge, dealing (25/70/115/160/205 + (70% Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing by 45/50/55/60/65% for 1.25 seconds.

W.name: Purge
W.tooltip:
Passive: Urgot's other Abilities mark the last champion hit for 5 seconds.

Active: Urgot begins firing his chain gun at the closest enemy, prioritizing marked enemies. He Attacks them 3 times a second dealing (12 + (20/23.5/27/30.5/34% Attack Damage)) physical damage per shot. Urgot can move while firing and has 40% Slow resistance, but loses 125 Move Speed.

At max rank, this Ability lasts indefinitely and can be Toggled on and off.

The shots apply On-Hit effects at 50% damage. They cannot critically strike.
Shots deal a minimum of 50 damage to minions and jungle monsters.
Urgot can move through minions and non-epic jungle monsters while firing.

E.name: Disdain
E.tooltip:
Urgot charges forward, gaining (55/75/95/115/135 + (135% bonus Attack Damage) + (13.5% bonus Health)) Shield for 4 seconds. The first champion hit is Stunned for 1.5 seconds and thrown behind Urgot. All enemies Urgot collides with take (90/120/150/180/210 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

Cannot cross terrain.

R.name: Fear Beyond Death
R.tooltip:
Urgot fires a chem-drill, impaling the first champion hit, dealing (100/225/350 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing for 4 seconds by 1% per 1% missing Health, up to 75%.

If the impaled victim falls below 25% Health, Urgot can Recast this Ability, Suppressing the victim and dragging them to himself. On reaching Urgot, they are killed and nearby enemies are Feared for 1.5 seconds.

This Ability will automatically Recast at the end of the duration if the victim is under the execution threshold.

P.name: Living Vengeance
P.tooltip:
When Varus kills an enemy, he gains 20% Attack Speed, (1100%) Attack Damage, and (1100%) Ability Power for 15 seconds.

Champion takedowns grant 30% Attack Speed that can bypass the Attack Speed cap, (3300%) Attack Damage, and (3300%) Ability Power instead.

Q.name: Piercing Arrow
Q.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Varus draws back his next shot, Slowing himself by 20%. After 4 seconds, if not fired, Varus will cancel the Ability and refund 50% of its Mana cost.

Release: Varus releases the arrow, dealing (53.334/100.001/146.667/193.334/240.001 + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, reduced by 15% per enemy hit (minimum 33%). Damage and Blight detonation effects are increased by up to 50% based on charge time (maximum (80/150/220/290/360 + (120% bonus Attack Damage))) .

W.name: Blighted Quiver
W.tooltip:
Passive: Varus' Attacks deal an additional (4/13/22/31/40 + (25% Ability Power) + (15% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage and apply a Blight stack for 6 seconds (max 3 stacks).

Varus' other Abilities detonate Blight stacks dealing 3/3.5/4/4.5/5% max Health magic damage per stack (max 9/10.5/12/13.5/15% max Health damage). Detonating Blight on champions and epic monsters also reduces his basic Abilities' Cooldowns by 13% of their Maximum per stack.

Active: Varus' next Piercing Arrow deals an additional 6/8/10/12/14% missing Health magic damage, increased up to 9/12/15/18/21% missing Health damage based on charge time.

Passive damage from Blight detonations is capped at 120 damage per stack against jungle monsters.

E.name: Hail of Arrows
E.tooltip:
Varus fires a hail of arrows that deals (60/90/120/150/180 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and desecrates the ground for 4 seconds, Slowing enemies by 30/35/40/45/50% and applying 40% Grievous Wounds.

Grievous Wounds reduces the effectiveness of healing and regeneration effects.

R.name: Chain of Corruption
R.tooltip:
Varus flings out a tendril of corruption, Rooting the first champion hit for 2 seconds and dealing (150/250/350 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. Rooted enemies gain 3 Blight stacks over the duration.

The corruption spreads from its target to uninfected enemy champions. If it reaches them, they take the same damage and Root.

P.name: Night Hunter
P.tooltip: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining 30 Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

Q.name: Tumble
Q.tooltip:
Vayne rolls a short distance, and deals an additional ((75/85/95/105/115% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage on her next Attack.

This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

W.name: Silver Bolts
W.tooltip:
Passive: Every third consecutive Attack or Ability against an enemy deals an additional 4/5.5/7/8.5/10% max Health true damage.

Deals a minimum of 40/55/70/85/100 damage.
Deals 140/155/170/185/200 damage against jungle monsters.

E.name: Condemn
E.tooltip: Vayne fires a bolt that Knocks Back and deals (50/85/120/155/190 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. If the target collides with terrain, they take (75/127.5/180/232.5/285 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) bonus physical damage and become Stunned for 1.5 seconds.

R.name: Final Hour
R.tooltip:
Vayne gains 35/50/65 Attack Damage for 8/10/12 seconds, extended by 4 seconds whenever a champion damaged by Vayne dies within 3 seconds. Additionally, during the duration:Night Hunter instead grants 90 Move Speed.The Cooldown of Tumble is reduced by 30/40/50%, and grants Invisibility for 1 second.

Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight.
This Ability's duration can't be increased past its maximum duration

P.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
P.tooltip:
Veigar's Abilities grant him 1 stack of Phenomenal Evil when they strike enemy champions. Takedowns on champions grant an additional 5 stacks.

Each stack of Phenomenal Evil grants Veigar 1 Ability Power.

Q.name: Baleful Strike
Q.tooltip:
Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (50/55/60/65/70% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first two enemies hit.

If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains stack of Phenomenal Evil. Large minions and large monsters grant stacks instead.

W.name: Dark Matter
W.tooltip:
Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing (85/140/195/250/305 + (70/80/90/100/110% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Every stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by.

E.name: Event Horizon
E.tooltip:
Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through for 1.5/1.75/2/2.25/2.5 seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.

This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

R.name: Primordial Burst
R.tooltip: Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between (175/250/325 + (65/70/75% Ability Power)) and (350/500/650 + (130/140/150% Ability Power)) magic damage, increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.

P.name: Organic Deconstruction
P.tooltip:
Vel'Koz's Abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction for 7 seconds. Enemies with 3 stacks consume them and take (60% Ability Power) true damage.

Vel'Koz's Attacks refresh the duration of Deconstruction, but won't add new stacks.

Q.name: Plasma Fission
Q.tooltip:
Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals (80/120/160/200/240 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 70% decaying over 1/1.4/1.8/2.2/2.6 second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting, the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle.

Killing a unit with this restores 20/22.5/25/27.5/30 Mana.

W.name: Void Rift
W.tooltip:
Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing (30/50/70/90/110 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage. The rift then erupts, dealing (45/75/105/135/165 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage.

This Ability has 2 charges (18/17/16/15/14 second refresh).

E.name: Tectonic Disruption
E.tooltip: Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, Knocking Up for 0.75 seconds and dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage. Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be Knocked Back instead of Knocked Up.

R.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
R.tooltip:
Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of (450/700/925 + (125% Ability Power)) magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by 20%. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by Organic Deconstruction.

Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.

P.name: Doom 'n Gloom
P.tooltip:
Every 16 seconds Vex becomes afflicted with Doom, causing her next basic Ability to Knock Down and Fear enemies for 1.5 seconds.

Whenever a nearby enemy dashes or blinks, Vex marks them with Gloom for 6 seconds. Vex's next Attack against a Gloomed enemy deals an additional (25% Ability Power) magic damage and reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 25%.

Q.name: Mistral Bolt
Q.tooltip:
Vex launches a wave of mist that deals (70/115/160/205/250 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage. After a delay, the wave becomes smaller and faster.

Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.

W.name: Personal Space
W.tooltip:
Vex gains (50/75/100/125/150 + (75% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds and emits a shockwave that deals (80/120/160/200/240 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.

E.name: Looming Darkness
E.tooltip:
Vex commands Shadow to fly to a location, increasing in size as it travels. Upon arriving, it deals (50/70/90/110/130 + (40/45/50/55/60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 30/35/40/45/50% for 2 seconds.

Killing an enemy with this ability reduces Doom'n Gloom's Cooldown by 10%.

Applies Gloom to enemies hit.

R.name: Shadow Surge
R.tooltip:
Shadow excitedly surges forward, dealing magic damage and marking the first enemy champion hit for 4 seconds.

Recast: Dash to the marked champion, dealing magic damage on arrival.

If the marked champion dies within seconds of taking damage from this Ability, its Cooldown is temporarily reset.

P.name: Blast Shield
P.tooltip: Vi gains (12% Health) Shield for 3 seconds after hitting an enemy or structure with an activated Ability.

Q.name: Vault Breaker
Q.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Vi begins charging a powerful punch, Slowing herself by 15%.

Release: Vi dashes forward dealing between (40/60/80/100/120 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) and (100/150/200/250/300 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage based on charge time and applying Denting Blows to all enemies hit. Vi stops upon colliding with an enemy champion, and Knocks them Back.

Non-champions hit are pulled towards Vi.
If the charge is interrupted, this Ability goes on a 3 second Cooldown.

W.name: Denting Blows
W.tooltip:
Passive: Every 3rd Attack on the same target deals an additional (4/5/6/7/8% + (0.035% bonus Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage, removes 20% Armor and grants Vi 30/35/40/45/50% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. It also reduces the remaining Cooldown of Blast Shield by seconds.

Deals a maximum of 300 damage against jungle monsters.

E.name: Relentless Force
E.tooltip:
Vi's next Attack deals (10/30/50/70/90 + (110% Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) physical damage to the target and enemies behind them.

This Ability has 2 charges (12/11/10/9/8 second refresh).

R.name: Cease and Desist
R.tooltip:
Vi singles out an enemy champion, revealing them and dashing unstoppably towards them. Upon reaching them, Vi Knocks them Up for 1.3 seconds and deals (150/250/350 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

Any other enemies Vi collides with are dealt damage, knocked aside, and Stunned for 0.75 seconds.

P.name: Sovereign's Domination
P.tooltip: The souls of enemy champions that die within 3 seconds of being hit by Viego become wraiths. Viego can Attack wraiths to Possess them, restoring (2 + (2.5% bonus Attack Damage) + (2% Ability Power) + (500%))of enemy's max Health and gaining access to their non-ultimate Abilities, Attacks, and items for 10 seconds. During this time he replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own and gains 10% Move Speed towards enemy champions.

Q.name: Blade of the Ruined King
Q.tooltip:
Passive: Viego's Attacks deal an additional 2/3/4/5/6% current Health physical damage. His first Attack against an enemy he has recently damaged with an Ability hits a second time, dealing ((20% Attack Damage) + (15% Ability Power)) physical damage and restoring 150% of damage dealt as Health. These bonuses are kept during Possession.

Active: Viego stabs forward, dealing (25/40/55/70/85 + (70% Attack Damage)) physical damage.

The second strike can Critically Strike and applies On-Hit effects while not Possessing an enemy. Its healing is decreased to 125% vs. jungle monsters and 100% vs. minions.
The bonus On-Hit damage can critically strike for 100% current Health and deals a minimum of 10/15/20/25/30 damage. It deals a max of 80 damage vs. jungle monsters.
This Ability's cast time is reduced with Attack Speed. Its damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Damage at 60% effectiveness.

W.name: Spectral Maw
W.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Viego begins gathering Mist, Slowing himself by 10%.

Release: Viego dashes forward and hurls the gathered Mist. Deals (80/135/190/245/300 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and Stuns the first enemy hit for 0.25 to 1.25 seconds based on charge time.


This Ability's Cooldown is set to 3 seconds when interrupted.

E.name: Harrowed Path
E.tooltip:
Viego sends forth a spectre to haunt the first terrain hit, surrounding it with Mist for 8 seconds. Viego gains Camouflage, (25/27.5/30/32.5/35% + (0.04% Ability Power)) Move Speed, and 30/35/40/45/50% Attack Speed while inside the Mist.

Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.
Viego reveals himself for 0.6 seconds whenever he attacks or uses an Ability.

R.name: Heartbreaker
R.tooltip:
Viego discards any souls he is currently Possessing and teleports. On arrival he Attacks the champion with the lowest percent Health, briefly Slowing them by 99% and dealing (120% Attack Damage) + (12/16/20 + (5% bonus Attack Damage))missing Health physical damage. Other nearby enemies are Knocked Back and take (120% Attack Damage) physical damage.

This Ability applies on-hit effects to the primary target and spell effects to everything else.
Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Damage at 70% effectiveness.

P.name: Glorious Evolution
P.tooltip:
Viktor gains Hex Fragments whenever he kills an enemy. Every 100 Hex Fragments Viktor obtains will permanently upgrade an active Ability. After upgrading all of his basic Abilities, Viktor can upgrade his Ultimate Ability.

Killing minions grants 1 Hex Fragment.
Killing cannon minions grants 10 Hex Fragments.
Champion takedowns grant 20 Hex Fragments.

Q.name: Siphon Power
Q.tooltip:
Viktor blasts an enemy, dealing (60/75/90/105/120 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and granting Viktor (25% Ability Power) Shield for 2.5 seconds.

Viktor's next Attack within 4 seconds deals (20/45/70/95/120 + (50% Ability Power) + (100% Attack Damage)) magic damage.

Upgraded: Grants (40% Ability Power) Shield and Viktor additionally gains 30% Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

W.name: Gravity Field
W.tooltip:
Viktor deploys a gravitational imprisonment device for 4 seconds, Slowing enemies inside it by 33/36/39/42/45%. Enemies who remain within its radius for 1.25 seconds are Stunned for 1.5 seconds.

Upgraded Passive: Viktor's Abilities Slow by 20% for 1 second.




Enemies that are Stunned by this Ability are also Knocked Down.

E.name: Hextech Ray
E.tooltip:
Viktor fires a hextech ray in a chosen direction, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to any enemies it hits.

Upgraded: An aftershock follows Hextech Ray, dealing (20/50/80/110/140 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

R.name: Arcane Storm
R.tooltip:
Viktor conjures an Arcane Storm in an area for 6.5 seconds, which instantly deals (100/175/250 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage followed by (65/105/145 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per second to surrounding enemies. The storm automatically follows champions it has recently damaged.

Recast: Viktor can manually move the storm.

Upgraded: The storm moves 25% faster. If a champion that the storm has damaged dies, the storm increases its size and its duration by 3 seconds (up to 6 times).



When the storm appears it interrupts channeled Abilities.
The farther the storm is from Viktor, the slower it moves.

P.name: Crimson Pact
P.tooltip:
Vladimir gains 1 Ability Power for every 30 bonus Health. He also gains 1.6 max Health per 1 Ability Power.

Bonus Ability Power:
Bonus Health:

Q.name: Transfusion
Q.tooltip:
Vladimir drains his target's lifeforce, dealing (80/100/120/140/160 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and restoring (20/25/30/35/40 + (35% Ability Power)) Health. After using this Ability twice, Vladimir gains 60% Move Speed for 0.5 seconds and empowers the next use of this Ability for 2.5 seconds.

The empowered version of this Ability deals (148/185/222/259/296 + (111% Ability Power)) magic damage instead and restores an additional 30/200 plus (5% + (0.04% Ability Power)) missing Health.

Empowered healing reduced to 30% against minions.

W.name: Sanguine Pool
W.tooltip:
Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood for 2 seconds, gaining 37.5% decaying Move Speed for 1 second and becoming Untargetable and Ghosted while Slowing enemies in the pool by 40%.

Vladimir deals (80/135/190/245/300 + (15% bonus Health)) magic damage and restores (24/40.5/57/73.5/90 + (4.5% bonus Health)) Health per enemy over the duration.

This Ability can be used while charging Tides of Blood.
Vladimir can't Attack or use other Abilities while inside the pool.
Healing is 60% effective against minions.
Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them.
Ghosted units can pass through other units.

E.name: Tides of Blood
E.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Vladimir charges up a reservoir of blood, spending up to (8% Health) Health. While at full charge, Vladimir is Slowed by 20%.

Release: Vladimir unleashes a torrent of blood missiles at surrounding enemies, dealing between (30/45/60/75/90 + (1.5% Health) + (35% Ability Power)) and (60/90/120/150/180 + (6% Health) + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage based on charge time. If this Ability was charged for at least 1 second, it also Slows targets by 40/45/50/55/60% for 0.5 seconds.

This Ability releases automatically after 1.5 seconds.
Enemies can be hit by multiple blood missiles, but take no damage after the first.

R.name: Hemoplague
R.tooltip: Vladimir creates a virulent plague, causing its victims to take 10% increased damage from all sources for 4 seconds. After it expires, Vladimir deals (150/250/350 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage to all infected targets. Vladimir restores (150/250/350 + (70% Ability Power)) Health if he hits a champion, and restores an additional (60/100/140 + (28% Ability Power)) Health for each champion beyond the first.

P.name: The Relentless Storm
P.tooltip:
Volibear gains (5% + (0.03% Ability Power)) Attack Speed for 6 seconds whenever he deals damage with an Ability or Attack, stacking up to 5 times.

At 5 stacks, Volibear's claws ignite with lightning, causing his Attacks to deal an additional (11 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage to the target and 4 closest enemies.

Q.name: Thundering Smash
Q.tooltip:
Volibear gains 12/15.5/19/22.5/26% Move Speed, doubled to 24/31/38/45/52% towards enemy champions for the next 4 seconds. While active, Volibear's next Attack deals (10/20/30/40/50 + (100% Attack Damage) + (160% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Stuns the target for 1 second.

Volibear becomes enraged if an enemy Immobilizes him before he Stuns a target, ending the Ability early but refreshing its Cooldown.

Volibear gains 25 attack range for this attack.

W.name: Frenzied Maul
W.tooltip:
Volibear mauls an enemy, dealing (5/30/55/80/105 + (110% Attack Damage) + (6% bonus Health)) physical damage and marking them for 8 seconds.

If this Ability is used on a marked target, its damage is increased to (5/30/55/80/105 + (110% Attack Damage) + (6% bonus Health)) and Volibear restores 20/35/50/65/80 plus 8/11/14/17/20% missing Health.

Empowered damage scales with (Damage multiplier: 150% + 25%)
This Ability applies on-hit effects.
Healing is 50% effective against minions.

E.name: Sky Splitter
E.tooltip:
Volibear summons a thundercloud that fires a lightning bolt, dealing (80/110/140/170/200 + (70% Ability Power)) plus 11/12/13/14/15% max Health magic damage and Slowing by 40% for 2 seconds.

If Volibear is inside the blast zone, he gains a (75% Ability Power) plus 14% max Health Shield for 3 seconds.

Damage against non-champions is capped at (150/265/380/495/610 + (70% Ability Power)).

R.name: Stormbringer
R.tooltip:
Volibear transforms and leaps, gaining 175/350/525 Health and 50 Attack Range for the next 12 seconds.

Upon landing, Volibear cracks the earth, Disabling nearby towers for 2/3/4 seconds and dealing (300/500/700 + (125% Ability Power) + (250% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to them. Nearby enemies are Slowed by 50%, decaying over 1 second. Enemies directly underneath Volibear suffer (300/500/700 + (125% Ability Power) + (250% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

P.name: Eternal Hunger
P.tooltip:
Warwick's Attacks deal an additional ((15% bonus Attack Damage) + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit.

If Warwick is below 50% Health, he also heals for 100% of the damage dealt by Eternal Hunger. If Warwick is below 25% health, the healing is increased to 250% of the damage dealt.

Q.name: Jaws of the Beast
Q.tooltip:
Tap: Warwick lunges forward and bites, dealing ((120% Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) plus 6/7/8/9/10% max Health magic damage and healing for 25/37.5/50/62.5/75% of the damage dealt.

Hold: Warwick lunges and clamps his jaws on the target, leaping behind them. While clamped, Warwick follows all movement of the target. After releasing his hold, he does the same damage and healing.

This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects, and does not Critically Strike.
While clamped, Warwick is immune to displacement.

W.name: Blood Hunt
W.tooltip:
Passive: Warwick can sense champions below 50% Health, gaining 35/42.5/50/57.5/65% Move Speed towards them. Spells and attacks against enemies below 50% Health grant 70/80/90/100/110% Attack Speed. These effects are increased by 200% against enemies below 25% Health.

Active: Warwick can briefly sense all enemies, and gains this Ability's passive effect against the closest champion for 8 seconds, regardless of Health. If no champions are found, this Ability's cooldown is reduced by 30%.

Warwick can only passively sense enemies who were brought below 50% Health by allies.

E.name: Primal Howl
E.tooltip: Warwick gains 35/40/45/50/55% damage reduction for 2.75 seconds. After it ends, Warwick howls, Fearing nearby enemies for 1 second. Warwick can Recast to end the Ability early.

R.name: Infinite Duress
R.tooltip:
Warwick leaps a huge distance that scales with his Move Speed, Suppressing the first champion he collides with while he channels for 1.5 seconds. He attacks that champion 3 times over the duration, dealing (175/350/525 + (167% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage. Warwick heals for 100% of all damage dealt during the channel.

This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects 3 distinct times over its duration, and does not Critically Strike.
This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

P.name: Clean Cuts
P.tooltip:
After using an Ability, Xayah's next Attacks will deal damage to all other targets along their path and leave a Feather for seconds.

Lover's Leap: Xayah and Rakan can recall together.

Q.name: Double Daggers
Q.tooltip: Xayah throws two daggers, dealing (45/60/75/90/105 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage each and leaving two Feathers. Targets hit after the first take (22.5/30/37.5/45/52.5 + (25% bonus Attack Damage)) damage from each dagger.

W.name: Deadly Plumage
W.tooltip:
Xayah creates a storm of blades for 4 seconds that grants her 35/40/45/50/55% Attack Speed and cause her Attacks to fire a secondary blade that deals 25% damage.

When the secondary blade hits a champion, she grants herself 30% Move Speed for 1.5 seconds.

If Rakan is nearby he will also gain the effects of this Ability, except he gains Move Speed when Xayah strikes a target.

E.name: Bladecaller
E.tooltip:
Xayah calls all Feathers back to her, dealing (50/65/80/95/110 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage each. If 3 or more Feathers hit an enemy, they are Rooted for 1.25 seconds.

Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 50% effectiveness.
Minions take 50% damage from this Ability.
Enemies take 5% less damage per feather hit, to a minimum of 10% damage.

R.name: Featherstorm
R.tooltip:
Xayah leaps into the air becoming Untargetable and Ghosted for 1.5 seconds before raining down daggers that deal (200/300/400 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and leave behind a line of Feathers.

Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been affected by them.
Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.
Xayah can move while in the air.

P.name: Mana Surge
P.tooltip:
Every 16 seconds Xerath's next Attack against a champion restores 60 Mana. It restores 30 Mana if attacking minions, jungle monsters or structures.

Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced by 3.5 seconds.

Q.name: Arcanopulse
Q.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Xerath begins charging an arcane beam, Slowing himself gradually up to 50%.

Release: Xerath fires the beam, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage. The range increases with time charged.

If Xerath does not release the beam, half the cost is refunded.

W.name: Eye of Destruction
W.tooltip:
Xerath calls down a blast of arcane energy, dealing (50/85/120/155/190 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing them by 25% for 2.5 seconds. Enemies in the center take (83.35/141.695/200.04/258.385/316.73 + (108.355% Ability Power)) magic damage instead and are Slowed by 60/65/70/75/80%, decaying over 2.5 seconds.

Empowered Slow decays down to 25%.

E.name: Shocking Orb
E.tooltip:
Xerath fires an orb of raw magic, Stunning the first enemy hit for up to 2.25 seconds based on distance travelled, and dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Minimum Stun duration is 0.75 seconds.

R.name: Rite of the Arcane
R.tooltip:
Xerath ascends to his true form and channels for 10 seconds. During this time he may Recast up to 4/5/6 times.

Recast: Xerath launches a magical artillery, dealing (170/220/270 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage. For each champion hit, the artillery deals an additional (20/25/30 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage.

If Xerath does not Recast at all, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 50%.

P.name: Determination
P.tooltip: Every third Attack or strike with Wind Becomes Lightning deals an additional physical damage and restores Health.

Q.name: Three Talon Strike
Q.tooltip: Xin Zhao's next 3 Attacks deal an additional (15/30/45/60/75 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and reduces his other Ability's Cooldowns by 1 second. The third Attack also Knocks Up for 0.75 seconds.

W.name: Wind Becomes Lightning
W.tooltip:
Xin Zhao slashes, dealing (30/40/50/60/70 + (30% Attack Damage)) physical damage, then thrusts, dealing (50/85/120/155/190 + (90% Attack Damage) + (65% Ability Power)). Enemies hit by the thrust are Slowed by -5000% for (1.5 + (0.5% Ability Power)) seconds.

Champions and Large Monsters hit by the thrust are marked as Challenged for 3 seconds and revealed unless Stealthed.

The thrust's damage is increased by up to 33.3% based on Xin Zhao's Critical Strike Chance.
Deals 53.34% damage to minions.
Applies Lifesteal at 33% effectiveness on both attacks.

E.name: Audacious Charge
E.tooltip:
Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing (50/75/100/125/150 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 30% for 0.5 seconds.

Xin Zhao grants himself () Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

This Ability's range is increased on enemies that are Challenged.

R.name: Crescent Guard
R.tooltip:
Passive: The last champion Xin Zhao damaged with an Attack or Audacious Charge is Challenged for 3 seconds.

Active: Xin Zhao unleashes a sweep around him that deals (75/175/275 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (110% Ability Power)) plus 15% current Health physical damage and Knocks Back all non-Challenged enemies.

Afterwards, Xin Zhao becomes immune to damage from enemies outside the sweep range for 4 seconds.

Deals a max of 600 damage to jungle monsters and minions.

P.name: Way of the Wanderer
P.tooltip:
Resolve: Moving grants Flow, which is tracked on Yasuo's resource bar. Moving faster grants more Flow. At maximum Flow, damage from a champion or monster briefly grants (125 ~ 600) Shield.

Intent: Yasuo's Critical Strike Chance is increased by 100% but his Critical Strike Damage is reduced to (100%). Gain Bonus Attack Damage for every 1% Critical Strike Chance above 100%.

Q.name: Steel Tempest
Q.tooltip:
Yasuo thrusts, dealing (20/45/70/95/120 + (105% Attack Damage)) physical damage. If he hits, he gains a stack for 6 seconds. While he has 2 stacks, his next use of this Ability fires a whirlwind from range, dealing the same damage and Knocking Up for 1 second.

If used while dashing, this Ability strikes in a circle rather than a stab.

This Ability acts like an Attack: it can critically strike for 20/45/70/95/120 physical damage, it applies On-hit effects and lifesteal to the first enemy struck, is interruptible by crowd control, and its cooldown and cast time are reduced with Attack Speed.

W.name: Wind Wall
W.tooltip:
Yasuo creates a drifting wall of wind that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.

Tower shots and beams are not blocked.

E.name: Sweeping Blade
E.tooltip:
Yasuo dashes through a target, dealing (70/85/100/115/130 + (20% bonus Attack Damage) + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Each use of this Ability grants (17.5/21.25/25/28.75/32.5 + (5% bonus Attack Damage) + (15% Ability Power)) bonus damage to subsequent uses for 5 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

This Ability has a 10/9/8/7/6 second per-target Cooldown.

R.name: Last Breath
R.tooltip:
Yasuo teleports to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing (200/350/500 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and holding all nearby Airborne enemies up for an additional 1 second. Yasuo also gains maximum Flow, but loses all Steel Tempest stacks.

Afterwards, Yasuo's critical strikes ignore 60% bonus Armor for 15 seconds.

P.name: Way of the Hunter
P.tooltip:
Steel and Spirit: Yone uses two blades, causing every second Attack to deal 50% magic damage.

Intent: Yone's Critical Strike Chance is increased by 100% but his Critical Strike Damage is reduced to (100%). Gain Bonus AD for every 1% Critical Strike Chance above 100%.

Q.name: Mortal Steel
Q.tooltip:
Yone thrusts forward, dealing (25/50/75/100/125 + (110% Attack Damage)) physical damage.

On hit, grants a stack for 6 seconds. At 2 stacks, this ability causes Yone to dash forward with a wave of wind that Knocks Up for 0.75 seconds and deals (25/50/75/100/125 + (110% Attack Damage)) physical damage.

This Ability acts like an Attack: it can critically strike for 25/50/75/100/125 physical damage, it applies On-hit effects and lifesteal to the first enemy struck, is interruptible by crowd control, and its cooldown and cast time are reduced with Attack Speed.

W.name: Spirit Cleave
W.tooltip:
Yone cleaves forward, dealing 5/10/15/20/25 + 4/4.5/5/5.5/6% max Health physical damage and 5/10/15/20/25 + 4/4.5/5/5.5/6% max Health magic damage.

If Yone hits, he gains (65% bonus Attack Damage) Shield for 1.5 seconds. The amount of Shield increases for each champion struck.

Shield increased by 100% for the first champion hit and 50% for all subsequent champions.
This abilities cooldown and cast time are reduced by Attack Speed.
Minimum (30 ~ 30) total damage against minions.

E.name: Soul Unbound
E.tooltip:
Yone enters a spirit form for 5 seconds, leaving his body behind for the duration and gaining 10% to 30% ramping Move Speed.

When the spirit form ends, Yone snaps back to his body and repeats 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% of all Attack and Ability damage he dealt to champions during this time. You may Recast this ability during spirit form.

Recast: End spirit form early.

Yone cannot snap back while affected by hard crowd control.

R.name: Fate Sealed
R.tooltip:
Yone strikes all enemies along a path for (100/200/300 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and (100/200/300 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage, teleporting behind the last champion hit and Knocking Up victims towards Yone.

If no enemy champion is struck, Yone will instead blink to maximum range.

P.name: Shepherd of Souls
P.tooltip:
Yorick raises a grave for every 2 enemies that die near him. Champions and large monsters always leave a grave.

These graves can be used to Awaken Mist Walkers with (15% bonus Health) Health and (20% bonus Attack Damage) Attack Damage, up to 4 in an area.

Q.name: Last Rites
Q.tooltip:
Yorick's next Attack deals an additional (30/50/70/90/110 + (50% Attack Damage)) physical damage and restores 10 plus 6/7/8/9/10% of his missing Health, reduced by 50% against non-Champions. If this Attack hits a Champion or large Monster or kills the target, it leaves a grave.

When there are 3 or more graves nearby and this Ability has already been used, Yorick can Recast to raise Mist Walkers from all nearby graves.

This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

W.name: Dark Procession
W.tooltip: Yorick summons a wall of spirits blocking enemies' path, but not allies'. The wall has 2/2/3/3/4 Health and disappears after 4 seconds.

E.name: Mourning Mist
E.tooltip:
Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that deals (6/6.5/7/7.5/8% + (0.03% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage, Slows by 30% for 1.5 seconds and marks champions and monsters for 4 seconds. Marked enemies continuously Awaken nearby graves (but not exceeding the maximum of ) and suffer 13/16/19/22/25% reduced Armor.

Yorick and his summoned units gain 18/21/24/27/30% Move Speed toward the mark. Mist Walkers will leap once at marked enemies that get away from them.

Deals a minimum of (70/105/140/175/210 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to lane Minions.
Deals a maximum of (50/75/100/125/150 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to jungle Monsters.

R.name: Eulogy of the Isles
R.tooltip:
Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist with (1050 + (60% bonus Health)) Health and (50/75/100 + (30% bonus Attack Damage)) Magic Attack Damage plus 2/3/4 Mist Walkers. The Maiden automatically raises Mist Walkers from nearby enemy deaths and marks enemy Champions with her attacks. When Yorick damages the Maiden's target, he deals 2/2.5/3% max Health magic damage.

After 10 seconds, Yorick can Recast this Ability to free the Maiden, sending her down the nearest lane.

Maiden of the Mist
30 Armor
30 Magic Resist
Takes 30% damage from lane minions

P.name: Vow of the First Lands
P.tooltip: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal an additional (10% + (0.1% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Q.name: Cultivation of Spirit
Q.tooltip:
Passive: Yunara deal (5/10/15/20/25 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit and attacking grants 1 Unleash (2 Unleash for champions).

Active: Yunara consumes 8 Unleash and for 5 seconds gains 20/30/40/50/60% Attack Speed and deals an additional (5/10/15/20/25 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit. During this time, her Attacks spread to nearby enemies dealing them (30% Attack Damage) physical damage.

Transcendent State: This Ability is instantly activated for seconds.

Spread Attacks can Strike Critically and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness. Damage from spread Attacks deal 250% damage to minions below 30% Health.

W.name: Arc of Judgment | Arc of Ruin
W.tooltip:
Yunara lets rip a prayer bead that deals (55/95/135/175/215 + (85% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 99% decaying over 1.5 seconds. It deals an additional (33/57/81/105/129 + (51% bonus Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage per second.

Transcendent State - Arc of Ruin: Yunara fires a laser that deals magic damage and Slows by decaying over second.

Cast time scales with permanent Attack Speed (/ 100%). Arc of Judgment deals 100% damage to minions and its tick damage executes low health minions. Arc of Ruin gains the benefits of an Ultimate Ability.

E.name: Kanmei's Steps | Untouchable Shadow
E.tooltip:
Yunara gains 30/35/40/45/50% Move Speed, increased to 45/52.5/60/67.5/75% Move Speed when moving toward an enemy champion, for 1.5 seconds.

Transcendent State - Untouchable Shadow: Yunara dashes in a direction.

Kanmei's Steps causes Yunara to become Ghosted. Untouchable Shadow gains the benefits of an Ultimate Ability.

R.name: Transcend One's Self
R.tooltip: Yunara enters a Transcendent State for 15 seconds upgrading her basic Abilities for the duration.

P.name: Feline Friendship
P.tooltip:
When Yuumi's Attacks and Abilities strike champions, she heals herself for (30% Ability Power) health. If Yuumi Attaches to an ally within 4 seconds, they are healed as well. This effect has a 20 second Cooldown.

While Attached, Yuumi gains Friendship with her ally whenever they kill a champion or minion. The ally with the most Friendship becomes her Best Friend and grants Yuumi bonus effects to her Abilities while she is Attached to them.

The heal will automatically trigger if Yuumi is already Attached to an ally.

Q.name: Prowling Projectile
Q.tooltip:
Yuumi summons an errant missile that deals (60/95/130/165/200/235 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy and Slows the target for 20%.

If cast while Attached, Yuumi can control the missile using her mouse for a short period before it accelerates in a straight line. The accelerated missile deals (80/135/190/245/300/355 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows the target for 50/53/56/59/62/65% for 2 seconds, instead.

Best Friend Bonus: Prowling Projectile's Slow will always be enhanced and hitting an enemy champion also grants them (10/12/14/16/18/20 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit for 5 seconds.

The bonus On-Hit damage can be increased by 75% based her ally's Critical Strike Chance.

W.name: You and Me!
W.tooltip:
Passive: While on her Best Friend, Yuumi gains an additional 4/5/6/7/8% Heal & Shield Power and her ally also restores (3/4/5/6/7 + (3% Ability Power)) health On-Hit .

Active: Yuumi dashes to an ally champion and Attaches to them. While Yuumi is Attached, she follows her partner's movement and is Untargetable except from towers.

Immobilizing effects on Yuumi place this Ability on a 5 second Cooldown.

This Ability has a second Cooldown, but Yuumi can cast it anytime she is already Attached to switch between friends or Unattach.

Yuumi's Abilities will use her Attached ally's position instead of hers.

Yuumi will Unattach if her ally uses Summoner Teleport.

E.name: Zoomies
E.tooltip:
Yuumi shields herself, blocking (65/90/115/140/165 + (40% Ability Power)) damage and gains (25/27.5/30/32.5/35 + (8% Ability Power))Attack Speed for 3 seconds. While the shield persists, the target also gains 20% Move Speed.

If Yuumi is Attached, this Ability affects her ally instead and also restores 20/24/28/32/36 Mana to them, increased by up to 100% based on the target's missing Mana.

R.name: Final Chapter
R.tooltip:
Yuumi channels for 3.5 seconds, launching 5 magical waves affecting both teams. If initially cast while Attached, Yuumi can steer the waves to follow her mouse.

Enemies struck are dealt (75/125/175 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowed by 10% for 1.25 seconds, increased by 10% per wave hit.

Ally champions are healed for (30/50/70 + (12% Ability Power)) health per wave. Excess healing is converted to a Shield instead.

Best Friend Bonus: For her Best Friend, the heal is increased to (30/50/70 + (12% Ability Power)) health.

Casting You and Me! will locks the waves in the current direction.
Yuumi can move and cast Zoomies while channeling.


Missiles after the first deal (18.75/31.25/43.75 + (6.25% Ability Power)) magic damage. Max possible damage to a single enemy is (75/125/175 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage.

P.name: Cultivation of War
P.tooltip:
Zaahen gains a stack of Determination when he hits an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability (max 12). He gains increased Attack Damage per stack.

When filled with Determination, Zaahen doubles the granted Attack Damage, and if he would die, he instead enters Stasis for 4 seconds then revives with of his max Health.

Zaahen's revive has a 120 second Cooldown.

Q.name: The Darkin Glaive
Q.tooltip:
Zaahen slashes twice on his next Attack, dealing (15/30/45/60/75 + (20/25/30/35/40% bonus Attack Damage)) bonus physical damage and restoring 5/6/7/8/9% of his max Health.

Recast: Zaahen's next Attack deals (25/50/75/100/125 + (20/25/30/35/40% bonus Attack Damage)) bonus physical damage and Knocks the target Up for 0.75 seconds.

Healing reduced to 50% against non-champions.
Deals an additional 100% bonus damage to monsters.

W.name: Dreaded Return
W.tooltip: Zaahen stabs in a direction, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies hit, then Pulls them toward him, dealing (30/50/70/90/110 + (30% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

E.name: Aureate Rush
E.tooltip:
Zaahen dashes then slices around himself, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to nearby enemies.

Enemies at the edge of the slice take (60/90/120/150/180 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage + 4/4.5/5/5.5/6% of their maximum Health as magic damage instead.

Deals an additional 50 bonus physical damage to monsters.
Additional Maximum Health damage capped to 400 against monsters.

R.name: Grim Deliverance
R.tooltip:
Passive: Zaahen gains 10/20/30% Armor Penetration.

Active: Zaahen rises, gaining 50% Damage Reduction while casting.

Zaahen then stabs downward, dealing (250/400/550 + (200% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and restoring 33% of the damage dealt to enemy champions as Health.

P.name: Cell Division
P.tooltip:
Each time Zac hits an enemy with an Ability, he sheds a chunk of Goo that can be reabsorbed to restore (4% ~ 8%) Max Health.

Upon dying, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain after 4 seconds, he will revive with 10-50% Health based on the surviving bloblet's Health. This has a 300 second Cooldown.

Q.name: Stretching Strikes
Q.tooltip:
Zac stretches his arm out, attaching it to the first enemy hit to deal (60/90/120/150/180 + (30% Ability Power) + (3% bonus Health)) magic damage and briefly Slow them. Zac's next Attack gains increased range and applies the same damage and Slow.

If Zac hits a different enemy with this Attack, he Knocks Up both towards each other. If they collide, they and surrounding enemies take (60/90/120/150/180 + (30% Ability Power) + (3% bonus Health)) magic damage and are briefly Slowed.

Slows by 40%.
Maximum magic damage: .

W.name: Unstable Matter
W.tooltip:
Zac's body erupts, dealing 40/50/60/70/80 + (4/5/6/7/8% + (0.03% Ability Power)) max Health magic damage to nearby enemies.

Absorbing Goo reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second.

Percent Health damage against minions and jungle monsters is capped at 200.

E.name: Elastic Slingshot
E.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Zac pulls himself taut, charging up a dash over 0.9/1/1.1/1.2/1.3 seconds.

Release: Zac launches himself and Knocks Up enemies where he lands for up to 1 second (based on charge time), dealing them (60/105/150/195/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. Zac spawns an extra chunk of Goo for each enemy champion hit.

Can be cancelled by moving.
If cancelled, refunds half of the Ability's Cooldown and cost.

R.name: Let's Bounce!
R.tooltip:
Zac bounces 4 times. The first bounce to hit each enemy Knocks them back and deals (120/190/260 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage. Subsequent bounces deal (60/95/130 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slow by 20% for 1 second.

Zac gains up to 50% Move Speed over time and can cast Unstable Matter while bouncing.

Total Damage: (120/190/260 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage
Move Speed increases from 20% to 50% over the duration.
During Let's Bounce!, Zac is Ghosted. Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.

P.name: Contempt for the Weak
P.tooltip: Whenever Zed Attacks an enemy below 50% Health, he deals an additional max Health magic damage. Enemy champions can only be hit once every 10 seconds.

Q.name: Razor Shuriken
Q.tooltip: Zed and his Shadows throw their shurikens, each dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy they pass through, and (48/72/96/120/144 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to each additional enemy.

W.name: Living Shadow
W.tooltip:
Passive: Zed gains 30/35/40/45/50 Energy whenever he and his Shadows strike an enemy with the same Ability.

Active: Zed's Shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for 5 seconds. Recasting this Ability will cause Zed to switch positions with this Shadow.

Energy can only be gained once per Ability usage.

E.name: Shadow Slash
E.tooltip:
Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing (70/92.5/115/137.5/160 + (70% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to nearby enemies.

Each enemy champion hit by Zed's slash reduces Living Shadow's Cooldown by 3 seconds.

Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are Slowed by 20/25/30/35/40% for 1.5 seconds. Enemies hit by multiple slashes take no additional damage but are Slowed by 30/37.5/45/52.5/60% instead.

R.name: Death Mark
R.tooltip:
Zed becomes Untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds, the mark triggers, dealing (100% Attack Damage) physical damage and repeating 25/40/55% of all damage dealt to the target by Zed while the mark was active.

The dash leaves a Shadow behind for 7.5 seconds. Zed can Recast this Ability to switch positions with this Shadow.

Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them.
The Shadow remains for an extra 1.5 seconds after the recast window ends.

P.name: Living Battery
P.tooltip: Zeri's Attacks are treated as Abilities instead of Attacks and can be charged up by moving and casting . Uncharged Attacks consume a small amount of charge, deal magic damage and execute enemies below Health. A fully charged Attack deals + max Health magic damage and consumes all charge.

Q.name: Burst Fire
Q.tooltip:
Zeri fires a burst of 7 rounds that deals (22/26/30/34/38 + (102/104/106/108/110% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack.

This Ability can crit, apply on-hit effects once per target, and hit anything that an Attack can. The Cooldown and cast time scale down with Attack Speed (max 1.5 attacks per second). 60% of excess Attack Speed is converted into Attack Damage.

W.name: Ultrashock Laser
W.tooltip:
Zeri fires an electric pulse that deals (30/70/110/150/190 + (120% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage and Slows the first enemy hit by 30/35/40/45/50% for 2 seconds.

If the pulse hits terrain, it expands into a laser that applies the effects in an area and Critically Strikes champions and monsters for (30/70/110/150/190 + (120% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage.

This Ability's cast time scales down with Attack Speed.
Empowered damage scales with Critical Strike Damage at 50% effectiveness.

E.name: Spark Surge
E.tooltip:
Zeri dashes a short distance and vaults over any terrain she touches, greatly extending the dash range. For the next 5 seconds, her shots of Burst Fire pierce dealing 80/85/90/95/100% damage to enemies after the first and an additional (22/24/26/28/30 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit to the first target struck.

Hitting an enemy with an Attack reduces this Ability's cooldown by 0.5 seconds. Critical strikes reduce the cooldown by 1.5 seconds instead.

On-hit damage is increased by Zeri's Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 100% effectiveness.
Pierce damage can critically strike but does not apply On-Hit effects.

R.name: Lightning Crash
R.tooltip:
Zeri discharges a nova of electricity, dealing (150/250/350 + (110% Ability Power) + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits an enemy champion, Zeri gains 30% Attack Speed and 15% Move Speed for 5 seconds. Hitting an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability extends this ability's duration and adds a stack of Overcharge for 2.5 seconds. Critical strikes add 2 additional stacks. Each stack grants 1.5% Move Speed.

During this time, Burst Fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains (40% Attack Damage) physical damage to nearby enemies.



The Attack Speed also increases Zeri's max Attack Speed. The chain lightning can critically strike but does not apply On-Hit effects. Uncharged Attacks do not stack or refresh this ability.
This ability's duration extension cannot exceed its original duration of 5 seconds.

P.name: Short Fuse
P.tooltip:
Every seconds, Ziggs' next Attack deals an additional (20 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage. It deals (35 + (87.5% Ability Power)) damage instead to structures.

Ziggs' abilities reduce this Cooldown by (4 ~ 6) seconds.

Q.name: Bouncing Bomb
Q.tooltip: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that deals (80/130/180/230/280 + (60/65/70/75/80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

W.name: Satchel Charge
W.tooltip:
Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after 4 seconds, or when this ability is Recast. It deals (70/105/140/175/210 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies and Knocks them Back. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage.

Satchel Charge will automatically destroy towers below 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% of their Health.

E.name: Hexplosive Minefield
E.tooltip:
Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing (30/70/110/150/190 + (25/30/35/40/45% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 10/20/30/40/50% for 1.5 seconds. Mines last 10 seconds.

Mines beyond the first deal (12/28/44/60/76 + (10/12/14/16/18% Ability Power)) damage.

R.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
R.tooltip: Ziggs hurls his ultimate creation, dealing (300/500/700 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage in the center of the blast radius, or (195/325/455 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage at the edge.

P.name: Time In A Bottle
P.tooltip: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.

Q.name: Time Bomb
Q.tooltip:
Zilean tosses a time-delayed bomb that sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After 3 seconds it detonates, dealing (75/115/165/230/300 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Placing a second bomb on a unit that already has one detonates the first bomb immediately and Stuns enemies in the blast for 1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 seconds.

The bomb will prioritize attaching to champions and units that already have a bomb.

W.name: Rewind
W.tooltip: Zilean turns time, reducing his other basic Ability Cooldowns by 10 seconds.

E.name: Time Warp
E.tooltip: Zilean Slows an enemy champion by 40/55/70/85/99% or grants an allied champion 40/55/70/85/99% Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

R.name: Chronoshift
R.tooltip:
Zilean grants a protective time rune to an allied champion for 5 seconds. If the target would die, the rune rewinds their timeline, putting them into Stasis for 3 seconds, then reviving them and restoring (600/850/1100 + (200% Ability Power)) Health.

Units in Stasis cannot move or act, and are invulnerable and Untargetable.

P.name: More Sparkles!
P.tooltip: After using an Ability, Zoe's next Attack deals an additional (16 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Q.name: Paddle Star!
Q.tooltip:
Zoe fires a star that deals increasing damage the further it travels to the first enemy hit and surrounding enemies -- between (52/82/112/142/172 + (60% Ability Power)) to (130/205/280/355/430 + (150% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Zoe can Recast this Ability to redirect the missile to a new position near Zoe.

W.name: Spell Thief
W.tooltip:
Passive: Enemies drop spell shards when casting a Summoner Spell or using an Active Item. Specific minions also drop a spell shard when Zoe or a nearby ally kills them. Zoe can pick up this shard to cast that ability once.

Passive: When Zoe casts this Ability or any Summoner Spell, she gains 30/40/50/60/70% Move Speed for 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3 seconds and tosses 3 missiles at the target she Attacked most recently. These missiles deal (15/25/35/45/55 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage each.

Active: Cast the Ability from a spell shard Zoe has picked up.

Spell shards last on the ground for 40 seconds.
Each missile can apply More Sparkles!

E.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
E.tooltip:
Zoe dropkicks a bubble that deals (70/110/150/190/230 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage, lingering as a trap if it hits nothing. The bubble's range is extended when flying over terrain.

If either the bubble or trap hits an enemy champion she refreshes 16/19.5/23/26.5/30% of her cooldown.

After a delay, the victim falls Asleep and have their Magic Resist reduced by 30% for 2 seconds. Attacks and Ability hits wake them up but deal double damage, up to (70/110/150/190/230 + (45% Ability Power)) true damage.



Before the target falls Asleep, they are Drowsy, becoming increasingly Slowed (up to 10/15/20/25/30%).

R.name: Portal Jump
R.tooltip:
Zoe teleports to a nearby position for 1 second. Afterwards, she teleports back. Zoe can use Abilities and Attack, but can't move during this time.

Zoe can also see over walls during the teleport.

P.name: Garden of Thorns
P.tooltip:
Zyra spawns Seeds around herself every (13.6 ~ 9.05) seconds that last 30 seconds. She can have 8 Seeds planted at once. If an enemy champion steps on a Seed, it dies. Zyra will not spawn Seeds while hiding in brush.

These Seeds are used by her other Abilities to spawn plants that deal (20% Ability Power) magic damage.

Q.name: Deadly Spines
Q.tooltip:
Zyra causes thick vines to spread and explode into spines, dealing (60/100/140/180/220 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage.

If this Ability is cast near a Seed, the Seed grows into a Thorn Spitter that deals magic damage and lasts seconds. Thorn Spitters have 575 range.

W.name: Rampant Growth
W.tooltip:
Zyra plants a Seed that lasts 60 seconds. These Seeds grant True Sight of enemy champions that step on them for 2 seconds, but are still destroyed.

This Ability has 2 charges with a 18/16/14/12/10 second recharge time. Killing an enemy minion or monster reduces the recharge time by 35%. Champion takedowns reduce the recharge time by 100% instead.

E.name: Grasping Roots
E.tooltip:
Zyra sends vines forward, Rooting for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 second(s) and dealing (60/95/130/165/200 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage.

If this Ability passes near a Seed, the Seed grows into a Vine Lasher that deals magic damage and lasts seconds. Vine Lashers have 400 range, and their Attacks Slow by 30% for 2 seconds. The Slow from multiple Vine Lashers stacks up to 2 times.

R.name: Stranglethorns
R.tooltip:
Zyra summons the fury of nature, growing a twisted thicket that deals (200/300/400 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage. After 2 seconds, the vines snap upwards, Knocking Up for 1 second.

Zyra's plants within the thicket become enraged, resetting their duration, gaining 50% Health and Attacking for 50% bonus damage.
